Abstract: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

</details>


### [109] [Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11942)
*Jiaming Zhang,Xuan Wang,Fuyao Zhang,Yang Cao,Lingjuan Lyu,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出LGWM，一种无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接在表示空间中预测下一个界面，将GUI agent安全验证化简为向量比较，在RSWT-BENCH上以17ms达到0.987 AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI agent的安全本质上是"转场"属性而非"屏幕"属性：合法界面在错误转场下即为攻击，仅检查屏幕的监控器可被复用合法界面绕过。判断转场需要"期望下一步应是什么"，现有GUI世界模型以文本/代码/图像输出，需第二个模型来比对，成本高且引入误差。

Method: 提出LGWM：无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接在观测编码空间中预测下一屏的表示；在185万条真实GUI转场数据上训练，无需语义标注。验证过程退化为向量比较，其残差方向还可区分违规是否有害。构建RSWT-BENCH诊断基准，使同一凭证界面同时出现在合法与劫持转场下。

Result: 免训练评分达0.987 AUC、每次决策17ms，与最强闭源VLM持平，较生成式GUI世界模型高约10个AUC点且延迟低三个数量级以上；残差方向在有害/无害违规区分上达0.953 AUC，而提示式VLM接近随机。预测是可用的未来状态而非异常分数。

Conclusion: 世界模型此前多用作模拟器或规划器，本文指出其第三种角色——验证器，并论证在表示空间中预测是该角色的自然设计。

Abstract: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.

</details>


### [110] [Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11954)
*Kartik Bali,Mahish Guru,Yiderigun Borjigin,Alexandra Starostina,Christian J. Cyron,Roland Aydin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SightCAD将视角可行性作为一等约束，联合训练视角选择器与CAD生成VLM，在场景嵌入与遮挡条件下显著提升参数化CAD重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CAD重建方法假设可从任意角度无限制地观察物体，但真实物体往往嵌入场景（靠墙、卡在角落、置于地面），导致视球大部分不可达且可用视角信息量不均。论文旨在将视角可行性作为显式约束，解决这一不现实假设带来的重建困难。

Method: 将标准CAD基准物体嵌入真实室内场景，基于离散视球施加物理推导的可见性约束；训练一个学习式视角选择器，从可行视角中挑选K个供VLM生成可执行的CadQuery代码，以执行实体的几何保真度作为奖励；由于奖励仅在离散视角选择、自回归生成和CAD内核执行之后才出现，提出视角选择器与CAD生成VLM的联合训练范式，共同针对该奖励优化。

Result: 学习到的选择策略显著偏离随机、均匀和覆盖贪心策略，在K∈{1,…,5}预算下较表面积最大化（SA-max）最多提升6.4 IoU点。完整系统在DeepCAD与Fusion360物体的场景嵌入、遮挡多视角渲染上超越强外部基线（分别提升+21与+17有效mIoU点），在T-LESS工业基准的测试时域规范化真实图像以及MP6D工业金属零件基准的合成与真实图像上同样领先，并实现最高的可执行程序率（无效代码率≤1.5%）。

Conclusion: 将视角可行性纳入CAD重建的建模与训练全过程，并通过视角选择与CAD生成的联合优化，可在真实场景约束下大幅提升参数化CAD重建的几何精度与代码可执行性，优于现有基线。

Abstract: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

</details>


### [111] [Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11967)
*Panagiotis Kiousis,Kuangyi Chen,Jun Zhang,Friedrich Fraundorfer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CELL方法，端到端学习逐对应置信度用于事件相机在LiDAR地图中的定位，减少中位平移误差达26.9%、旋转误差达15.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件相机对LiDAR地图定位管线依赖几何一致性进行位姿估计，但未显式建模每个对应的可靠性或位姿信息量。直接以逐点误差学习置信度存在深度偏置：小像素误差多出现于大深度处，而大深度对应并不对位姿形成强约束。

Method: 将定位建模为渲染深度图与事件图之间的稠密光流估计，再由PnP求解3D-2D对应。通过可微概率PnP的log-partition项端到端学习逐对应置信度，使权重配置产生约束更好的位姿分布。置信度有三处用途：(i)在解耦训练中重加权光流监督，避免位姿梯度进入光流/边缘主干；(ii)测试时驱动概率式对应选择；(iii)结合网络边缘概率加权最终边缘匹配精化。另设计部分补全深度表示，在大间隙处不产生幻觉。在M3ED与DSEC上验证。

Result: 在M3ED和DSEC数据集上，完整系统在大多数评估序列上优于LEAR基线，中位平移误差最多降低26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低15.8%。

Conclusion: 端到端经位姿学习的逐对应置信度优于基于逐点误差的置信度监督，能有效提升事件相机-LiDAR地图定位精度。

Abstract: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

</details>


### [112] [FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11986)
*Xiaoshan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文用信号检测论分解VLM灾害损伤评估中"不愿报警"的问题，定位并操纵模型中的"恐惧"情感回路，从而在不重训练的情况下修正过保守的判定准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在灾后损伤评估中整体准确率尚可，但召回率偏低，模型倾向于不宣告危险（从不误报Red），这种过保守决策策略限制了实际应用价值。作者希望从决策机制层面诊断并纠正这一缺陷。

Method: 采用信号检测论（SDT）将决策行为分解为感知能力（d'）与判定准则（c）。受"恐惧使人风险规避"的启发，使用机制可解释性方法在情感丰富的自然场景上定位一个因果相关的情感回路，通过稀疏神经元敲除与分布式激活引导（activation steering）进行因果验证，再将该"恐惧方向"注入基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段SeisMLLM流程，观察对下游预测的影响。

Result: 基线在SeisMLLM-1K测试集上仅标记27.0%的真实不安全建筑且从不误报Red（c=+1.354），但证据质量充分（d'=1.521）。注入恐惧方向后Red召回率提升至75.7%（p<0.001）；减去同方向则完全抑制Red预测；等范数随机方向与匹配的"快乐"方向无显著效应。机制为判定准则偏移（c=-1.515），而辨别力未提升（d'=-0.493）。

Conclusion: VLM的决策行为可在推理阶段通过情感回路的激活引导进行调控而无需重训练；机制可解释性可用于诊断并控制工程应用中VLM的决策行为。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.

</details>


### [113] [DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11993)
*Yupeng Xie,Zhenyang Wang,Jiayi Zhu,Yinghao Tang,Zhouan Shen,Yiyu Chen,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DataVista，首个面向数据视频理解（Data Video Understanding）的基准，包含 961 个真实数据视频与 6,775 道评测题，构建三级递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解），含 10 类细粒度题型、覆盖 5 个主题域。对 19 个主流 MLLM 的系统评测显示最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率仅 70.0%，远低于人类专家水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据视频融合数据可视化与视频叙事，广泛应用于新闻报道与商业分析。相比通用视频理解，它更强调从动画图表中准确读取数据、跨图表与时序整合证据、以及理解叙事组织与视觉设计如何传达信息。然而现有基准或针对通用视频、或针对静态图表，数据视频理解尚未被系统评测，因此缺乏针对该任务的能力刻画与模型诊断工具。

Method: 构建 DataVista 基准：收集 961 个真实数据视频，设计 6,775 道评测问题；提出三级递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解），并细化为 10 种题型，覆盖 5 个主题域。基于该基准对 19 个主流多模态大模型（MLLM）进行系统评测，并开展帧数、字幕等设置的影响分析，以及对模型回答的失败模式分析。

Result: 最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率为 70.0%，仍显著低于人类专家表现；模型在因果推理（Causal Reasoning）与叙事结构（Narrative Structure）上表现最差。增加帧数与添加字幕主要提升数据感知与时序推理能力，对叙事理解提升有限。通过分析模型回答，识别出图表读取、证据判断与指令理解三类典型失败模式。

Conclusion: DataVista 填补了数据视频理解缺乏系统评测的空白，揭示了当前 MLLM 在叙事级理解上的明显短板。基准已开源（https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista），为该方向的能力评估与模型改进提供基础。

Abstract: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.

</details>


### [114] [Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12048)
*Yutong Xie,Jiawei Tang,Zhenglin Hua,Yuxiang Ma,Si Qin,Yaxin Hou,Hui Liu,Junhui Hou,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现模型在训练/微调早期校准更好，后期准确率提升有限但校准误差显著增大；提出EUA-Cal，将早期模型作为不确定性锚点，通过早期预测正则与原型结构正则，在图像分类和多项选择问答的八个模型上优于现有校准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络（含大语言模型）在训练或微调过程中容易过度自信。作者观察到跨模型的一致现象：早期模型校准更好，继续训练或微调仅带来边际准确率增益，却大幅增加校准误差；分析表明早期模型在预测与特征中保留了不确定性感知，而该感知随训练逐渐丢失。因此动机是避免在训练中抹除这种不确定性感知。

Method: 提出EUA-Cal（Early model as Uncertainty Anchor for Calibration）。核心是将训练早期的模型视为不确定性锚点，包含两项正则：一是早期预测正则（early prediction regularization），用于保留早期模型的预测不确定性；二是原型结构正则（prototype structure regularization），用于利用早期特征空间中反映的不确定性；二者联合缓解过度自信。

Result: 在图像分类和多项选择问答任务上，跨八种不同模型的广泛实验表明，EUA-Cal 优于当前最先进的校准方法。

Conclusion: 训练早期模型天然具备更优的校准与不确定性感知，这一性质可被显式保留并用于校准。EUA-Cal 通过锚定早期模型的不确定性，有效缓解模型过度自信，并在多任务、多模型设置下取得优于SOTA的校准表现。

Abstract: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.

</details>


### [115] [Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12060)
*Yicheng Xue,Han Wu,Jufeng Yang,Minjing Dong,Xinghao Chen,Hanting Chen,Jianyuan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ViMoD轻量框架，通过DART构建可恢复的粗细粒度视觉表示，并用TRACE根据解码历史动态选择细粒度证据，在20%视觉token预算下显著提升MLLM多步推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像产生长视觉token序列，使多模态大模型的多步推理计算开销巨大。现有一次性剪枝与聚合方法在解码前将视觉token压缩为固定上下文，但视觉证据需求会随推理展开而变化，固定压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需的全部细节。

Method: ViMoD框架包含两个组件：DART（Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens）学习内容自适应的分组与聚合容量，构建与可恢复原始Fine token相链接的紧凑Coarse表示；TRACE（Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence）融合解码历史预测后续证据需求，对活跃的Fine token组进行选择、保留或替换。所选Fine token在冻结主干中增强持久Coarse上下文，实现阶段特定证据访问而无需持续关注全部视觉token。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-4B上，20%目标视觉token预算下，ViMoD在全部八个推理基准上超越所有评测基线，平均归一化分数较最强的一次性基线提升39.0%；相对冻结主干仅增加0.0546%可训练参数。

Conclusion: 通过维护紧凑视觉上下文并保留对原始细粒度证据的动态访问，ViMoD以极低参数开销有效缓解固定压缩上下文与动态推理需求间的矛盾，验证了自适应、可恢复视觉token管理在多步多模态推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

</details>


### [116] [LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12069)
*Peijun Xu,Chuansen Nie,Yiyang He,Yinuo Bai,Jingyang Liu,Kuixiang Shao,Yuyang Jiao,Kuanhao Xia,Jiayi Zhu,Zitian Yang,Yanqi Zhang,Tianye Tan,Shuwei Di,Junyi Xu,Jingyi Yu,Jiayuan Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LIVIN：基于30个真实居住家庭数字孪生构建的空间与具身智能基准，覆盖3D检测、重建、导航与移动操作四类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有家庭仿真资源在规模、与真实世界的对应性、交互可用性之间难以兼顾，缺乏对真实家庭实际物品摆放与空间约束的忠实、可交互复现，而这些正是影响机器人运动与交互的关键。

Method: 构建30个多样化真实居住家庭的数字孪生，保留房间布局、家具配置与日常物品；采用人在回路的构建流程，包含实例识别、建筑结构重建、物体生成与摆放三阶段，每阶段中间结果均由人类对照原始观测进行审查与修正。

Result: 在LIVIN上评测3D检测、3D重建、导航和移动操作四项任务，结果表明现有方法在真实居住家庭中的密集物体摆放、遮挡、有限自由空间与受限交互区域面前仍存在明显挑战。

Conclusion: LIVIN有望推动真实家庭场景下的具身智能研究，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家庭环境。

Abstract: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

</details>


### [117] [Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12081)
*Fedor Kitashov,João Carreira,Shiry Ginosar,Dima Damen,Andrew Zisserman,Viorica Pătrăucean*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文报告了ECCV 2026第四届Perception Test挑战赛，聚焦空间智能，设四个赛道：原基准的videoQA与grounded videoQA，及基于城市尺度步行视频的两个新赛道（KilometerAudio、KilometerVision），并总结了各赛道获胜方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延续Perception Test挑战赛系列，推动空间智能与多模态视频理解研究，并通过city-scale步行视频引入新任务。

Method: 以workshop形式组织第四届挑战赛，设四个赛道；为city-scale赛道构建新基准，并汇总各赛道获胜方案。

Result: 各赛道产生获胜方案，其中包括一个在所有赛道均有参赛且表现令人满意的通用模型；city-scale赛道的获胜方案表明复杂空间与多模态推理可通过昂贵的agentic pipeline解决。

Conclusion: 复杂空间与多模态推理对独立使用的多模态模型仍具挑战，需依赖agentic pipeline等方式；通用模型展现跨赛道可行性与一定泛化能力。

Abstract: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

</details>


### [118] [DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12095)
*Wenhao Li,Xianjing Meng,Qiangchang Wang,Zhongyi Han,Yilong Yin,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DVLA-RL++，通过互补语义净化（CSP）与反事实强化学习门控（CRG）缓解少样本学习中的上下文污染，在多个基准上取得SOTA，平均较DVLA-RL提升1.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本学习方法引入文本语义以补偿视觉观测不足，但图像-文本的高一致性可能同时源于目标固有属性与偶然上下文，导致支持原型易受上下文污染。

Method: DVLA-RL++在DVLA-RL基础上扩展出两个模块：CSP从带标签支持样本生成固有描述与干扰描述，并与各支持token比较一致性，利用歧义依赖的拒绝边界进行稀疏证据分配，并以固有语义锚填补未分配质量作为视觉证据不可靠时的回退；CRG基于平衡识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励学习逐层语义融合强度，并在同一episode上独立执行参考轨迹以提供配对学习信号。

Result: 在标准、细粒度与跨域基准上达到SOTA精度，平均较DVLA-RL提升1.4%。

Conclusion: 理论分析将保留证据与锚质量同原型稳定性相关联，并给出无偏on-policy梯度估计的条件，验证了方法的有效性与理论合理性。

Abstract: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

</details>


### [119] [SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02660)
*Zhendong Mi,Pu Zhao,Ziyu Hu,Xiaodong Yu,Yanzhi Wang,Grace Li Zhang,Shaoyi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpectralCache：一种免训练的谱缓存框架，利用扩散世界模型特征中稳定的奇异子空间及可预测的奇异值演化，实现推理加速且保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式世界模型虽能高质量生成交互环境，但去噪过程中反复进行 Transformer 评估导致推理开销巨大。现有缓存方法多停留在特征或 token 层面的时间冗余利用，未深挖扩散特征的内在数学结构。

Method: 观察到相邻去噪步的世界模型特征具有高度稳定的奇异子空间、奇异值呈可预测演化规律；据此复用稳定奇异子空间，仅对低维奇异值做线性外推估计；并利用相邻全计算特征间的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放跳过部分昂贵的主干评估。

Result: 在 HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上实现 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 达 65.90，推理效率显著优于现有免训练缓存方法，同时保持生成质量。

Conclusion: 从谱结构角度切入的免训练缓存可有效消除扩散世界模型的推理冗余，在不牺牲生成质量前提下大幅提升效率，为扩散世界模型加速提供了新范式。

Abstract: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

</details>


### [120] [VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12104)
*Leigang Qu,Feng Cheng,Ziyan Yang,Bangbang Yang,Zhaoyang Huang,Wei Chow,Yicong Li,Wenjie Wang,Tat-Seng Chua,Yan Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VINCIE-NExT 统一框架，通过图像域作为中介和上下文视觉示范，把图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑，无需大规模配对视频数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，核心瓶颈在于编辑需要 (source, instruction, edited) 三元组，标注成本极高且难以大规模合成；而图像编辑已有成熟的海量配对数据。因此需要一种机制，将成熟的图像编辑能力迁移到视频，规避对大规模配对视频编辑数据的依赖。

Method: 1) 将视频编辑分解为结构化可组合子任务链（Video → Image → Image → Video），把编辑意图路由到图像域，从而在统一扩散目标下联合训练异构的图像与视频语料。2) 将模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对作为上下文视觉示范前置，充当每帧输出的空间外观蓝图。3) 提出新的位置编码，将图像示范与视频帧链接到共享空间坐标系，实现外观编辑在每个输出帧上的像素级忠实传播。4) Chain-of-Editing 将子任务链作为渐进式扩散阶段执行，提供原则性的测试时扩展能力。

Result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上的综合实验表明，在多种编辑类别上取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能；消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过图像域中介、上下文视觉示范与共享空间坐标位置编码，VINCIE-NExT 有效缓解配视频编辑数据稀缺问题，实现可扩展的联合训练与测试时计算扩展，验证了图像到视频编辑能力迁移路线的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

</details>


### [121] [ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12107)
*Ruicheng Zhang,Kaiwen Shen,Jiaqi Hou,Shuhan Yang,Junchao Huang,Kewei Zhang,Jun Zhou,Li Jiang,Shen Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ContourVLA将广义指代分割（GRES）重构为闭环视觉运动策略，用可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，通过EASS自适应调度多模态特征，并用DECT-GRPO联合优化定位与轮廓动作，在gRefCOCO上gIoU分别提升8.7/2.8/2.7点，并在RefCOCO系列全部八个划分上取得最高mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRES需同时动态平衡高层语义（识别数量可变的语言指代目标）与细粒度视觉证据（精确边界刻画），而现有级联视觉-语言架构依赖静态特征接口和单次掩码预测，限制了自适应感知与几何校正能力。

Method: 提出ContourVLA——一种视觉-语言-动作策略，将GRES建模为闭环视觉运动过程：可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，条件化多模态感知并由几何动作块更新。核心组件包括Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling（EASS），将轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件化的多层级多模态特征路由耦合；以及DECT-GRPO（Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO），在监督初始化后以实例级信用联合优化离散定位与连续轮廓动作，其奖励与信用由考虑误检与漏检的软预测-目标对应关系导出。

Result: 在gRefCOCO val、testA、testB上gIoU较最强基线分别提升8.7、2.8、2.7点；在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg全部八个划分上取得最高mIoU。

Conclusion: 将GRES转化为以轮廓为策略状态的闭环视觉运动策略，并结合演化感知特征调度与实例级信用强化学习，可显著提升广义指代分割的边界精度与跨数据集泛化性能。

Abstract: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.

</details>


### [122] [SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12402)
*Hongxing Li,Jinyue Su,Dingming Li,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpaceCast-Bench，首个诊断式评估"预测性空间推理"的基准（观测-变换-推断框架，182 场景、3862 题、16 类任务、三级难度）；21 个模型中最佳仅 58.0% 远低于人类 87.2%，并揭示 bridge view 与显式 3D 证据的关键作用，微调可将 Qwen3-VL-4B 从 34.0% 提升至 65.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准主要考察"空间感知"，即读取输入中已可见的关系；而真实世界的空间智能需要"预测性空间推理"：从观测中构建场景、预判干预带来的变化并推理不可见结果。该能力此前缺乏直接、可诊断的评测手段。

Method: 构建 SpaceCast-Bench，围绕 observe-transform-infer 框架，从 182 个真实场景生成 3,862 道题，覆盖 16 种任务类型、三个层级（静态感知、局部预测、全局预测），递进考察场景理解、空间状态更新与对未观测结果的关系推理；评测 21 个模型并做受控分析（bridge view、3D 证据 vs 生成图像/视频），并进行基于程序化生成数据的微调实验。

Result: 最强模型仅达 58.0%，人类为 87.2%；空间专用模型接近随机水平。受控分析表明 bridge view 对整合分布式观测至关重要，显式 3D 证据比生成的结果图像或视频更稳定地提升模型表现。微调使 Qwen3-VL-4B 从 34.0% 升至 65.7%，并在六个域外基准上取得宏平均提升。

Conclusion: SpaceCast-Bench 提供了对预测性空间推理的直接诊断性评测，暴露当前模型与人类间的显著差距；结果凸显多视角整合（bridge view）与显式 3D 表征的重要性，并说明程序化生成数据微调是提升该能力的有效途径。

Abstract: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

</details>


### [123] [LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12127)
*Qizhou Huo,Xuan Sun,Yongfei Guo,Zhipeng Wang,Yuanhao Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种逐场景框架，用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代邻近视角的重复渲染，通过几何warp与轻量多尺度网络的RGB残差预测实现高效视图更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视图，但小幅度相机运动下可见内容高度重叠；传统3D Gaussian Splatting对每个目标视角都重新渲染，未能利用这种图像重叠，导致重复计算开销大。仅靠几何warp无法恢复新暴露区域，且对深度误差敏感。

Method: 逐场景框架：对邻近视角以相对位姿引导复用RGB-D图像，替代重复渲染；利用深度与相对位姿做几何warp搬运源内容；用轻量多尺度网络预测RGB残差，修正伪影并推断缺失外观；并缓存源特征以减少重复计算。

Result: 在GS-render上，残差细化相比纯warp将PSNR提升约0.72 dB；在实拍与渲染场景上的评测均显示较低查询延迟。

Conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视图更新解耦，可支撑高响应的场景探索，在增强现实与虚拟现实等场景具应用潜力。

Abstract: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

</details>


### [124] [ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12403)
*Hongxing Li,Dingming Li,Yixin Li,Yong Du,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViSkill：一种"视觉原生"技能学习框架，将成功交互编码为复合视觉技能卡供VLM智能体直接调用，通过技能检索指导推理与奖励塑形、成功轨迹回流蒸馏形成闭环，在Sokoban等任务上达0.89（冷启动0.91）成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能增强智能体多以文本为中心，把空间布局与动作-状态对应关系线性化为语言，丢失关键几何结构；近期引入视觉证据的方法又把技能构建/更新与策略优化分离，二者相互促进的潜力未被充分挖掘。

Method: 提出ViSkill视觉原生技能学习框架：将成功交互编码为复合视觉技能卡，可直接被VLM智能体访问；检索到的技能同时用于引导推理与奖励塑形，成功轨迹再被蒸馏回技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进互相强化的闭环；另设可选冷启动机制加速早期学习。

Result: 在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上评测，整体成功率0.89，加入冷启动初始化后升至0.91，优于所有评估的专有与开源基线，且收敛速度快于标准PPO。

Conclusion: 视觉原生技能表示与策略优化的闭环耦合可有效提升样本效率与任务成功率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

</details>


### [125] [Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12147)
*Inês Cruchinho Garcia,Mariana Mourão,Francisco Maria Calisto,Carlos Santiago,Jacinto Nascimento*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种反事实数据增强策略，通过扩散模型在异常乳腺X线图像中"擦除"病灶并生成健康组织，以缓解CAD系统的假阴性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在乳腺癌筛查中面临严重的假阴性问题，导致检测与治疗延迟。训练数据中异常样本分布不均、健康样本不足，限制了分类器对病灶的判别能力。

Method: 在BI-RADS 1（健康）乳腺X线图像上训练去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），并采用基于RePaint的采样策略，在标注的病灶边界框内修复生成逼真的正常组织；由此得到的健康反事实样本在保留患者个体解剖结构的同时替换病灶区域。随后在四种分类器架构（ConvNeXt、ViT、基于乳腺X线-报告对预训练的视觉语言模型Mammo-CLIP、多尺度注意力多实例学习框架FPN-MIL）上评估该增强策略。

Result: 真实与生成图像之间的相似度指标支持结构保留效果；放射科医师评估认为生成图像的真实性与原始数据集质量一致。在VinDr-Mammo数据集上，所有架构的敏感度均提升，尤其在固定特异度80%时提升显著。

Conclusion: 基于扩散的反事实生成可为乳腺X线筛查CAD系统提供有效的训练数据增强，降低假阴性、提升敏感度，从而推动更可靠的乳腺癌筛查辅助诊断。

Abstract: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.

</details>


### [126] [WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12417)
*Zheyu Fan,Yue Zhang,Mingkai Deng,Kangrui Wang,Qineng Wang,Canyu Chen,Jie Hao,Xing Fan,Chenlei Guo,Eric P. Xing,Mohit Bansal,Manling Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉转变推理（visual transition reasoning）作为多模态大模型空间、具身、物理与时间推理失败的共同根源，并构建 WOVEN 训练源与基准（36,076 样本，20 场景类型、5 动作类型、8 推理类型）加以验证；发现 38 个前沿模型存在系统性缺陷，而基于 WOVEN 训练可学得可迁移的共享能力，并给出视觉世界建模的训练配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 在空间、具身、物理与时间推理上普遍失败，作者假设这些失败源于共同的"视觉转变推理"能力缺失，希望验证该能力能否作为跨模型、跨监督来源、跨任务复用的共享训练基元。现有基准仅分别记录各类缺陷，无法支持跨场景、动作与推理操作的受控比较。

Method: 构建 WOVEN 训练源与基准，按场景、动作与推理类型组织转变监督信号，使用视频预训练生成模型产出的多样真实感 rollout，共 36,076 个样例（20 场景类型、5 动作类型、8 推理类型）。先评测 38 个前沿 MLLM（如 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B）以量化缺陷；再在多个规模上基于 WOVEN 训练 MLLM，并进行受控比较以提炼训练配方。

Result: 38 个前沿模型中即便最强模型也远低于人类水平，失败跨模型族出现且随规模持续。基于 WOVEN 训练后，仅约 2,000 条的子集各自即可在 26 个外部基准中改进 22 个，最高提升 27.3 个百分点；WOVEN 数据可替代某任务自身 30–50% 训练数据而保持相当精度。受控比较给出训练配方：按监督所教的推理操作而非所展示的动作、场景或领域来选择监督；优先选择视觉状态变化更大的样本以提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 视觉转变推理是 MLLM 系统性视觉推理缺陷的共享根源，可作为可复用的训练基元，为多模态大模型的视觉世界建模提供系统化训练基础与可验证的训练配方。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

</details>


### [127] [Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12156)
*Dongbin Zhang,Chaoda Zheng,Kangjie Chen,Xiangyu Li,Shijia Chen,Jinhao Deng,Yuqi Zhang,Guangfeng Jiang,Hongbin Lin,Choo Sin Wai,Minqi Wang,Puyi Wang,Jingye Zhang,Yu Zhang,Xianming Liu,Boyang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Connected Self Forcing 训练框架，通过重新连接自回归视频生成中各分块之间的梯度路径，并结合 shortcut gradient replay 实现内存高效的跨块梯度回传，在不改变推理流程的前提下提升长视频的视觉质量与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式生成长视频需兼顾视觉质量与时间一致性。Self Forcing 通过自生成历史的 self-rollout 训练缓解曝光偏差，但为控制显存而分离（detach）历史 KV 缓存，虽保留分块间的前向依赖，却切断了反向梯度路径，导致早期上下文无法从后续预测的反馈中受益。

Method: 提出 Connected Self Forcing：重新连接各自回归分块间的梯度路径，使后续预测的反馈能指导早期上下文的生成。梯度不仅经由历史 KV 写入，还穿过生成的 latent 回传到产生它们的计算过程，将早期上下文的生成与其在后续预测中的使用联系起来。为降低显存开销，设计 shortcut gradient replay，无需保留完整 rollout 计算图即可恢复跨块梯度。结合 distribution matching distillation，使历史分块依据其直接监督信号及其对后续生成的贡献进行训练。

Result: 在自回归视频生成任务上，长时程视觉质量与时间一致性均获得提升，且推理流程无需任何改动。

Conclusion: 通过重构跨分块梯度连接并将其高效实现，Connected Self Forcing 有效利用后续预测的反馈来优化历史上下文的生成，在保持推理不变的同时改善长视频生成质量。

Abstract: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.

</details>


### [128] [FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12427)
*Yuxuan Hu,Weikang Shi,Yang Bo,Xudong Lu,Xintong Guo,Shuhan Li,Yuyang He,Huankang Guan,Peiwen Sun,Yunqiao Yang,Wenbo Li,Rui Liu,Hongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 FastBench 基准与 ProactiveFrame 基线，用于评估高动态真实视频流中的流式视频大模型感知能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频大模型基准多聚焦低动态场景，而 1–2 FPS 稀疏采样会漏掉快速事件；在有限上下文预算下，模型需在时间历史、空间分辨率与时序粒度之间权衡，缺乏针对高动态感知的评测手段。

Method: 构建轨迹驱动的数据流水线：由高帧率片段生成 QA、过滤掉 2 FPS 即可回答的问题、用 SAM3 与 CoTracker3 轨迹验证答案，并进行三轮人工检查。FastBench 含 306 组 QA，覆盖八个领域、六种能力及前向/即时/后向时序范围，并带人工标注证据区间。同时提出免训练基线 ProactiveFrame，通过文本 token 调节输入帧率，并用双层滑动窗口保留近期高帧率观测、将较旧帧降采样为稀疏历史。

Result: 最强模型 Gemini-3.5-Flash 仅得 50.7%。密集采样使 Qwen3-VL-8B 从 2 FPS 的 32.9% 提升至 24 FPS 的 44.6%，但随历史被压缩增益趋于饱和。ProactiveFrame 比稀疏均匀采样高出 5.4 与 1.5 个百分点，但仍显著低于 oracle 引导的聚焦。

Conclusion: 当前 VLM 难以仅凭视频流判断何时需要更细的时序感知；FastBench 为高动态流式视频理解提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.

</details>


### [129] [AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12182)
*Thomas Goudemant,Aurélien Bobey,Omar Hlimi,Marjorie Bellizzi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究星上舰船检测以减少下传数据量，构建数据集、在Versal VC1902 DPU上部署量化YOLOX-S，并提出多种下传模式，在港口/海岸场景实现以29%数据量保留98%舰船的折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 甚高分辨率对地观测卫星获取的数据量超过其存储与下传能力，而在海事监视中舰船只占每个场景极小部分，因此需要按内容而非逐像素选择下传数据，以缓解下传瓶颈。该工作与常规星上压缩互补。

Method: 沿三条轴线展开：(i) 数据与算法——基于68幅Maxar标注场景、43个舰船类别生成受控数据集，并训练YOLOX-S检测器；(ii) 嵌入式部署——对检测器量化后部署于Versal VC1902的DPU上；(iii) 数据削减——提出从仅元数据（检测框、类别、得分）到舰船周围裁剪、含检测的瓦片、或背景降质的整景等多种下传模式。

Result: 检测器在DPU上部署仅有有限检测质量损失，每景处理时间为数秒。依据实测检测误差估计各下传模式的折中：在密集港口与海岸场景中，瓦片模式以29%的场景数据量保留98%的舰船，裁剪模式以3%的数据量保留83%的舰船。

Conclusion: 星上舰船检测可作为内容驱动的下传选择机制，在有限质量损失与秒级处理时延下，通过瓦片/裁剪等下传模式在保留舰船与下传数据量之间取得良好折中。

Abstract: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

</details>


### [130] [Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12216)
*Olivier Rukundo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出半自动步幅无关分块（SSP）方法，通过用户或专家输入将预定义分块定位在目标对象上，并比较其与重叠（Overlap）和非重叠（Noverlap）分块在语义分割中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动分块方法依赖步幅参数，可能无法最优地覆盖感兴趣对象。作者希望探索一种步幅无关、可结合人工经验定位分块的方式，以兼顾分割性能与训练效率。

Method: 利用SSP、Overlap和Noverlap三种分块策略分别构建三个分块数据集；在每个数据集上分别训练以ResNet50、ResNet18和MobileNetV2为骨干的DeepLabV3+模型；在各自测试集和共同外部测试集上进行定量评估，比较分割指标与训练时间。

Result: SSP在三个骨干模型上于测试集普遍取得更高分割分数，并且模型训练时间最短。在外部测试集上，SSP在三种骨干下取得最高平均精确率和F1分数，而Noverlap取得最高平均召回率。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明，Overlap和Noverlap潜在更大的空间覆盖并不必然转化为更好的分割性能；SSP在分割性能与模型训练时间之间提供了更有利的平衡。

Abstract: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.

</details>


### [131] [VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12229)
*Jinjing Zhao,Fangyun Wei,Yitong Wang,Xiuyu Wu,Yunuo Chen,Yang Yue,Sirui Zhang,Wenbo Wang,Hongyang Zhang,Dong Chen,Yan Lu,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出画布指令式图像编辑界面 VibeEdit：用户在原图上添加空间标记与短注释，无需单独文本提示即可完成增删替换、属性修改与移动等编辑；基于 Qwen-Image-Edit 引入层解耦条件编码，经区域加权 SFT 与评分引导强化学习训练，在 419 例人工基准上 VLM 评分 79.9、区域外 PSNR 32.8 dB，显著优于最佳文本指令基线 FireRed（67.4、24.0 dB）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本引导图像编辑中，描述目标改动通常容易，但当多个物体外观相似时，准确指明目标物体或区域十分困难；纯文本提示缺乏空间定位能力，易导致编辑对象误选。

Method: 1) 新界面：用户在图像上直接放置空间标记（spatial marks）并可选添加短注释，二者构成 canvas instruction，同时指定"改哪里"与"改什么"，无需额外文本提示；2) 数据：构建 155 万组源—目标编辑对，含物体掩码与结构化编辑描述，训练时将描述渲染为画布指令；3) 模型：以 Qwen-Image-Edit 为基座，采用层解耦条件（layer-decoupled conditioning）分别编码源图像与画布指令；4) 训练：区域加权监督微调（region-weighted SFT），再用评分准则引导的强化学习（rubric-guided RL）优化编辑完成度、局部编辑质量与未编辑区域保持。

Result: 在独立构建的 419 例人工标注基准（侧重相似物体间的目标选择）上，VibeEdit 达到 VLM 评分 79.9、区域外 PSNR 32.8 dB；对比评估中得分最高的文本指令基线 FireRed 为 67.4 与 24.0 dB，VibeEdit 在两个指标上均大幅领先。

Conclusion: 将空间标记与短注释统一为画布指令，可有效解决相似物体场景下的目标选择歧义，实现免文本提示的多类型编辑；层解耦条件编码结合区域加权 SFT 与评分引导 RL，在编辑完成度、局部质量与未编辑区域保持上均取得明显提升。

Abstract: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.

</details>


### [132] [From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12230)
*Yitong Wang,Fangyun Wei,Jinjing Zhao,Sirui Zhang,Hongyang Zhang,Dong Chen,Bo Dai,Yan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial Canvas Interface 与 Compo 模型，将海报生成从一维文本提示转为二维空间"编排"，支持语义、身份、文本、像素四类绑定及文本规格，兼具直接推理与代理模式，并在新基准上验证其组成可控性优于通用与专用系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本提示本质上是一维序列接口，用户被迫将海报固有的二维构图意图压缩为词序列，导致空间布局与元素关系难以精确表达，生成意图指定与视觉生成耦合在一起，可控性受限。

Method: 1) 提出 Spatial Canvas Interface，用户直接在空间中编排生成意图，包含四种互补绑定类型：semantic（语义）、identity（身份）、text（文本）、pixel（像素），并配合针对单个元素的 Text Specifications 与全局外观描述。2) 基于该接口构建 Compo：由预训练图像编辑模型适配而来，理解 Spatial Canvas 输入与 Text Specifications。3) 支持两种使用方式：直接推理（用户显式构建画布）与代理模式（高层请求自动翻译为规划好的 Spatial Canvas）。4) 训练上设计可扩展数据管线，自动构建不同绑定类型及其组合的监督数据，无需从零训练专用海报生成器即可高效适配。5) 建立基准，评估对单一绑定类型及联合组成的遵循程度。

Result: 实验表明，Compo 在保持高视觉质量的同时，组成可控性优于通用图像生成模型和专用海报生成系统；基准同时覆盖单绑定遵循与联合组成评估。

Conclusion: 通过将意图指定与视觉生成解耦，该工作把海报生成从"提示（prompting）"范式推进到"编排（composing）"范式，并借助可扩展监督数据管线实现高效适配，无需专用生成器从头训练。

Abstract: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

</details>


### [133] [Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12256)
*Youngtaek Oh,Qiyu Wu,Hiromi Wakaki,Junmo Kim,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Syn-Omni统一框架，通过正交模态专家LoRA和渐进协同路由实现结构化全模态适配，在81个任务上超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法通常依赖混合模态数据的单一共享参数空间，限制了通用表示与模态特定表示之间的结构分离。

Method: 提出OME-LoRA，将适配分解为共享LoRA路径（通用语义）与模态专家LoRA路径（模态特化）；并设计PSR，使专家先建立模态特定先验，再逐步与其他专家交互实现跨模态协同。

Result: 在涵盖图像、视频、音频和视听模态的81个多样任务上，Syn-Omni持续优于全模态基线。

Conclusion: 结构化的模态特化与跨模态渐进协同协作是有效的，验证了所提框架在全模态嵌入适配中的优越性。

Abstract: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

</details>


### [134] [DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12266)
*Jinghua Hou,Zhe Liu,Hengshuang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出动态向量解码方法DVD，将2D/3D感知输出统一为1D向量序列并映射为紧凑离散token，显著降低token开销与推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多模态大模型的感知方法多依赖文本式坐标表示，导致token开销过大；或采用固定范围量化，受范围与精度限制，尤其难以应对空间范围无界、定位精度要求高的3D场景。

Method: DVD先将多种感知表示（2D边界框、2D掩码、3D边界框）转换为1D向量序列，再映射到高维空间中的紧凑离散token；随后用轻量级去token化器（de-tokenizer）将输出token解码回原始2D/3D感知表示，实现与MLLM的无缝集成。

Result: 在RefCOCO系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes等2D与3D感知基准上，DVD在2D和3D任务中均取得优越性能，并显著降低token开销与推理延迟。

Conclusion: DVD为将感知能力集成到MLLM中提供了一个高效且通用的框架，克服了现有方法的固有局限。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

</details>


### [135] [Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12282)
*Xiyuan Zhang,Yanming Yang,Kaiyuan Xu,Ruibo Li,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Slot3R：一种免训练、集合关联式的流式 3D 重建改造方案，将"位置"仅用作寻址而非融合依据，允许同一地址共存多个状态，并在冻结 Point3R 主干的前提下显著提升精度与长序列内存可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式 3D 重建需在处理不断扩展场景的同时保留每帧证据。空间记忆按重建的 3D 位置组织历史，是自然选择。但 Point3R 将"空间邻近"同时用于新观测与既有记忆条目的关联和是否融合的判断，把"共位"与"状态同一性"混为一谈。由于指针是对图像块的摘要，邻近指针可能编码不同表面、视角或可见性条件，直接平均会在后续帧能够消歧之前破坏互补证据。

Method: Slot3R 主张位置应决定"地址"而非"是否必须融合"，并以此为指导实现免训练（training-free）的集合关联式（set-associative）改造：在共享地址上允许多个状态共存；同时保持预训练 Point3R 主干冻结。此外引入有界稀疏读出（bounded sparse readout），将持久存储与逐帧解码器访问解耦。

Result: 在 300–500 采样帧下，Slot3R 将 Point3R 的点云精度误差（Acc）在 7Scenes 上降低 57.1%–63.1%，在 NeuralRGBD 上降低 64.0%–72.0%；在三个位姿基准上均降低 Sim(3) 对齐的绝对轨迹误差（ATE），并在视频深度估计上保持竞争力。在相同协议下，600 至 1000 采样帧的全部评测设置中约 19 FPS 完成，而 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在 800 帧及以上出现内存耗尽。

Conclusion: 将空间位置的角色从"融合判据"修正为"寻址机制"，使同一位置上互补的多状态证据得以保留，从而在冻结主干、免训练的前提下同时提升重建与位姿精度，并增强长序列流式处理的可扩展性。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.

</details>


### [136] [Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12299)
*Dahyun Chung,Siyoon Jin,Hyunwook Choi,Honggyu An,Junyoung Seo,Hyunsung Kim,Seung Wook Kim,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出多智能体自我中心世界模型（ME-World），将多智能体自我中心世界建模形式化为共享世界中多个智能体通过细粒度动作交互的同步自我流生成任务，并在共享token序列中联合去噪多个自我流，从而提升共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自我中心世界模型多聚焦于单智能体，而真实具身场景常涉及多智能体在同一共享环境中行动与交互。现有多智能体世界模型依赖粗略动作（如移动、相机控制或离散指令），细粒度具身交互尚未被充分探索，同时缺乏可衡量共享世界一致性的指标。

Method: 提出ME-World，在共享token序列中联合去噪多个自我流；将每个流以所有智能体的目标视角位姿为条件；并利用共享环境记忆为生成提供基础。训练与评估使用真实及合成多智能体数据，并引入针对环境一致性、更新一致性和身份一致性的共享世界一致性指标。

Result: 实验表明，与现有方法相比，ME-World在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量方面均取得提升。

Conclusion: 该工作将多智能体自我中心世界建模形式化为同步自我流生成，并通过共享token联合去噪、全智能体位姿条件化和共享环境记忆，为多智能体细粒度交互下的世界建模提供了有效框架与一致性评估指标。

Abstract: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

</details>


### [137] [From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12305)
*Barbara Toniella Corradini,Caterina Gallegati,Ludovica Genovese,Vittorio Murino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OTTER——一种基于最优传输的轻量级监督探针，用于从冻结的多模态大模型表示中解码生成 token 对所指实例的定位信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型定位方法聚焦于"图中有什么"（如 banana），而忽略了帮助区分具体实例的描述性 token（如 yellow、left），因此需要探究冻结表示中是否包含跨生成 token 的所指实例定位信息。

Method: 提出 OTTER，即作用于冻结 MLLM 表示之上的轻量级监督探针，利用最优传输（OT）将生成 token 与视觉区域对齐，生成紧凑的定位图，覆盖属性、空间表达和关系/动作修饰词。

Result: (i) 修饰词 token 可解码出具有实例区分性的视觉信息，空间词证据最明显；(ii) 该信息不限于修饰词，语境化物体名词同样携带指代信息；(iii) 定位结果在上下文扰动下仍有信息量，所选区域与生成相关；(iv) OT 定位可泛化到自由生成与跨数据集迁移。

Conclusion: 冻结的 MLLM 表示中包含跨 token 的所指实例定位信息，且可被 OT 探针有效解码，突破以往仅关注物体名词的定位范式。

Abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.

</details>


### [138] [BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12307)
*Ozgur Kara,Yujia Chen,Daniel Watson,David Forsyth,James Matthew Rehg,Wen-Sheng Chu,Du Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BudgetPix自适应token化框架，按视觉复杂度与空间布局动态分配计算量，实现推理时的灵活计算预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型采用均匀token化，对等大图像块分配相同计算预算。该静态范式无法适应推理时的不同资源约束，且对简单背景与复杂细节投入相同算力，导致质量-成本权衡次优。

Method: 包含三个关键组件：(1) 自适应编码器，用熵引导四叉树与多尺度patch嵌入器将固定尺寸图像映射为变长token序列；(2) 尺度感知解码器，从多尺度token集合重建固定分辨率图像；(3) 灵活的训练与采样调度，使像素空间去噪器可在可变token数量下运行。可无缝集成现有像素空间扩散架构，单一checkpoint支持多种计算预算。

Result: 在文本到图像生成上，BudgetPix用25%原始算力即匹配512²的MiniT2I-L和1024²的PixelDiT的保真度。在MeanFlow骨干的类别条件生成中，仅需60%算力即可实现近乎零质量退化，FID仅增加0.8。人类与VLM评测确认其质量-效率权衡显著优于既有预算自适应基线。

Conclusion: BudgetPix通过复杂度感知的自适应token化，在单一模型中实现宽范围计算预算下的高效图像生成，显著改进质量-效率权衡。

Abstract: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

</details>


### [139] [Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12310)
*Xingwu Zhang,Duanyang Du,Huiling Zhu,Jiayue Dai,Yixiao Liu,Guozhi Liu,Zhihan Zhang,Zijun Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有多模态大模型在工业异常理解（MM-IAU）中难以兼顾检测、定位、描述与推理，且领域内训练无法弥合与人类专家的差距。作者提出空间锚定的多智能体框架 SiGMA，通过异构 MLLM 智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家分工协作，在 MMAD 基准上达到 85.2% 平均准确率，接近人类专家水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一 MLLM 在检测、定位、描述和推理等多任务上难以同时表现优异；领域内训练收效有限，训练后的专家模型在缺陷定位上最高仅 75.5%，远低于人类专家的 92.3%，甚至异常检测精度不如未训练的基座模型。不同 MLLM 能力互补，但在细粒度感知上存在共同短板，简单组合无法解决。

Method: 提出 SiGMA——一种空间锚定的多智能体框架，将任务在异构 MLLM 智能体和专用视觉缺陷专家之间分工。多模态检索器提供工业知识与正常参考样本；缺陷专家将查询—参考对比转化为校准的异常证据；无标签可靠性控制器根据任务级能力与查询级证据质量对各信息源加权。

Result: 在 MMAD 基准上达到 85.2% 平均准确率，比最强训练专家及 Gemini-2.5-Pro 高 4.0%，与人类专家差距在 1.5% 以内。使用最多 9B 参数的三个智能体也能达到 84.4%，且新 MLLM 无需重训练即可接入。

Conclusion: SiGMA 通过多智能体分工与可靠性加权有效弥补了单一 MLLM 在细粒度感知上的不足，在 MM-IAU 任务上显著缩小了与人类专家的差距，同时具备参数高效、易于扩展的优势。

Abstract: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

</details>


### [140] [Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12316)
*Amirhossein Zamani,Arianna Rampini,Bruno Roy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文聚焦动画中"夸张"原则，提出一个两阶段框架，将夸张引入现有文本到动作生成流程：训练阶段用自建夸张数据集对预训练模型做监督微调，推理阶段用基于动态运动基元（DMP）的夸张数学表述作为引导信号，无需额外训练即可引导扩散与流匹配模型生成更夸张的动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作生成模型虽能合成物理上合理的角色动作，却忽视了专业动画师赖以设计作品的动画原则。将这些原则融入生成流程，才能让角色不仅运动合理，还显得生动、富有表现力与感染力。作者据此选择"夸张"这一动画原则作为切入点，探讨如何将其整合进现代动作生成流程。

Method: 提出一个作用于现有动作生成流程两个阶段的框架。第一阶段在训练时引入夸张：用自建的夸张数据集对预训练文本到动作模型进行监督微调。第二阶段在推理时运作：一是提出基于动态运动基元（DMP）的夸张数学表述；二是将该表述作为夸张引导信号，在不额外训练的情况下，引导现有的扩散与流匹配文本到动作生成模型趋向夸张动作。

Result: 通过与三个强动作生成模型的定性与定量评估对比，所提方法能够生成更夸张、更具表现力的动作，同时保持中性参考动作的意图与物理合理性。

Conclusion: 将"夸张"这一动画原则系统性地融入动作生成流程是可行且有效的：训练阶段的微调与推理阶段的DMP引导相结合，可在维持动作意图与物理合理性的前提下提升动作的夸张度与表现力，为面向角色动画社区的动作生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.

</details>


### [141] [RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12333)
*Ruixiang Ouyang,Guanren Qiao,Fansen Meng,Yueci Deng,Ruixing Jin,Kui Jia,Guiliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RiCo，用稀疏接触面点邻域表示刚体交互，实现高效高精度的刚体动力学接触推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚体交互的准确模拟对预测性物理世界模型至关重要，但现有方法难以刻画局部表面接触如何影响物体运动。端到端世界模型对整场景或整物体做预测，而刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近表面才能直接传递接触力。

Method: RiCo将物体间交互表示为接触表面点的稀疏邻域：对每个点，结合其自身状态与邻近表面的相对几何、运动及物理属性；再在物体内部各点之间进行推理，以判断这些局部接触如何共同影响物体运动。跨物体推理被限制在邻近表面，接触信息则在刚体内部传播。

Result: 在MOVi基准上，相比基线，100帧位置误差降低31–35%，朝向误差降低约38%；接触保真度高，相对真值的穿透时间差为11.0%，平均穿透深度差为2.22 mm。可从小规模训练场景零样本泛化到含270个物体的场景。真实世界多球碰撞实验初步显示了sim-to-real迁移能力。

Conclusion: 将跨物体推理限定于邻近表面、并在刚体内传播接触信息，可在不建模所有场景点对的前提下保留细粒度交互细节，从而提升精度与接触保真度，并具备零样本泛化与初步的sim-to-real迁移能力。

Abstract: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [142] [ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12337)
*Jialei He,Enhe Liu,Sifan Song,Pengfei Jin,Jionglong Su,Hongbin Wang,Zhixiang Lu,Yanhao Huang,Anteng Cai,Zhengyong Jiang,Jiaman Ding,S. Kevin Zhou,Jinfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV
