TL;DR: 提出ContiLNN，用双向闭式连续时间模块进行跨切片建模，在CT去噪、MRI超分和低计数PET恢复上超过Restore-RWKV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像恢复可利用解剖连续性，但需同时处理局部解剖与切片采样变化，现有2D骨干缺乏有效的跨切片建模手段。

Method: 在2D恢复骨干上增加双向闭式连续时间（Bi-CfC）模块做跨切片建模，保留面内特征提取；用切片索引间隔调制由局部特征与隐状态决定的门控，实现无需数值ODE积分、可适应采样变化的传播；引入参考引导一致性对齐一阶与二阶跨切片强度差，并用冻结骨干蒸馏保持面内保真度。

Result: 五个训练种子下，较Restore-RWKV的均值PSNR分别提升0.1907 dB（CT去噪）、1.0176 dB（MRI超分）、1.2482 dB（低计数PET恢复），三项任务RMSE均更低；CT结果为单例留出患者的描述性结果；PET消融支持有序传播优于单纯逐点容量；连续训练下Bi-CfC在相同参数与算力下优于Bi-GRU；七切片配置下延迟低52.8%、峰值GPU显存低57.0%；混合间隔训练改善稀疏与不规则上下文表现但指标排序不统一；更少患者与第二骨干实验支持数据效率与骨干兼容性。

Conclusion: ContiLNN以闭式连续时间跨切片建模有效提升医学图像恢复性能，兼具效率、数据效率与骨干兼容性，但部分结论受限于单例评估与指标不一致性。

Abstract: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

</details>


### [143] [Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12343)
*Xue Yang,Peiyuan Zhang,Yilun Zhu,Qihao Yang,Mingxin Liu,Xiangyu Zhao,Ziqian Fan,Zhaokai Wang,Yan Li,Yifan Yang,Xu Yang,Xiaosong Jia,Yue Zhou,Zhihang Zhong,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出RISEBench++，首个面向推理驱动视觉编辑（RISE）的综合细粒度基准，并开发免训练智能体框架RISE-Agent，评测58种编辑方法，最强模型仅达56.6%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型多模态模型在视觉理解与生成上进展显著，但在视觉编辑中仍面临三大挑战：遵循复杂指令、保持外观一致性、支持灵活输入格式。现有工作缺乏专门针对“推理驱动视觉编辑”的系统性评测基准，无法衡量模型在复杂推理条件下的编辑能力，因此需要构建覆盖多推理维度、多输入格式、多任务的基准以揭示模型局限。

Method: 1）构建RISEBench并扩展为RISEBench++：分类体系为层次化方案，涵盖时间、因果、空间、逻辑、反事实推理及跨多轮编辑的混合推理六大维度，细分为12个子类、65种细粒度任务类型；2）扩展输入格式，支持多图条件；3）规模达1000个人工标注测试用例，发布中英双语版本；4）评估框架从指令推理、外观一致性、视觉合理性三方面，采用人类评判与LMM-as-a-judge结合，提升可靠性与校准度；5）提出RISE-Agent，免训练智能体框架，融合推理驱动规划、工具增强执行与验证器引导精炼。

Result: 评测58种视觉编辑方法，含34个开源模型、19个闭源模型和5种智能体方法。结果显示推理驱动视觉编辑仍存在显著挑战，即使最强的GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst也仅达56.6%准确率；RISE-Agent在多种RISE任务上优于大多数强基线方法。

Conclusion: RISEBench++揭示了当前编辑模型在推理感知视觉编辑方面的能力局限，提供了系统性洞见，并指明了未来研究方向。

Abstract: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.

</details>


### [144] [Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12355)
*Hongxing Li,Yixin Li,Dingming Li,Zixuan Wang,Yuchen Yan,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GPD（Geometry-Privileged Distillation），将3D几何证据作为特权信息引入on-policy自蒸馏，在训练中用深度、语义与BEV文本线索辅助教师模型，仅对错误轨迹施加特权KL损失，部署模型保持纯RGB输入，在多个空间推理基准上超越GRPO与答案特权OPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在空间推理上存在持续短板，根源在于RGB输入无法直接提供几何证据，导致深度、方向等感知判断出错。现有方法要么在推理阶段注入3D信息带来架构与延迟开销，要么仅用结果奖励监督最终答案，无法纠正源于感知的错误。而空间训练语料的3D扫描源本身已包含真实几何信息，未被充分利用。

Method: 提出GPD，将几何证据作为on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）中的特权信息。对每个问题，将深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索渲染为紧凑文本，与参考答案一同路由给教师模型；对错误轨迹施加特权KL散度，以增强GRPO训练，部署时模型仅依赖RGB输入。采用问题条件化路由而非全上下文注入。

Result: 在4B骨干模型上，GPD在VSI-Bench取得57.1，在MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench和ViewSpatial上平均37.6，优于GRPO和答案特权OPSD。消融实验证实3D特权与答案特权的互补性、问题条件化路由优于全上下文注入，以及将蒸馏限制于错误轨迹的增益。

Conclusion: 将场景真实几何作为特权信息引入on-policy自蒸馏，可有效缓解VLM空间推理中源于感知的错误，且部署模型保持RGB-only，无额外推理开销。3D与答案特权互补，问题条件化路由及仅对错误轨迹蒸馏均为有效设计。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

</details>


### [145] [AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12374)
*Jiawei Chi,Shangchen Miao,Zhiyuan Shi,Kailu Wu,Hanyang Wang,Weiliang Chen,Qiyu Dai,Jinshan Ren,Jun Gao,Mingsheng Long,Yueqi Duan,Jiangran Lyu,Jialong Wu,Fangfu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AgentGarten 框架，将仿真/游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器耦合以构建实时交互环境，并让智能体通过经验蒸馏为 playbook 持续进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体通过探索与交互学习，其学习上限受环境所限：环境需具备忠实性（状态、规则、动力学一致）与真实性（观测符合真实视觉分布）。同时满足这两点并覆盖多样世界仍是瓶颈。

Method: 框架层面：仿真后端维护持久世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则；渲染器通过统一接口从结构化条件生成视觉观测，实现仿真器与游戏引擎同神经渲染器的耦合。渲染器层面：将预训练视频模型适配到几何条件，用 Adversarial Forcing 蒸馏，并针对实时交互优化推理。Adversarial Forcing 通过精确回放使历史预填充可微，使后续预测的损失能更新渲染器对先前观测的编码，并加入真实数据对抗监督提升视觉质量。智能体层面：以视觉观测感知世界、实时交互，并将每轮经验蒸馏为 playbook 供后续智能体继承与改进。

Result: 学习效率显著提升：智能体仅需 4 轮即可学习，而传统强化学习对照需数百万轮。新世界可以代码形式编写并通过同一接口渲染，环境数量与难度可与智能体协同扩展。

Conclusion: AgentGarten 同时兼顾环境的忠实性与真实性，支持实时交互与经验继承，使环境与智能体共同规模化演进，迈向通过交互经验持续进化的智能体。

Abstract: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.

</details>


### [146] [WorldAlign: Decoupled 4D Reward for World-Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12382)
*Jing He,Kaixin Ding,Xingye Tian,Guibao Shen,Wenhang Ge,Xin Tao,Pengfei Wan,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldAlign：一种解耦的4D奖励框架，将静态区域与动态主体分开评估，分别对齐几何世界先验与VLM世界先验，在不抑制运动的前提下同时提升生成视频的静态与动态一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 忠实的视觉世界模拟要求生成视频保持4D世界一致性（静态+动态）。现有几何感知后训练方法多依赖静态场景假设；即便处理动态场景，也难提供可靠的静态一致性反馈，且动态一致性常被忽视或评估不足。

Method: WorldAlign在语义上分离静态区域与动态主体并分别对齐适配的世界先验：静态区域通过语义引导的掩码重投影对齐几何世界先验，提升静态一致性评估可靠性，并辅以相机运动奖励以抑制近静态解；动态主体使用强VLM作为动态世界先验，构建基于样本定制清单的VLM-as-a-judge奖励，评估动态性、物理合理性、形状与纹理一致性。该解耦设计支持无需人类偏好标注的在线后训练。

Result: 在Wan2.1与Wan2.2两个预训练图像到视频生成器上，WorldAlign较现有方法同时提升静态与动态一致性，且未抑制整体运动或主体运动。

Conclusion: 结果支持采用解耦的世界先验对齐来实现更忠实的视觉世界模拟。

Abstract: Faithful visual world simulation requires generated videos to maintain 4D world consistency, encompassing both static and dynamic consistency. Static consistency requires coherent 3D structure in static environments across viewpoints, while dynamic consistency requires plausible subject motion and consistent appearance over time. Geometry-aware post-training offers a promising way to improve world consistency. However, existing methods often rely on a static-scene assumption. Even those that accommodate dynamic scenes struggle to provide reliable static-consistency feedback, while dynamic consistency is often overlooked or inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldAlign, a decoupled 4D reward framework that semantically separates static regions and dynamic subjects and provides feedback by aligning each with a world prior suited to its assumptions. For static regions, WorldAlign aligns static geometry with a geometric world prior through semantically guided masked reprojection, enabling more reliable static-consistency evaluation; an auxiliary camera-motion reward discourages nearly static solutions. For dynamic subjects, WorldAlign uses a strong vision-language model (VLM) as a dynamic world prior and constructs a VLM-as-a-judge reward based on sample-specific checklists that assess dynamicity, physical plausibility, shape, and texture consistency. This decoupled design enables more effective online post-training without requiring human preference annotations. Across two pretrained image-to-video generators, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, WorldAlign jointly improves static and dynamic consistency over existing methods without suppressing overall or subject motion. These results support decoupled world-prior alignment for more faithful visual world simulation. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/.

</details>


### [147] [GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12388)
*Stefano Esposito,Naama Pearl,Polina Karpikova,Samuel Rota Bulò,Lorenzo Porzi,Peter Kontschieder,Andreas Geiger,Jonathon Luiten*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenIA：一种测试时输入对齐的生成框架，将SAM3D生成先验锚定于几何与光度观测，无需重训练即可提升单目/稀疏多视图/动态输入的位姿与物体重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单目或稀疏多视图观测重建完整3D物体资产仍具挑战。生成式3D基础模型（如SAM3D）虽能补全观测视角之外的几何，但其预测未必忠实还原观测到的几何、外观与位姿，即生成先验与输入观测之间存在不一致。

Method: 提出GenIA，测试时输入对齐生成框架，在不重训练基础模型的前提下将SAM3D生成先验锚定于几何与光度观测：1）物体位姿方面，由几何推导平移与尺度，同时保留学习到的旋转先验；2）外观对齐采用可见性偏置注意力、跨观测融合与去噪过程中的可微渲染引导；3）可选去噪后细化，进一步适配外观隐变量、轻量解码器适配器与物体摆放；4）支持外部提供几何，当给定动态物体的时序形状时，可恢复共享、输入对齐的规范外观与稳定的世界坐标放置。

Result: 在合成与真实基准上，GenIA在单目、多视图与动态输入下均改进了位姿预测与物体重建，性能优于近期基于优化、逐帧图像到3D以及视频到4D的方法。

Conclusion: GenIA通过测试时输入对齐，有效弥合生成先验与观测间的差距，统一支持单目、多视图与动态物体的重建与位姿估计，并公开了项目页面。

Abstract: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.

</details>


### [148] [SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12399)
*Neil De La Fuente,Joan Lafuente,Mukhammadali Sayfiddinov,Felicia Scharitzer,Marc Pollefeys,Ata Celen,Sayan Deb Sarkar,Elisabetta Fedele*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpaceFlow 是一个免训练的文本到3D生成流水线，通过将几何基元作为物体部件的代理并赋予局部控制等级，实现对生成结构的局部几何约束与外观的局部路由，从而在保持高控制区域几何忠实度的同时允许低控制区域自由变形，并提升文本提示忠实度与颜色/材质准确度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成方法缺乏显式的局部控制：几何遵循度通常由全局控制强度决定，外观也无法在局部指定。因此需要一种能对物体不同部件分别设定几何约束与外观条件的生成方案。

Method: 提出SpaceFlow免训练流水线：输入文本描述与一组几何基元，每个基元代表一个物体部件并分配局部控制等级，用户可指定该区域严格遵循输入形状或允许生成式补全。结构生成阶段，在生成式流过程中施加这些空间约束；外观合成阶段，将生成结构分割并匹配到基元，每个生成部件仅以其对应的文本或图像提示为条件，从而限制跨部件泄漏。

Result: 区域几何指标表明，SpaceFlow在高控制区域保留了指定几何，在低控制区域实现了合理的形状变化；用户研究显示其在几何保真度与生成自由度之间的平衡在整体质量上具有竞争力。在固定几何上的外观评估中，文本条件路由取得了最优的提示忠实度以及颜色/材质准确度；定性结果还展示了图像提示的局部路由效果。

Conclusion: SpaceFlow通过局部控制等级与部件级条件路由，实现了可控且高质量的局部化3D生成，兼顾几何约束与生成自由度，并在外观忠实度与准确性上达到领先水平。项目页面：SpaceFlow3D.github.io。

Abstract: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.

</details>


### [149] [WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12412)
*Ziyang Ye,Junchao Huang,Evelyn Zhang,Zhihao Xie,Ruicheng Zhang,Boyao Han,Litao Ban,Ziye Wang,Xinting Hu,Shaoshuai Shi,Zhuotao Tian,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldCast 是一种分布式多人世界模型，每个玩家运行包含视频生成器与状态模型的本地客户端，通过交换玩家状态与场景状态实现可扩展、实时的多人视图生成，无需中心化计算瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人世界模型需要生成独立控制且表示一致的玩家视图与共享环境。现有方法多采用联合多视图生成来协调多玩家，但其计算成本随玩家数量增加而增长，难以扩展。

Method: 提出分布式架构 WorldCast：每个玩家运行本地客户端，含视频生成器与状态模型。训练时利用记录的玩家位置与地图几何，状态模型从生成视频和控制输入估计玩家位置。客户端交换玩家状态，并将其投影为相机对齐的玩家状态场（camera-aligned player state field），以指导其他玩家的渲染位置与方式；共享场景状态使客户端复用彼此的生成观测，以在不同视图间保持场景外观一致。客户端仅交换玩家与场景状态。

Result: 在 Counter-Strike 2 上的实验表明 WorldCast 具备一致性、实时性和分布式可扩展性。相机对齐玩家状态场将玩家渲染率相比联合生成方法提升一个数量级以上；共享场景状态在整回合中提升视觉一致性。每个客户端实时运行，图像质量在长达一小时的 rollout 中保持稳定。

Conclusion: WorldCast 通过分布式客户端与状态交换，实现了无中心化瓶颈的可扩展多人世界生成，兼顾实时性能、渲染效率与长时视觉一致性。

Abstract: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

</details>


### [150] [MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12416)
*Mingyuan Lei,Yoonchang Sung,Tat-Jen Cham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAMHOI提出一种基于可供性(affordance)中介的分解式框架，将场景感知的人-物交互(HOI)生成拆解为"场景理解"与"运动合成"两个阶段，无需成对的人-物-场景数据即可训练，在复杂室内场景中生成更真实、物理可行的交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂3D场景中生成真实的人-物交互需要两种互补能力：环境中的交互可行性推理与真实的人-物运动合成。然而大规模联合监督数据稀缺：人-场景数据集提供环境感知运动信息，人-物数据集刻画交互动态，但配对的人-物-场景数据极为匮乏，导致两种能力难以联合学习。

Method: 提出MAMHOI，一种可供性中介的分解式建模(affordance-mediated factorization)。核心是构建显式的"运动-可供性(motion-affordance)接口"作为场景理解与运动合成之间的中间表示：先由场景条件模型预测交互在何处、以何种方式可行执行(可供性预测)；再由可供性条件化的HOI模型生成对应的人-物运动。该分解使场景理解与交互动态可分别从互补的监督来源中学习，无需成对的人-物-场景数据。

Result: 在复杂室内环境中的实验表明，MAMHOI在降低物体-场景穿插(object-scene penetration)的同时，更好地保持了人-物交互质量，生成结果更真实且物理可行。

Conclusion: 通过显式的运动-可供性接口解耦场景理解与运动合成，MAMHOI有效缓解了配对监督缺失的问题，实现了场景感知HOI生成的可行性与真实性的平衡。项目页面：https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

Abstract: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

</details>


### [151] [OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12419)
*Hongyu Li,Manyuan Zhang,Kaituo Feng,Shu Chen,Dian Zheng,Hao Li,Hao Yu,Zhangquan Chen,Zoey Guo,Ray Zhang,Shaofei Huang,Tianrui Hui,Linjiang Huang,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一智能体 OneSearch-VL，以视觉锚定证据图（VGEG）为核心，将定位、检索与事实组合的依赖编码为共享任务级引用，用于数据构建、过程监督与操作级评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图、多图与视频深度研究需不同的视觉操作，但共享视觉锚定、外部检索、事实组合的工作流；核心挑战在于保持局部视觉锚点、实体关系、来源支撑事实与答案生成操作之间的依赖关系。

Method: 构建 VGEG（视觉锚定证据图）作为统一表示；基于 VGEG 的数据引擎构建并验证多图与视频问题、过滤专家轨迹，形成 SFT 数据 OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K 与 RL 数据 OneSearch-VL-RL-10K；从 VGEG 标注推导证据感知视觉锚定评分奖励（EVGR）用于强化学习；并构建 OneSearch-MI-Bench 与 OneSearch-Video-Bench 进行细粒度评估。

Result: OneSearch-VL-8B 相比具备工具访问能力的 Qwen3-VL-8B，在两个新基准上分别提升 20.2 与 17.6 个百分点，并在 7 个图像基准与 VideoDR 上取得显著增益。

Conclusion: 以 VGEG 为中心的 OneSearch-VL 统一了单图、多图与视频深度研究的任务表示、训练监督与评估流程，验证了证据图结构对视觉锚定与证据可追溯性的有效性。

Abstract: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

</details>


### [152] [Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12421)
*Luping Liu,Bingyi Kang,Yifan Wang,Dong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FreeMatching，一个可泛化的密集对应匹配框架，专为图像编辑与参考引导生成（IEG）中"视觉身份保持但物理连续性破坏"的变换场景设计，实验证明其在IEG挑战性图像对上显著提升匹配质量，同时保持经典基准的竞争力，并可作为一种评估身份保持的定量指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统密集对应匹配受限于简化时空先验（如平滑运动与刚性几何），这些假设在图像编辑与参考引导生成（IEG）中失效，因为此类变换可能保持视觉身份却破坏物理连续性。因此需要建立跨此类变换的身份保持对应关系。

Method: FreeMatching结合生成式与语义基础表示，并采用来自经典数据集、跟踪视频与合成场景的异构监督；同时引入教师引导的迭代精炼机制，使得在IEG场景下无需密集对应标注即可提升匹配质量。

Result: 单一FreeMatching模型在具有挑战性的IEG图像对上大幅提升对应质量，同时在经典基准上保持有竞争力的表现；此外，模型可作为评估身份保持的定量指标，其得分与人类判断具有相关性。

Conclusion: FreeMatching突破了传统时空先验的桎梏，为IEG场景下的身份保持对应建立了可泛化框架，并拓展了密集匹配在身份保持评价中的指标化应用。代码已开源。

Abstract: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.

</details>


### [153] [Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12423)
*Siyu Chen,Zehan Wang,Jiayang Xu,Yihan Wu,Jialei Wang,Junming Chen,Ziang Zhang,Yutong Ying,Zhou Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Pumpire，一个统一基准，直接评估图像与视频级3D基础模型重建几何的点对点距离估计能力，并构建pumpire-6k数据集（100场景、每场景64帧、共6400帧，含物理测量的点对距离标注），在29种基线配置上开展评测与分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往评测通常将深度与相机内参分开评估，或用几何相似度指标评价点云，无法直接反映模型的点对点距离估计能力；同时，重建3D空间中的物理尺度感知这一更基础能力长期被现有评测协议忽视。

Method: 构建大规模多样化数据集pumpire-6k：100个真实场景，每场景含64帧、共6400帧，并标注物理测量的点对距离；基于重建几何直接计算点对点距离，建立覆盖图像级与视频级3D基础模型（含/不含深度先验）的统一评测协议，支持点对距离误差评估与跨设置比较；对29种代表性3D基础模型的基线配置进行广泛实验与全面分析。

Result: 在29种基线配置上完成广泛实验，得到可跨设置比较的点对距离误差结果，并对各代表性3D基础模型的重建与距离估计表现进行了全面分析。

Conclusion: Pumpire提供了直接评估3D基础模型点对点距离估计能力的统一基准与协议，弥补了以往评测在物理尺度感知方面的不足；项目页面为https://pumpire.github.io/。

Abstract: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

</details>


### [154] [LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12442)
*Suhwan Cho,Yonwoo Choi,Soongjin Kim,Jicheol Park,Taegyu Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种免显式提升（lifting-free）的自中心视频生成方法：用LVSM风格Transformer直接合成自中心视图作为扩散模型条件，以概率性映射优先保证结构对齐，并利用对应分布置信度进行掩码与引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单一外中心（exocentric）视频生成自中心（egocentric）视频是极具挑战的新视角合成问题：两相机重叠区域小、目标视图大量区域未被观测。现有SOTA采用显式重建（估计深度→点云→重投影），其确定性映射将像素指派到唯一重投影位置，虽保留纹理却把深度误差放大为内容错位，因此需要重新思考"扩散模型究竟应该接收什么样的条件"。

Method: 提出免提升方案：微调LVSM风格Transformer作为学习式视图合成器，不经深度、点云或重投影，直接在内部解决跨视角对应关系，渲染自中心视图。该合成器采用概率映射，按学到的对应分布将每个区域在候选源位置上加权平均。此分布的集中度提供逐区域置信度，用于（1）掩蔽低置信区域，（2）在去噪早期布局形成阶段引导生成器聚焦高置信区域。

Result: 方法持续优于现有SOTA显式流程，并可无需重新训练泛化到其他数据集。

Conclusion: 条件与生成器应优势互补：概率性视图合成器提供结构（以纹理锐度为代价），扩散模型凭借去噪训练恢复细节。故有效条件应优先结构对齐而非锐度——合成器供结构，扩散模型供细节。

Abstract: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution's concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.

</details>


### [155] [One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12448)
*Adrian Bulat,Yassine Ouali,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: reViT用单个循环Transformer块配合归一化深度坐标编程的专家凸组合FFN，在同等推理FLOPs下匹配全深度视觉编码器精度，无需中间特征蒸馏，并支持弹性深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环复用单个Transformer块可大幅压缩参数，但权重共享会抹平各深度的特定变换，导致精度落后于全深度编码器；已有方案多依赖中间特征蒸馏来弥补，成本高且受限。

Method: 将每次循环深度的FFN表示为小型共享专家库的凸组合，由连续归一化深度坐标编程该混合，形成FFN参数空间中可重采样的轨迹。在ImageNet-1k有监督训练与DINOv2教师蒸馏两种设定下评估，并对比权重空间合并、token分派、输出混合三类MoE；支持弹性深度训练与固定深度稠密化部署。

Result: 在匹配单FFN预算下，权重空间合并为最强MoE方案。reViT-B/16从零训练达到DeiT III精度且存储参数减少约70%；8专家模型仅用教师输出特征蒸馏即保留接近全部DINOv2线性探测精度，并迁移至分类、分割与深度预测。

Conclusion: 循环单块加深度条件FFN混合可兼顾参数效率与精度；弹性深度使单一checkpoint多深度运行，固定深度时可物化为常规稠密图以去除在线路由，代价是部署存储增大。

Abstract: In this work, we show that a single Transformer block, applied recurrently, can match the accuracy of a full-depth vision encoder at comparable inference FLOPs without intermediate feature distillation. reViT restores depth-specific transformations by representing the FFN at each recurrent depth as a convex combination of a small shared expert bank. A continuous normalized-depth coordinate programs this mixture, defining a resampleable trajectory through FFN parameter space. We evaluate this design in two regimes: supervised ImageNet-1k training and distillation from a DINOv2 teacher. Across both regimes, controlled adaptations identify weight-space merging as the strongest tested MoE family at a matching one-FFN budget, ahead of the token-dispatch and output-mixture alternatives. Trained from scratch, reViT-B/16 attains DeiT III accuracy with about 70\% fewer stored parameters. An 8-experts model distilled using only the teacher's output features retains nearly all of its DINOv2 teacher's linear-probe accuracy and transfers across classification, segmentation, and depth prediction. Elastic-depth training allows one checkpoint (trained model) to operate at multiple tested depths by resampling the same normalized coordinate interval. For fixed-depth deployment, the recurrent block can be materialized as a conventional dense graph, removing online routing and merging without changing the one-FFN-per-depth compute but expanding deployment storage.

</details>


### [156] [VersaCamVLA: Camera-Configurable VLA Policies for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12451)
*Boyao Han,Chen Shi,Jingjing Qian,ZhuoTan Tian,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VersaCamVLA 提出一种相机可配置的 VLA 框架，通过解耦相机集合表征与动作学习，使机器人在部署时可适应变化的相机数量与位姿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在训练时依赖固定的相机配置，部署时若相机数量或位姿发生变化，性能会显著退化，鲁棒性不足。

Method: 学习统一的场景 token 接口，将任意可变数量的带位姿 RGB 视图映射为固定大小的潜在场景 token；通过多信号目标视图预测与腕部增强位姿采样（WAPS）实现，利用腕部相机自然运动获得免费视角多样性；部署时用轻量空间编码器将场景 token 作为补充视觉条件注入预训练基础 VLA，无需显式 3D 感知或新视角渲染。

Result: 在 RoboTwin、LIBERO 及真实机器人平台上，VersaCamVLA 一致优于已有 VLA 方法与直接多视图基线，并在不同相机数量和未见相机位姿下保持稳健性能。

Conclusion: 通过解耦相机表征与动作学习，VersaCamVLA 有效提升了 VLA 模型对相机配置变化的泛化能力，为相机可配置的机器人操作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose VersaCamVLA, a camera-configurable framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning. VersaCamVLA learns a unified scene-token interface that maps an arbitrary, variable set of posed RGB views into fixed-size latent scene tokens. This is achieved via multi-signal target-view prediction and Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling (WAPS), which leverages natural wrist-camera motion for free pose diversity. At deployment, a lightweight spatial encoder injects these compact scene tokens into a pretrained base VLA as a supplementary visual condition, requiring no explicit 3D sensing or novel-view rendering. Experiments on RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real-robot platform demonstrate that VersaCamVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA methods and direct multi-view baselines, maintaining robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen camera poses.

</details>


### [157] [OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12458)
*Zhongyu Yang,Jiale Tao,Ruitao Chen,Zuhao Yang,Yingfang Yuan,Xueliang Zhao,Auden,Kai Wang,Shuai Shao,Biao Wang,Steve Yves,Qinglin Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniCapBench，将音视频描述评测重构为深度结构化诊断框架，通过将预测目标从自由文本转为原子化、可验证的评测单元（实体引用、视觉镜头、音频事件），实现兼具覆盖率与定位性的可靠评测，并揭示前沿 MLLM 在长时程音视频推理上的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型正快速迈向连续音视频推理，亟需能暴露其能力边界的评测方法。音视频描述是理想的诊断任务，但现有基准存在耦合权衡：整段描述评分有覆盖率却无定位，局部探针有定位却无覆盖率，而无约束的 LLM 评判器又引入不稳定性。

Method: 提出 OmniCapBench，将音视频描述评测重构为深度结构化诊断框架。预测目标由自由形式文本转为原子化、可验证的评测单元集合，覆盖三条轨道：实体引用、视觉镜头与音频事件；采用确定性约束检查与局部化 LLM 语义比较相结合的方式进行可靠评分。

Result: 构建了包含 786 个密集标注视频的数据集，可有效区分 MLLM 的感知错误类型，包括时间定位失败、身份漂移、跨模态错位与幻觉性描述。对前沿 MLLM 的评测显示：其局部感知能力较强，但长时程音视频推理能力薄弱，尤其在身份漂移与跨模态错位上表现突出。

Conclusion: OmniCapBench 通过结构化、可定位且稳定的评测范式，为全模态（omnimodal）发展提供了细粒度的改进路线图，表明提升长时程音视频推理与跨模态对齐是未来关键方向。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.

</details>


### [158] [WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12459)
*Ankan Deria,Komal Kumar,Hisham Cholakkal,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将程序性视频生成重新定义为视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行，提出 WorldGuide——同时训练 Planner（预测下一原子动作或终止）与 Executor（直接生成对应视频片段）的框架，并配套发布约 59K 步级标注视频的 WorldGuide Bench，在 WorldGuide-Bench 与 VideoCraft-Bench 上均优于 MiniMax-H3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程序性任务要求生成过程能依据"已实际生成的状态"自适应决策：从当前状态判断下一动作、执行该动作并判断任务是否完成。开环生成无法适应执行结果；现有闭环系统多依赖预训练执行器或间接验证，导致"决定动作"与"真正实现动作"之间存在缺口。

Method: 提出 WorldGuide：仅需初始图像与任务目标，即预测一个原子动作、生成其对应视频片段，并利用生成结果选择下一动作或终止。Planner 与 Executor 在同一套步级程序性演示上训练——Planner 从视觉进展预测下一原子动作或任务完成，Executor 直接被训练以真实实现所预测的动作。采用分层视觉记忆在长时执行中维持状态，并将历史 token 开销控制在有界范围。为支持联合训练，构建 WorldGuide Bench：约 59K 步级标注视频，覆盖 245 个任务、27 个程序性类别。

Result: 在 WorldGuide-Bench 上取得 33.33% Task Success，高于近期强视频模型 MiniMax-H3 的 29.90%（后者还额外获得参考动作计划）；在 VideoCraft-Bench 上以仅目标条件取得 47.69%，对比 MiniMax-H3 的 32.73%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将规划与可学习的执行相耦合，对目标导向的程序性视频生成至关重要。

Abstract: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.

</details>


### [159] [OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12461)
*You-Zhe Xie,Ting-Wei Chou,Yu-Hsuan Li,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OuroWorld提出免掩码框架，将任意静态3DGS场景转为可从任意视角无缝循环播放的3D电影图（动态场景），通过VLM推断动态、视频模型生成参考视频并提升为多视图视频，配合抗不一致的周期4DGS学习不完美监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D世界模型生成的场景虽逼真可探索，但"时间冻结"缺乏动态；已有欧拉方法仅能模拟流体类运动，无法刻画一般形变、物体运动与光照变化。

Method: 1) VLM推断合理动态并引导视频模型合成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视图视频；2) 提出Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS：基于傅里叶级数的形变场在构造上保证循环性，以参考视图为锚的Grounded Drift Field吸收跨视图不一致；3) 兼容一般形变、物体运动与光照变化，无需掩码。

Result: 在39个重建与生成场景上超越所有基线，用户研究对比中胜率70.8%–99.0%；并提出无真值的评估指标，覆盖生动性、自然性、循环接缝一致性与场景质量。

Conclusion: OuroWorld实现了无掩码、任意视角无缝循环的3D电影图生成，验证了在弱监督下学习周期动态的可行性。

Abstract: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com

</details>


### [160] [What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12464)
*Jiahua Dong,Anurag Bagchi,Yash Jangir,Muhammad Zubair Irshad,Sergey Zakharov,Martial Hebert,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Yu-Xiong Wang,Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini,Pavel Tokmakov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过3万小时自我中心人类视频、超1000种场景类型与1.4万名贡献者的数据，在分布外基准上直接评估世界模型对智能体与物体交互的保真度。结果显示：数据扩大100倍可提升两者，但智能体建模接近上限，物体保真度仍低且提升缓慢；智能体收益未必来自数据，精心的视觉条件设计可在较少数据下饱和保真度，并据此测量物体保真度饱和点；随后提出将容量从场景外观转向物体动力学的监督方案，提升物体保真度但仍有明显差距，结论可迁移至下游人形建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型有望替代基于物理的模拟器，但距离实际部署仍很遥远。作者希望探究：扩大自我中心人类视频规模能把世界模型推进到何种程度，并避免依赖不透明的下游指标，直接评估智能体与物体交互的保真度。

Method: 构建/使用覆盖3万小时、1000+场景类型、1.4万贡献者的自我中心人类视频数据集；在具有挑战性的分布外基准上直接评估智能体与物体交互保真度；将训练数据扩大100倍进行对比；设计精心的视觉条件（visual conditioning）方案；提出一种监督方案，将模型容量从场景外观转向物体动力学。

Result: 训练数据扩大100倍对智能体和物体交互保真度均有提升，但不均衡：智能体建模良好，物体保真度显著更低且提升缓慢。智能体收益并非必然来自数据，精心视觉条件设计可用少部分数据使保真度饱和，从而单独测量物体保真度并发现其饱和点。监督方案提升物体保真度，但仍存在实质性差距。结论可迁移到下游人形建模。

Conclusion: 扩大自我中心数据使智能体建模接近其极限，但对其在世界中产生影响的建模仍远远落后；缩小这一差距取决于模型的训练方式，而不仅取决于数据规模。

Abstract: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.

</details>


### [161] [Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12469)
*Ritesh Thawkar,Shubham Patle,Shravan Venkatraman,Rao Muhammad Anwer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Rubric-CEPR 自进化框架，无需人工编辑对或外部奖励模型，仅用编辑器自身生成样本并通过内部表示验证，实现指令引导图像编辑器的自我提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指令引导图像编辑器进一步提升仍依赖人工编辑训练对或外部奖励模型，这类监督获取成本高，且可能奖励"貌似合理"的失败——真实感输出可能未完成所请求的编辑，或改动了本应保留的内容。因此作者希望仅借助编辑器自身的生成结果来改进预训练编辑器。

Method: Rubric-CEPR 采用自进化框架：Planner 从无标注图像提出结构化编辑指令；Editor 采样多个候选编辑；冻结的 Critic 利用编辑器已暴露的特征，通过"评分标准增强的对比式编辑-保留奖励（CEPR）"对每个候选进行分解式评分，检查编辑实现、旧状态移除与内容保留；非补偿性门控剔除不可行候选；最佳已验证候选经轻量适配器训练蒸馏回编辑器。

Result: 在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，ImgEdit 从 4.36 提升至 4.60（+5.5%），物体隔离任务提升 +24.9%，并可迁移到 GEdit-Bench 与 Complex-Edit；同一流程在 Step1X-Edit 上使 ImgEdit 提升 +7.8%。

Conclusion: Rubric-CEPR 表明仅凭编辑器自身已验证样本即可有效自我改进，为图像编辑器提供可靠基线，代码已公开。

Abstract: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

</details>


### [162] [HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11685)
*Ziying Li,Shengchu Zhao,Huiang He,Yiyang Chen,Jianwen Huang,Bailin Li,Changhao Li,Jianhui Li,Jie Li,Ruiyang Liu,Yibo Luo,Tengjiao Sun,Pei Tang,Shiwen Wang,Jiaqi Wu,Kang Wu,Kaiqiao Yang,Zherui Yang,Hu Zhang,Xuezhi Zhao,Xinhe Zheng,Yukun Li,Heliang Zheng,Rongfei Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hi3D 3.0是一个面向物体专有保真度的图像到3D生成系统，其几何模型Twinkle3D可在2048³分辨率生成水密三角网格，通过四项改进在几何保真度上超越四个商用系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到3D生成虽能产出与输入图像高度相似的物体，但难以忠实复现物体自身特性，铭文、品牌标识、重复结构等对物体身份至关重要的细节常被扭曲或丢失，因此需要提升"物体专有保真度"。

Method: Twinkle3D从四方面推进：（1）针对O-Voxel/FaithC表征收精度高但表面质量差、几何不水密的问题，在保留2048³精度前提下同时解决两者；（2）通过重新设计的DiT架构与大规模分布式训练优化，将扩散生成扩展到最多30万几何token序列，单步训练时间由约10分钟降至约10秒；（3）强化初始生成阶段的全局形状与局部细节，使单阶段模型超越以往带512³精化的两阶段流程；（4）引入细粒度图像-3D跨模态交互机制，增强视觉证据与几何token的对应关系。

Result: 采用基于轮廓和法线场的对齐指标评估几何保真度。Hi3D 3.0在所有报告指标上均优于四个商用系统，铭刻字符恢复率达82.1%、精确率98.2%，而最强竞品的召回率仅为21.7%。

Conclusion: 通过提升初始生成阶段的表示质量、模型容量与跨模态对应，可在单阶段框架下实现高保真、物体专有的图像到3D几何生成，并在关键细节恢复上显著领先现有商用系统。

Abstract: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.

</details>


### [163] [Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11907)
*Shuran Ma,JiaLe Li,Yuxin Dong,Shan Zheng,Qingyun Jiang,Xiang Chen,Qi Zhu,Deyi Ji,Yifan Yang,Jianfeng Pan,Yu Tian,Xue Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 AIMS，一种免训练的轻量框架，通过自适应协调视觉、预填充文本和生成文本三种上下文来源的贡献来缓解 LVLM 幻觉，在多个模型上有效降低物体幻觉且保持通用多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 的幻觉问题严重。现有免训练方法多通过对比解码或视觉增强，单纯提高视觉证据的相对影响。作者提出核心问题：LVLM 能否动态调节不同上下文来源的贡献以抑制幻觉？并希望量化 LVLM 在解码过程中如何协调多种上下文来源，利用这种内在行为指导幻觉缓解。

Method: 提出 AIMS（Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering），一种免训练框架。方法为：为视觉、预填充文本、生成文本三个上下文域构建紧凑原型；估计各原型与当前查询的亲和度，据此确定逐注意力头的引导权重；将得到的多源引导方向作用于查询表示，实现自适应上下文整合，无需额外训练或辅助前向传播。

Result: 发现 LVLM 存在内在的视觉关注倾向，可指导自适应视觉引导，而文本上下文也有助于幻觉缓解。大量实验跨多个 LVLM 和解码策略表明，AIMS 能有效缓解物体幻觉，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态能力。

Conclusion: LVLM 具备可被利用的内在多上下文协调行为；通过 AIMS 自适应调节视觉、文本和生成上下文的多源引导方向，可在免训练、无额外前向开销的条件下有效缓解幻觉，兼顾通用多模态性能。

Abstract: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

</details>


### [164] [Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11924)
*Jierui Lei,Wenjian Zhang,Qingyi Yang,Yuyang Hong,Fangzheng Chen,Zhengbo Zhang,Haina Tang,Shiming Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一时空预测骨干网络 MIDAPN，通过媒体通用图自适应与自动时间学习，同时覆盖"多变量"与"多模态"时间序列预测场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型依赖特定范式的关系、融合与时间模块，难以在数值型与预对齐叙事流（文本辅助）两类设置间共享同一预测骨干，因此需要探索通用化的预测架构。

Method: 设计了多媒体身份感知棱镜网络 MIDAPN：(1) 多媒体身份感知图 MIDAG，从静态本质、动态行为与潜在共性三方面重访身份，诱导跨媒体亲和关系以扩展变量依赖，并用上下文身份调制 CIM 细化判别性聚合；(2) 谱棱镜卷积 SPConv 自动进行分层时间分析，平衡粗粒度趋势与细粒度细节，并通过自适应搜索引导配置面向时间维重构的尺度高效架构。

Result: 在 13 个"多变量"与 12 个"多模态"数据集上与 16 个 SOTA 时间序列预测模型对比，并针对长上下文场景与 14 个时间序列基础模型及融合预训练语言模型进行比较，MIDAPN 均表现出一致优越性与良好的共享骨干兼容性。

Conclusion: 解耦但协同的组件共同解决了媒体身份解耦与时间尺度失配问题，验证了统一骨干在数值与多模态预测中的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [165] [Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10550)
*Tianjing Li,Wei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Diffu-LoRA，通过学习式门控低秩适配实现扩散模型个性化中的自适应秩分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从少量参考图个性化文生图扩散模型需兼顾主体身份保真与新情境提示跟随。全模型微调参数开销大，LoRA 虽减少可训练参数，但各层适配容量如何分配仍无定论。

Method: 在 Transformer 块的线性层中插入可训练低秩组件并为每个组件配置可学习门控；采用双层优化在不同数据划分上分别更新适配权重与门控参数；结合渐进剪枝移除门值最低的组件以满足预设秩预算；主干网络保持冻结，实现跨层非均匀的适配容量分配。

Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上针对 DreamBooth 及额外收集数据集的主体进行实验，整体主体保真度与提示对齐度均优于所评估的微调基线；消融研究验证了双层优化、渐进剪枝与适配器放置的贡献。

Conclusion: 学习式秩分配是扩散模型参数高效个性化的一种实用途径。

Abstract: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.

</details>


### [166] [Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10592)
*Szymon Kocur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布 Wieszcz-XIX：一个 1800–1918 年波兰语语料库，含 67.5 亿 token（约 31 亿词、294,369 篇文档），主要来自期刊，规模比同期人工标注语料大三个数量级以上；并基于该语料从头训练 47M–349M 参数的 decoder-only 模型，测量其时间边界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史波兰语虽文献丰富，但机器可读的标注形式仅约百万词，其余文本仅以质量不稳定的 OCR 形式存在。缺乏大规模、经审计的历史语料，限制了历史语料的建模与语言技术研究。

Method: 从 Wolne Lektury 与 Internet Archive 采集，构建过滤、去重、1918 年后泄漏审计、按文档切分的流水线；量化缺陷：识别损坏（对照假阳性下限）、近似重复（已剔除）、后 1918 泄漏（训练语料中已排除至已知残留 0.04%–0.38% 字节，来自转录源），使发布语料与训练语料逐文档一致。人工校正样本上计算字符错误率。在该语料上从头训练 47M–349M 参数 decoder-only 模型阶梯，测量时间边界性，并与两个现代波兰语基座模型对比。添加参数带来的增益约为再跑一遍数据的约两倍。

Result: 语料 67.5 亿 token、约 31 亿词、294,369 篇文档。可读文本字符错误率 0.68%，45% 采样段落无法校正。与两个现代波兰语基座模型（其中一个更大）相比，349M 模型出现交叉，107M 相对同尺寸对照者也出现交叉：后 1918 词汇比时代词汇多消耗约 3.1 bits/byte，对照模型无此差距；时代词汇消耗位数少于对照模型。给定时代文本时，本文模型保留其拼写，对照模型仅部分保留。

Conclusion: Wieszcz-XIX 以三个数量级规模扩展了 1800–1918 年波兰语的机器可读资源，并给出可复现的缺陷量化与训练一致性。时间边界性实验表明，历史语料专用模型在时代词汇和拼写上优于现代基座模型，参数扩展收益约为重复数据约两倍。发布语料、代码与权重。内容警示：模型会复现时代偏见，包括反犹言论。

Abstract: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.

</details>


### [167] [Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10650)
*Zihao Sheng,Pei Li,Zilin Huang,Yen-Jung Chen,Yuhao Luo,Zhengyang Wan,Steven T. Parker,David A. Noyce,Sikai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的辅助框架，用于自动化生成交通管理计划（TMP）内容，以WisDOT的WisTMP系统为应用场景，通过微调多规模开源LLM并本地部署保障数据安全，实验表明微调显著提升文本生成性能，但在策略过度生成、项目特定论证和成本估算方面仍存在挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工作区是交通基础设施中关键但危险的部分，需要精心设计的交通管理计划（TMP）来保障安全与通行能力。然而TMP的编制工作劳动密集，且高度依赖从业者的专业知识，亟需自动化手段提升效率。

Method: 提出LLM辅助的TMP内容生成框架，以WisDOT的WisTMP系统为应用背景。对多个不同规模的开源LLM进行微调并本地部署以保障数据安全；通过将历史WisTMP文档的PDF文件转换为JSON格式的结构化问答对，构建领域专用数据集以支撑模型训练。

Result: 实验结果显示，微调在标准文本生成指标上显著提升了性能。分章节和策略层面的进一步分析表明：LLM整体表现较强，但倾向于过度生成策略，且难以给出项目特定的论证和准确的成本估算；此外，模型规模从7B/8B扩展到14B带来的收益有限。

Conclusion: 这些发现表明LLM具有提升TMP编制效率的潜力，同时揭示了LLM辅助TMP开发中尚待解决的挑战。源代码和演示视频将在 https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/ 公开。

Abstract: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.

</details>


### [168] [Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10724)
*Shane Steinert-Threlkeld,Jakub Szymanik*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文主张以机器学习模型作为度量语义复杂度的"认知温度计"，为语义类型学提供比逻辑可定义性更中立的解释框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类心智如何表征语义范畴、自然语言为何偏好某些意义，是语义类型学的核心问题。既有解释依赖逻辑可定义性与复杂度，但这类度量对逻辑语言的选择高度敏感，导致部分设计选择缺乏理据。

Method: 提出用机器学习作为相对中立的语义复杂度度量方式，并综述逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂度及其语义类型学效应上趋于一致的证据。

Result: 逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂度及相应语义类型学效应上常得到收敛结论；在二者出现分歧之处，学习复杂度比逻辑复杂度更具解释力。

Conclusion: 将机器学习模型视为"认知温度计"，可形成一套统一复杂度观，桥接符号逻辑与联结主义AI。

Abstract: How does the human mind represent semantic categories? Why do natural languages favor certain meanings over others? Prior explanations have relied on logical definability and complexity, but these are highly sensitive to the choice of logical language, rendering some design choices unmotivated. In this article, we propose that machine learning provides a somewhat more agnostic approach to measuring semantic complexity. We review emerging evidence that logic and machine learning often yield converging results on relative complexity and its resulting effects in semantic typology. Where they diverge, learning appears to be a better explanation than logical complexity. We argue that treating machine learning models as ``cognitive thermometers'' enables a unified approach to complexity that bridges symbolic logic and connectionist AI.

</details>


### [169] [Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10738)
*Vinko Sabolčec,Angelos Katharopoulos,David Grangier*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种对文本进行自编码器压缩潜表示学习的方法，通过沿时间轴残差降采样/上采样及残差低维离散瓶颈，实现约2.24 bits/byte的压缩率，并具备良好的重构与下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据压缩与表示学习的交叉领域，探索学习文本的压缩潜表示，兼顾高压缩率、高质量重构以及下游任务可用性。

Method: 设计一种自编码器架构：沿时间轴对隐表示执行残差降采样与上采样，并引入残差低维离散瓶颈；对不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集进行分析；在表面层（BLEU）与语义层（基于LLM的评判）评估重构相似度，并在问答与语义文本相似度基准上评估下游性能。

Result: 在web文本数据上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损文本压缩算法相当，同时重构质量和下游任务表现良好。

Conclusion: 该压缩潜表示方法在压缩率与表示可用性之间取得较好平衡，验证了压缩与表示学习结合路径的可行性。

Abstract: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.

</details>


### [170] [Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10758)
*Mikhail L. Arbuzov,Karan Dave,Evgeniya Dontsova,Yaodong Hu,Vincent Lao,Navita Jain,Sisong Bei,Dmitry Dimov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"先澄清文本、再聚焦读者"的原则：将对话归一化为带说话人归属、来源引用和语义标签的短陈述句，使含义更显式并支持按问题筛选证据；在客服通话的优惠抑制任务上，归一化提升有监督分类器，弱提示读者同时受益于归一化与筛选，且小模型即可承担归一化、标签与决策，从而以全小模型流水线降低大规模对话分析成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业对话分析需对数百万次交互回答大量问题，每个问题都要重建人物意图、识别关键信息，导致对同一批转录反复进行高成本的解释性工作。现有流程缺乏可复用的中间表示，造成重复劳动与推理开销。

Method: 提出语句归一化：将对话转换为说话人归属的短陈述句，附带来源引用与语义标签；标签用于针对特定问题选择证据。下游模型可选用完整表示或相关子集。整体流水线由小模型构成——小模型学习归一化契约，轻量编码器负责标签与下游决策。

Result: 在客服通话的优惠抑制任务中，归一化在无筛选条件下提升了有监督分类器；较弱的提示式读者在归一化与筛选共同作用下获得更大收益。小模型能够学会归一化契约，轻量编码器可完成标签与决策。

Conclusion: 将文本准备（归一化）跨问题共享，可构建完全由小模型组成的推理流水线，在保持任务效果的同时显著降低对数百万对话进行分析的成本。

Abstract: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.

</details>


### [171] [Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10827)
*Marjan Celikik,Ana Peleteiro Ramallo,Javier Morales*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将教师模型生成的监督信号过滤、重平衡后微调 Qwen3.5 小模型，部署 0.8B 语法掌握度追踪器，在两个人工标注基准的嵌套匹配（概念/证据片段/正确性）下精度与召回均优于提示式 GPT-5.4/5.6 Sol，服务成本降低约 16 倍，线上实验带来参与度与业务指标显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纠错反馈是二语习得最有力的驱动因素之一，但课堂中的纠正很少能累积成可操作的语法掌握度视图。前沿模型的提示式方案虽可从师生对话转录中生成该视图，却在大规模场景下成本过高，因此需要低成本、可落地的替代方案。

Method: 以教师模型生成监督数据，经筛选与重平衡后微调 Qwen3.5 系列小语言模型；将标注契约内化进适配器权重，使 0.8B 模型可搭配紧凑的匹配提示而非冗长指令；最终部署 0.8B 端到端语法掌握度追踪器，并进行特征级线上实验。

Result: 在两个人工策划基准上，部署的 0.8B 模型与 4B 参考基线在概念、证据片段、正确性三级递增严格度的嵌套匹配标准下，精度和召回均超过提示式 GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.6 Sol；服务成本降低约 16 倍。线上实验显示学习者参与度提升 15.8%，排课时长提升 2.1%，新课程 GMV 提升 13.2%。

Conclusion: 通过将标注契约蒸馏进小模型适配器并用紧凑提示替代冗长指令，小模型可在语法掌握度追踪任务上超越大规模前沿模型的提示式方案，同时大幅降低服务成本并带来可观的参与度与业务收益，为平台级教育应用提供了高效可扩展的落地路径。

Abstract: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).

</details>


### [172] [Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10845)
*Sietse Schelpe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出并测试 KV 缓存记忆层 galahad-kv：将约 16,000 token 块的 KV 状态字节级保存至加密本地 NVMe，避免重复计算，在单张 H100 上经 vLLM 服务 5,000 万 token 文本验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型受限于上下文窗口，且每次收到 prompt 都需重新计算内部 KV 状态，导致长文本场景下的重复算力与能耗浪费。

Method: 使用公开包 galahad-kv，将每约 16,000 token 块的 KV 状态字节级写入加密本地 NVMe 磁盘，后续按需直接加载而不重算；在单张 NVIDIA H100 上通过 vLLM 服务 Gemma 4 12B 与 31B，处理 5,000 万 token 真实公开文本，并设计抗基准刷分漏洞的测试协议。

Result: 探测的所有块均字节级从加密存储加载且无重算（100/100，深度覆盖 0 至 5,000 万 token）；加载比重算快 2.8–4.3 倍、GPU 能耗低 8.8–12.3 倍；整个 5,000 万 token 流中 GPU 显存保持平稳；对数百万 token 前植入事实提问，12B 答对 82/100，31B 答对 98/100，均无编造答案。

Conclusion: 该方案本质是已存状态复用而非扩大注意力窗口：一次仅加载一个块，问答效果依赖模型；写入记忆为一次性开销，且需数 TB 本地 NVMe 存储。论文给出单卡可复现方案，使用公开软件与免费许可证。

Abstract: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

</details>


### [173] [Disentangling Linguistic and Paralinguistic Information with Routed Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10865)
*Beimnet Bekele Guta,Xiaoyu Yang,Guangzhi Sun,Philip C. Woodland*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出结合TopK稀疏自编码器、路由特定监督与跨因子对抗的方法，在冻结的SPEAR和WavLM语音编码器中实现语言与副语言信息的路由选择性分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督语音编码器将语言信息与副语言信息（如说话人身份、情感、韵律）纠缠在同一表示空间中，导致两类信息难以独立利用与操控，因此需要一种能够在表示层面实现因子解耦的方法。

Method: 采用TopK稀疏自编码器，并引入路由特定监督信号与跨因子对抗训练，在冻结的SPEAR和WavLM编码器上学习语言路由与副语言路由的分离表示。

Result: 独立探针显示：语言信息在语言路由中更强，说话人身份、情感、韵律等副语言因子在副语言路由中保留而在语言路由中显著减少；在LibriSpeech上学到的路由组织无需表示端重训练即可迁移到MSP-Podcast；特征空间的路由干预可传递被交换的因子，同时基本保持未改变路由所携带的信息。

Conclusion: 在多个编码器、语料库、独立探针及表示级干预下均观察到一致的、路由选择性的语言—副语言信息分离，表明该方法具有良好的泛化性与可控性。

Abstract: Self-supervised speech encoders contain linguistic and paralinguistic information in a shared, entangled representation space. We combine a TopK sparse autoencoder with route-specific supervision and cross-factor adversaries. Across frozen SPEAR and WavLM encoders, independent probes show factor-specific retention and suppression: linguistic information remains stronger in the linguistic route, while paralinguistic factors, including speaker identity, emotion, and prosody, are retained in the paralinguistic route and substantially reduced in the linguistic route. The route organisation learned on LibriSpeech persists on MSP-Podcast without representation-side retraining. Feature-space route interventions further transfer the swapped factor while largely preserving the information carried by the unchanged route. These results show consistent route-selective separation across encoders, corpora, independent probes, and representation-level interventions.

</details>


### [174] [Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10871)
*Fang Wan,Xufeng Liu,Fan Li,Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出稀疏注意力现有方法在概念上存在偏差——将注意力矩阵视为"数值集合"而忽略其作为结构化矩阵参与矩阵乘积的作用，进而提出基于矩阵近似的稀疏注意力方法MASA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的注意力计算复杂度随提示长度呈二次增长，稀疏注意力通过保留少量query-key交互来降低开销。然而现有方法仅保留注意力矩阵中的大数值或高权重区域，本质上是把注意力矩阵当作"数值集合"处理，忽略了它作为结构化矩阵通过与value向量相乘共同决定注意力输出的作用，这是一个核心的概念性错误。

Method: 作者将稀疏注意力重新表述为矩阵近似问题，并提出MASA（Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention）。MASA用闭式评分替代原始的注意力权重排序，该评分衡量每个稀疏单元对降低矩阵乘积近似误差的贡献。作为一种有理论依据的插入式修正，MASA可在不改变稀疏核与预算的情况下嵌入现有稀疏注意力框架。

Result: 在多种稀疏注意力方法、基准测试和LLM骨干模型上的大量实验显示，MASA带来一致的精度提升，验证了MASA方法及稀疏注意力的矩阵近似视角的有效性。

Conclusion: 稀疏注意力应被正确地表述为矩阵近似问题，而非简单地从注意力矩阵中挑选最大数值；MASA作为一种通用且理论支撑的修正方案，可显著提升现有稀疏注意力方法的精度。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many domains, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic cost of attention with respect to prompt length. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retaining only a small fraction of query-key interactions to approximate the full attention matrix. However, existing methods are trapped in a mathematically wrong view: they simply keep large scalar entries or high-mass regions of the attention matrix. This treats the attention matrix as a bag of values, ignoring that it is used as a structured matrix whose entries jointly determine the attention output through multiplication with value vectors. We argue that this is the core conceptual issue: sparse attention should be formulated as matrix approximation, not as blindly choosing the largest values from a bag of entries. Based on this view, we propose Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA). MASA replaces raw attention-mass ranking with a closed-form score that measures how much each sparse unit reduces matrix-product approximation error. As a theory-grounded plug-in correction, MASA can be added to existing sparse attention frameworks without changing their sparse kernels or budgets. Extensive experiments across multiple sparse attention methods, benchmarks, and LLM backbones show consistent accuracy gains, supporting both MASA and the matrix-approximation view of sparse attention.

</details>


### [175] [Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10878)
*Junnan Liu,Linhao Luo,Zhijun Chen,Qianren Mao,Thuy-Trang Vu,Gholamreza Haffari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对多轮智能体 on-policy 蒸馏中误差累积导致教师监督不可靠的问题，提出 STI-OPD 随机教师干预框架，利用师生策略差异指导干预概率，并设计重要性加权反向 KL 目标，在多项基准上超越现有 OPD 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多轮智能体任务中，学生的动作决策会影响后续观测，早期错误会跨轮次累积，使轨迹偏离教师的 rollout 分布，导致教师的 token 级监督不可靠甚至产生反效果。

Method: 提出 STI-OPD 随机教师干预框架：在多轮交互中，依据师生策略差异，用教师生成的动作用以替换学生的动作，以最大化获取可靠监督。采用随机干预策略，用 KL 散度估计策略差异并映射为干预概率，通过采样决定是否干预，自适应平衡教师控制与学生探索。针对混合策略轨迹，引入重要性加权反向 KL 目标，纠正教师生成响应与学生策略间的 token 采样不匹配，保持原 OPD 目标。

Result: 在工具集成推理和长程交互任务上，STI-OPD 在每项评测基准和每种学生规模下均优于最强的先前 OPD 基线。消融实验表明，差异引导的干预与重要性加权均对性能提升有贡献。

Conclusion: STI-OPD 通过随机教师干预与重要性加权反向 KL 目标，有效缓解多轮智能体 OPD 中的轨迹漂移与监督不可靠问题，在工具集成推理与长程交互中稳定超越现有 OPD 方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective.
