Result: 54个分词器间，某语言BPB的标准差随其模型训练数据份额下降而增大（31种训练语言上Spearman rho=-0.52，28种有词边界书写语言上rho=-0.69）。将某语言排除在分词器训练之外，会使其在所研究的所有语言上BPB升高，且该惩罚对模型训练数据较少的语言往往更大。给低资源语言更大分词器训练数据份额并非无条件有益：等权以及相对语言模型训练数据做反向份额分配，都会提高其BPB，在语言模型训练重复数据时尤为明显。与更好BPB相关的分词器内在属性因语言而异；这些属性指标可成功预测下游模型的两两BPB排名。

Conclusion: 分词器选择的重要性因语言而异，对低资源语言更为关键；不存在普适的"好分词器"，其优劣取决于语言。可先用内在指标预测BPB排名，在训练语言模型前筛选分词器候选。

Abstract: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.

</details>


### [244] [SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12207)
*Thomas Gebhart,Russell J. Funk*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SciTBERT 系列时间一致的语言模型（2013–2025 逐年截止），并以引用信息后训练得到 SciTBERT-CI，同时发布 PatRepEval 基准，用于科学—技术界面的专利文本嵌入评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向论文/专利的领域编码器虽在下游分类、回归与邻近任务上优于通用模型，但因预训练语料在时间与来源分布上不受约束，存在"前视偏差"（lookahead bias）与领域偏差，难以研究科学、技术及其界面的时间相关或档案性属性。

Method: 构建 SciTBERT：基于 BERT 的、时间一致的语言模型族，训练语料涵盖科学论文、专利与高质量教育网页文本，训练数据截止日期覆盖 2013–2025 每一年；再以论文与专利引用进行时间一致的后训练，得到 SciTBERT-CI 模型族；同时提出 PatRepEval 基准，包含科学—技术界面的专利相关文本嵌入任务。

Result: 即使受早期年份数据限制、训练数据有限，SciTBERT 系列总体仍优于此前的领域专用编码器；在涵盖论文与专利的分类、回归与检索任务中，编码器表示与下游任务领域分布的对齐至关重要，时间一致的编码器可媲美甚至超越无时间约束训练的模型。

Conclusion: 时间一致（chronologically consistent）的预训练与后训练可有效缓解前视与领域偏差，为科学计量与技术演化等时间依赖型研究提供更可靠的表示模型；表示与下游领域分布对齐是跨科学与技术任务性能的关键。

Abstract: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.

</details>


### [245] [Language Models as AI Research World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12235)
*Zijun Wang,Zewen Liu,Minhua Lin,Zhaotian Weng,Zhan Shi,Bing He,Yisi Sang,Dakuo Wang,Benoit Dumoulin,Wei Jin,Yuyin Zhou,Cihang Xie,Hanqing Lu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究将语言模型作为"研究世界模型"（RWM），用于预测研究环境中候选干预的实验结果；基于9个研究环境、2600余条实验记录（超17.1万H100 GPU小时）验证，实验经验可显著提升预测与干预排序能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI研究智能体提出实验的速度远超其在真实环境中执行实验的能力，在实验预算有限的情况下，结果预测成为维持自我改进循环的关键能力。因此需要研究语言模型能否充当预测实验结果的"研究世界模型"。

Method: 将语言模型用作Research World Model（RWM），预测候选干预在不同研究环境中的结果。评估数据集包含9个研究环境（涵盖预训练、后训练与推理）的2600多条实验记录，累计超过171,000 H100 GPU小时。实验对比有/无研究知识、跨环境迁移、多轮Autoresearch固定选择预算下的表现，并对13个语言模型做消融。

Result: 真实实验经验带来的研究知识可提升同环境未见干预的预测能力（Spearman +0.27），并可跨环境复用：仅使用OLMo3、Marin、Nanochat的预训练经验，RWM在Qwen3环境中将选择后悔降低78%（相比零经验）。在固定选择预算的多轮Autoresearch中，具备环境内与跨环境研究知识的RWM分别将最佳增益提高15.8%和11.6%。消融显示，加入研究知识对干预排序的提升可超过更换模型或增加推理计算。

Conclusion: 结果支持语言模型可作为研究世界模型，并说明积累实验数据对训练未来RWM具有重要价值。

Abstract: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

</details>


### [246] [TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12242)
*Tianyu Fu,Tengxuan Liu,Ruoxi Wang,Yixin Dong,Yi Ge,Yichen You,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TokenRouter 是一个面向 token 级路由 LLM 推理的高效、易用服务系统，通过“请求为中心的编程、模型为中心的执行”架构与延迟批处理调度器，实现解码吞吐量 2.01-64.15 倍的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: token 级路由相比会话级/查询级粗粒度路由能带来显著的效率与质量收益，但现有系统基于单 LLM 假设，在 token 级路由下存在严重的步骤不同步与频繁的批次准入延迟，且给开发者带来极高的实现复杂度。

Method: 提出 TokenRouter 服务系统，遵循“请求为中心的编程、模型为中心的执行”原则：开发者从单个请求视角描述路由逻辑，运行时为每个 LLM 启动子服务器并异步分派请求；每个子服务器采用延迟批处理调度器，其最优超参数由系统的数学吞吐模型推导得到。

Result: 在多种路由算法、工作负载与模型组合下，TokenRouter 的解码吞吐量相比现有系统提升 2.01-64.15 倍，显著推进了 token 级 LLM 路由的服务效率。代码已开源于 https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter。

Conclusion: TokenRouter 有效解决了 token 级路由推理中的系统挑战，在保证开发者易用性的同时大幅提升服务效率，为 token 级 LLM 路由的实际部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.

</details>


### [247] [EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12248)
*Heeseung Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 EgoVoice：基于第一人称连续音视频流，训练并评估能主动判断"何时说话、说什么"的自我中心语音助手框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手正走向连续真实世界交互，需在无人显式提问时通过第一人称视频与音频感知用户活动并给出及时语音指导。主动视频助手、口语对话系统与自我中心任务理解各自进展迅速，但尚无系统解决"从连续第一人称流中联合决定何时说话与说什么"这一问题。

Method: 1) 从 HoloAssist 真实人类指导员录像出发，经源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流；2) 将每段视频会话转为逐时刻决策格式：模型须判断保持沉默或给出语音指导；3) 用该数据微调一个全模态 LLM；4) 进一步用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进其主动介入行为。

Result: 在闭源与开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少能产生时机恰当且有意义的主动介入；EgoVoice 在介入时机、内容相关性与人类偏好上相较零样本主干模型均有明显提升。

Conclusion: EgoVoice 为主动式自我中心语音助手提供了可训练、可评估的框架，验证了通过数据构建、全模态微调与偏好优化来提升主动介入质量的有效性。

Abstract: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

</details>


### [248] [HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12274)
*Haolin Yang,Jipeng Zhang,Jian Xie,Shuaishuai Gong,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessSQL，一种保留完整交互结构的"执行框架原生"后训练框架，通过隔离可执行数据库环境、在目标 SQL harness 内 rollout 教师模型、验证轨迹后依次进行全序列 SFT 与执行奖励 RL，显著提升紧凑模型在复杂数据库任务上的执行准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 模型通常被训练为直接将问题映射到静态查询，但真实世界的数据库智能体是在有状态的、多轮交互中运作——检查 schema、执行探测查询、诊断错误并修正假设。由于中介这种交互的执行框架仅在推理阶段才引入，导致训练与部署之间存在严重的不匹配（train-deploy mismatch）。

Method: HarnessSQL 是一种 harness-native 的后训练框架，在监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）中均保留完整交互结构。具体做法：构建隔离的可执行数据库环境并配以隐藏的执行 oracle；在目标 SQL harness 内直接 rollout 教师模型；仅保留经执行验证的轨迹用于全序列 SFT，随后进行执行奖励驱动的 RL。

Result: 在 Spider 2.0-SQLite 上，HarnessSQL 大幅提升紧凑模型的执行准确率：Qwen3-8B 从 15.5% 提升至 45.2%，Qwen3-14B 从 22.2% 提升至 54.8%；同时有效迁移到 BIRD-Interact、LiveSQLBench 等分布外交互式基准。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，在数据库智能体的执行框架内直接进行训练，对于掌握复杂、长时程的数据库工作流至关重要。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

</details>


### [249] [VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12338)
*Neha Verma,Sungwon Kim,Kenton Murray,Kevin Duh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出对称感知的value cache合并策略，在不改变架构、不损害性能的前提下压缩KV缓存，并可与其他压缩技术组合实现更高压缩比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文下KV缓存主导显存占用，现有基于层间相似性的压缩方法需改动LLM架构且开销大。

Method: 利用value缓存的对称性，设计对称感知的value cache合并（merging）策略，压缩缓存内存；该策略可与高比率量化或key cache剪枝等现有技术正交组合。

Result: 避免性能退化与解码期架构开销；与量化或key剪枝组合可达到单一方法无法企及的压缩比，附加成本极小。

Conclusion: 揭示了value缓存中被严重低估的冗余容量，为显存受限下扩展上下文窗口提供了简单而有效的方向。

Abstract: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.

</details>


### [250] [Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12367)
*Yuhan Liu,Xiyao Ma,Zhongkai Sun,Xu Han,Chengyuan Ma,Benjamin Z. Yao,Chenlei Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出检索到的技能中多数对蒸馏无用，提出SGUID方法筛选出稳定有效的技能子集用于蒸馏，实现模型-技能协同进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作仅按语义相关性从技能库检索技能，并作为推理补丁或模型蒸馏使用，忽视每个技能的个体效用；作者发现在策略蒸馏中不足25%的检索技能能提供有效蒸馏信号，因此需要筛选技能。

Method: 提出SGUID：在训练过程中，仅当某技能能持续产生有效学习信号时保留该技能，从完整技能库中选出紧凑子集，再将其蒸馏到模型中；支持迭代式协同进化，每轮蒸馏后从更新模型的rollout中构建新候选技能库并再次筛选。

Result: 在Olmo与Qwen四个模型上，蒸馏6个精选技能在四个模型中三个的平均avg@12匹配或超过全库蒸馏；第二轮再选3个新技能后，四个模型全部达到或超过全库蒸馏，而全库规模最高达其11倍。Qwen3-8B第二轮从64.3%提升至66.3%。Qwen3-4B上无过滤技能更新会退化（HMMT25下降0.3个百分点），而SGUID第一轮提升0.5、第二轮提升1.1个百分点。

Conclusion: 并非所有技能都值得蒸馏；技能筛选是稳定模型-技能协同进化的关键机制。

Abstract: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.

</details>


### [251] [Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12376)
*Felermino D. M. A. Ali,Millicent Ochieng,Ogbemi Ekwejunor-Etchie,Ade Famoti,Jacki O'Neill,Debjit Paul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT)，将结构发现与词表构建分离，用MDL、熵边界信号和形态约束识别可复用语言单元，在104种语言上实现更低fertility和更高MorphScore，并提升多语言下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分词器多以压缩率为优化目标，而紧凑词表未必能在不同语言间均匀分配容量，导致跨语言表示质量不均衡。

Method: LCT采用语言无关方法，将结构发现与词表构建分离；利用最小描述长度(MDL)、基于熵的边界信号和形态句法约束，先识别可复用语言单元，再构建共享词表。

Result: 在104种语言、200K词表规模下，LCT相较BPE、Unigram和parity-aware BPE具有更低fertility和更高MorphScore，同时保持可比的跨语言分词成本差异；在四个多语言下游基准上，聚合分数分别提升1.48、1.83和2.00分。

Conclusion: 压缩率本身不能预测表示质量，形态驱动的结构发现以及频率在跨语言词表分配中的使用方式至关重要。

Abstract: Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.

</details>


### [252] [Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12410)
*Andy Liu,Mehar Bhatia,Karolina Stanczak,Mona Diab,Vered Shwartz,Daniel Fried*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"对齐泛化预测"任务，即预测微调模型遵循某一价值后其在其他未见过价值上的行为变化。基于66种价值的规模化分析发现，模型激活表示显著优于文本描述表示（相关系数0.45 vs 0.05），并可将该表示应用于多价值对齐目标的相似度度量与基于泛化动态的价值分类学构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练虽有对齐评估高分，但在窄行为集合上训练会影响模型在未见情境下的行为，且方式难以预料。作者希望建立能够预测对齐泛化的方法，从而更经验性地设计训练目标与模型行为。

Method: 作者定义了"对齐泛化预测"任务：预测将模型微调以遵循给定价值后，其在大量留出价值上的行为变化。构建覆盖66种价值的对齐泛化矩阵，并在此任务上基准测试多种表示技术，比较基于上下文价值激活的模型内部表示与基于价值文本描述的表示。

Result: 基于激活的表示显著优于基于描述的基线，最佳激活方法在泛化矩阵上达到0.45的相关系数，而描述基线仅为0.05。该表示还可用于度量多价值对齐目标中价值间的相似度，与模型鲁棒性显著相关，并提供了跨模型共享价值空间的初步证据。

Conclusion: 本文强调了对LLM价值泛化进行研究的必要性，并展示了其在对齐目标设计与模型行为训练实证化方面的应用潜力，包括构建首个基于经验泛化动态的价值分类学。

Abstract: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [253] [Characterizing the Narrowband Ambiguity Function of Frequency Modulated OFDM Waveforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10869)
*David A. Hague*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文刻画了采用PSK的FM-OFDM波形的频谱与模糊函数特性，用EOA模型近似主瓣结构并给出闭式表达，揭示了三点基本结论，并提出利用部分子载波导频符号抑制ACF旁瓣的波形优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向通信与感知一体化的波形设计需求，需要深入理解FM-OFDM波形（采用PSK）的频谱与模糊函数形状特性，以支撑波形参数选择与性能优化，尤其是主瓣宽度、时延-多普勒耦合及频谱效率等关键指标。

Method: 采用Ellipse of Ambiguity（EOA）模型近似FM-OFDM波形的模糊函数主瓣结构，推导描述时延与多普勒主瓣宽度及其耦合程度的精确闭式表达式；并在此基础上提出一种波形优化技术，仅使用部分子载波符号作为感知"导频"符号，以最小化波形的自相关函数（ACF）旁瓣，其余子载波保留用于通信。

Result: EOA模型给出的闭式表达式得到三点基本结论：(1) 给定调制指数h、脉冲长度T和子载波数L时，波形具有固定的RMS带宽；(2) 在相同RMS带宽下，其频谱效率约为CE-OFDM波形的两倍；(3) 对于实际波形设计参数，波形始终具有"图钉状"（Thumbtack-Like）模糊函数形状。此外，导频优化技术通过两个示例验证了ACF旁瓣抑制效果。

Conclusion: FM-OFDM（PSK）波形具备固定RMS带宽、较CE-OFDM更高的频谱效率和图钉状模糊函数等有利特性；所提基于部分子载波导频的优化方法可在保留通信能力的同时有效降低ACF旁瓣，适用于通感一体化波形设计。

Abstract: This paper characterizes the spectral and Ambiguity Function (AF) properties of Frequency Modulated Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (FM-OFDM) waveforms employing Phase-Shift Keying (PSK). The mainlobe structure of the AF is well approximated by the Ellipse of Ambiguity (EOA) model. The EOA produces exact closed-form expressions that describe the AF mainlobe width in time-delay and Doppler as well as the degree of coupling between them. These expressions yield three fundamental insights into the spectral and AF shapes of FM-OFDM waveforms employing PSK: (1) these waveforms possess a fixed Root Mean Square (RMS) bandwidth for a given modulation index $h$, pulse-length $T$, and number of sub-carriers $L$, (2) they are roughly twice as spectrally efficient as Constant Envelope OFDM (CE-OFDM) waveforms with the same RMS bandwidth, and (3) for practical waveform design parameters will always possess a ``Thumbtack-Like'' AF shape. Finally, this paper demonstrates a waveform optimization technique that minimizes the FM-OFDM waveform's Auto-Correlation Function (ACF) sidelobes using only a subset of the sub-carrier symbols as sensing ``pilot'' symbols leaving the rest for communications. This pilot optimization technique is then demonstrated via two illustrative design examples.

</details>


### [254] [Low-complexity Equalization of Zak-OTFS Via Neumann Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10872)
*Vineetha Yogesh,Saif Khan Mohammed,Sandesh Rao Mattu,Ronny Hadani,Robert Calderbank*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Zak-OTFS pulsone基、经广义离散仿射傅里叶变换(GDAFT)生成的载波波形正交基选择方法，通过选取Heisenberg-Weyl群的最大交换子群S使信道能量对角化，实现低复杂度单抽头均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为卫星通信与地面站到无人机(UAV)通信等实际信道提供低复杂度均衡方案。这两类信道在Doppler补偿后均表现为零时延零多普勒的LOS主径加一条较弱次径，且存在分数时延与分数多普勒，需寻找能与信道时延/多普勒特性对齐的载波基。

Method: 以Zak-OTFS的pulsone基为出发点，施加广义离散仿射傅里叶变换(GDAFT)得到一族正交载波基（含AFDM等6G候选调制）。该族波形的共同特点是均为离散时延-多普勒平移所构成Heisenberg-Weyl群的某最大交换子群S的公共特征向量。通过合理选择S来抑制载波间干扰；将信道建模为时延-多普勒抽头，当抽头落在S内时，每个波形仅被乘以一个复相位。

Result: 若所有信道抽头都位于所选子群S内，则信道对每个波形仅施加复相位乘性作用，单个抽头均衡器即可支撑可靠通信；LTI信道即为该框架的特例，此时S为离散时间平移群、载波波形退化为离散单音(OFDM)。一般情况下通过最大化信道能量的对角分量来选取S。该方法对分数时延和分数多普勒具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作统一了OFDM、AFDM及Zak-OTFS等波形，给出以最大化信道能量对角分量为准则的子群选择策略，为卫星及UAV通信等具有LOS主径特征的信道提供低复杂度单抽头均衡方案，并证明其对分数时延/多普勒偏移的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We describe a general method for selecting an orthonormal basis of carrier waveforms that aligns the basis with delay / Doppler characteristics of a wireless channel. We show that our method enables low-complexity equalization for two channels of practical interest. The first is satellite communication and the second is communication from a ground station to an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). After Doppler compensation both scenarios are characterized by a first line of sight (LOS) path with zero delay and zero Doppler shift, and a second weaker path. We show that our method is robust to fractional delay and Doppler shifts.
  We consider orthonormal bases of carrier waveforms that are obtained from the pulsone basis of Zak-OTFS carrier waveforms by applying a generalization of the discrete affine Fourier transform (GDAFT). This family of waveforms includes AFDM and other modulations proposed for 6G. What distinguishes these bases is that the carrier waveforms are common eigenvectors of some maximal commutative subgroup S of a Heisenberg-Weyl group of discrete delay and Doppler shifts. We describe how to choose S to mitigate the damaging effects of interference between carriers. We represent the wireless channel by delay-Doppler taps and observe that a channel tap located within S multiplies every waveform by a complex phase. If all channel taps are located within S, then the channel multiplies every waveform by a complex phase, and a single tap equalizer supports reliable communication. This is the case for a linear time-invariant (LTI) channel, where S is the group of discrete time shifts and the carrier waveforms are discrete tones (OFDM). In general, we choose the subgroup S to maximize the diagonal component of the channel energy.

</details>


### [255] [Robust Prediction of Internal Wave-Affected Multi-Scale Sound Speed Distribution Using Lightweight Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Hybrid Basis Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10877)
*Wei Huang,Junpeng Lu,Tianhe Xu,Hao Zhang,Feng Yin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量化混合基函数增强的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（LHBF-KAN）模型，用于多尺度水下声速预测，通过多分支基函数表征与剪枝策略兼顾多尺度建模能力与模型紧凑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下声速分布决定声传播路径，对水声通信与目标定位至关重要。传统声速剖面（SSP）预测方法虽能在无现场测量时估计声速，突破声呐观测设备的覆盖范围限制，但水下声速存在多尺度变化（如内波引起的日变化、季度变化及间歇性波动），现有固定结构模型难以对多尺度声速分布模式保持良好泛化能力。

Method: 提出轻量化混合基函数增强的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（LHBF-KAN）。构建多分支表征层，使不同基函数对应不同时间模式，从缓慢变化的背景趋势到海洋动力过程引起的快速波动，从而自然适应不同深度声速的多尺度演化；同时引入剪枝策略，在训练中抑制贡献持续偏低的分支，避免多分支结构增大模型规模。

Result: 多分支结构在剪枝后可得到紧凑架构，具有适配资源受限水下平台部署的能力，并能对多尺度声速变化进行建模（摘要未给出定量实验结果）。

Conclusion: LHBF-KAN通过多分支混合基函数建模多尺度声速演化，并借助剪枝抑制低贡献分支，实现紧凑且可用于资源受限水下平台的多尺度声速预测。

Abstract: The underwater sound speed distribution directly governs acoustic propagation paths, rendering it critically important for underwater acoustic communication and target localization. Conventional sound speed profile (SSP) prediction methods provide a good way to estimate the underwater sound speed distribution without on-site data measurement, thus breaking through the coverage area constraints of sonar observation equipment and making the model universal in most marine areas. However, underwater sound speed exhibits multi-scale variations, such as diurnal, quarterly, and intermittent fluctuations caused by ocean processes such as internal waves. This makes it difficult for the fixed structure models in existing methods to have good generalization ability for multi-scale sound speed distribution patterns. To tackle this problem, we proposed a lightweight hybrid basis-function empowered Kolmogorov-Arnold network (LHBF-KAN) model for multi-scale sound speed prediction. We aim to construct a multi-branch representation layer in which different basis functions respond to distinct temporal patterns, from slowly varying background trends to rapid fluctuations induced by dynamic ocean processes, allowing the model to naturally accommodate the inherently multi-scale evolution of sound speed at different depths. To prevent the multi-branch structure from increasing model size, a pruning strategy is further introduced to suppress branches with consistently low contribution during training, yielding a compact architecture, suitable for deployment on resource constrained underwater platforms.

</details>


### [256] [Flexible Analog Self-Interference Cancellation for Waveform-Robust Monostatic ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10997)
*Anh Tuyen Le,Xiaojing Huang,J. Andrew Zhang,Peiyuan Qin,Le Chung Tran,Nhan Thanh Nguyen,Y. Jay Guo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出FASIC框架，基于WL-NLMS算法在数字基带生成抵消信号并于射频域相减，实现波形鲁棒的单站ISAC模拟自干扰消除，仿真得到约30–34 dB的稳定SIC，低PAPR波形因高阶幅度矩更小可获得深3.3 dB的抵消底。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单站ISAC需带内全双工，SIC须在压制强发射泄漏的同时保留微弱感知回波。模拟域中受发射机损伤（共轭与非线性SI分量）及统计特性差异很大的波形影响，传统方法难以兼顾稳定性与灵活性。

Method: 提出FASIC框架，采用广泛线性归一化最小均方（WL-NLMS）算法，在数字基带生成抵消信号并在射频域相减；通过可配置抵消跨度实现灵活的感知距离控制；归一化自适应机制应对不同PAPR波形；并将发射波形统计量与模拟SIC性能关联，预测波形相关的抵消底。

Result: 仿真验证了分析结论，获得约30–34 dB的稳定模拟SIC；低PAPR波形因高阶幅度矩较小，抵消底深3.3 dB；抵消跨度内的近场静态反射被抑制，而时延与多普勒偏移的回波得以保留。

Conclusion: FASIC是一种波形鲁棒的模拟SIC方案，并将波形统计特性确立为6G波形选择的关键考量。

Abstract: Monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) requires in-band full-duplex operation, where self-interference cancellation (SIC) must suppress the strong transmit leakage while preserving weak sensing echoes. In the analog domain, this task is complicated by transmitter impairments, which generate conjugate and nonlinear SI components, and by waveforms with widely different statistics. This paper develops a flexible analog self-interference cancellation (FASIC) framework for monostatic ISAC based on the widely linear normalized least-mean-square (WL-NLMS) algorithm. FASIC generates the cancellation signal in digital baseband, subtracts it in the radio-frequency domain, and enables flexible sensing-range control via a configurable cancellation span. Its normalized adaptation remains stable across waveforms with substantially different peak-to-average power ratios (PAPRs), for which fixed-step adaptation can become unstable. We further relate transmit-waveform statistics to analog SIC performance and predict the waveform-dependent cancellation floor. Simulations validate the analysis and demonstrate stable analog SIC of approximately $30$--$34$ dB, with the low-PAPR waveforms achieving a $3.3$ dB deeper floor owing to their smaller high-order amplitude moments. Near-field static reflections within the cancellation span are suppressed while delayed and Doppler-shifted echoes are preserved. These results establish FASIC as a waveform-robust analog SIC solution and identify waveform statistics as a key consideration for sixth-generation (6G) waveform selection.

</details>


### [257] [SEER: Source-Conditioned Emotion Enhancement via Retrieval for Cochlear-Implant Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11131)
*Hsing-Hang Chou,Yun-Shao Lin,Ching-Chin Sung,Chi-Chun Lee*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出SEER，一种基于检索的框架，无需平行录音与强度标签，通过学习"哪条同情感参考"能帮助源语音在CI处理后保持情感可识别性，显著提升人工耳蜗语音情感识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工耳蜗（CI）虽能恢复语音可及性，但削弱了情感识别所需的声音线索。现有面向CI的增强方法依赖平行的正常/强录音与强度标签，数据获取成本高、限制实用性，因此需要一种不依赖这些资源的增强方案。

Method: SEER采用检索式框架：由源条件检索器（source-conditioned retriever）从采样得到的情感语音转换结果中学习CI感知的效用；利用不确定性引导的探索（uncertainty-guided exploration）避免穷举式配对评估。该方法无需平行录音，也无需强度标签。

Result: 在RAVDESS上N8条件源语音macro-F1提升7.30个点，ESD上提升11.66个点；ESD在N4/N8/N16上均有显著增益；RAVDESS的16人听测在所有条件下均显著改善。穷举分析显示更强的参考语音带来总体收益，而性别或内容匹配影响甚微。

Conclusion: SEER证明通过检索合适的同情感参考即可在CI处理下有效保留并提升情感识别能力，且摆脱对平行录音与强度标签的依赖，为CI用户的情感感知增强提供了轻量、可推广的解决路径。

Abstract: Cochlear implants (CIs) restore speech access but weaken cues needed for vocal emotion recognition. Prior CI-oriented enhancement requires parallel normal/strong recordings and intensity labels. We propose SEER, a retrieval-based framework that learns which same-emotion reference helps each source remain recognizable after CI processing. A source-conditioned retriever learns CI-aware utility from sampled emotional voice conversion outcomes, while uncertainty-guided exploration avoids exhaustive pair evaluation; neither parallel recordings nor intensity labels are required. SEER improves Source macro-F1 at N8 by 7.30 points on RAVDESS and 11.66 points on ESD, with significant ESD gains across N4/N8/N16. Sixteen-listener RAVDESS gains are significant across all conditions. Exhaustive analysis finds an aggregate benefit from stronger references but little effect from matching gender or content.

</details>


### [258] [2D Coprime Pilots for Delay-Doppler Sensing in OFDM-ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11172)
*Guanping Shang,Zeyan Zhuang,Anzheng Tang,Shenghui Song,Chi-Ying Tsui*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 面向OFDM-ISAC系统，以感知互信息（SMI）为统一指标，联立优化时延-多普勒（DD）参数估计的无模糊感知区域与感知精度。基于广义Bezout恒等式首次给出实现DD参数唯一估计的二维（时间-频率）互质充要条件，并提出Adam引导迭代精化（AGIR）算法优化感知精度，数值结果验证了所提框架优于现有设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G系统期望通过ISAC实现无缝感知能力；为以最低通信开销实现高效感知，通信帧内嵌稀疏导频成为有前景的方案。现有研究虽在最大化无模糊感知区域上取得成果，但缺乏统一性能指标与有效的导频设计框架，难以同时最大化感知区域与感知精度。

Method: 在OFDM-ISAC系统中，采用感知互信息（SMI）作为刻画整体感知能力的统一性能指标，将联合优化建模为SMI最大化问题，系统性地解决感知模糊并优化感知精度。基于广义Bezout恒等式推导二维（时间-频率）互质条件，作为DD参数唯一估计的必要且充分条件；在该无模糊条件下提出Adam引导迭代精化（AGIR）算法以优化感知精度。

Result: 数值结果表明，得益于二维互质条件在优化感知精度方面提供的自由度，所提框架优于现有设计方案。

Conclusion: 该工作以SMI统一度量并联合优化无模糊感知区域与感知精度，其提出的二维互质条件为DD参数唯一估计提供了首个充要条件，AGIR算法进一步提升了感知精度，为稀疏导频的ISAC导频设计提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) is envisioned to endow future 6G systems with seamless sensing capabilities. To support efficient sensing with minimum communication overhead, sparse pilots embedded within communication frames have emerged as a promising solution. Along this line of research, existing studies have achieved engaging results in maximizing the unambiguous sensing region. However, jointly maximizing the sensing region and sensing accuracy remains challenging due to the lack of a unified performance metric and an effective pilot design framework. This paper jointly optimizes the unambiguous sensing region and sensing accuracy for estimating delay-Doppler (DD) parameters in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC systems, where sensing mutual information (SMI) is adopted as a unified performance metric to characterize the overall sensing capability. Specifically, the joint optimization is formulated as an SMI maximization problem by systematically resolving sensing ambiguity and optimizing sensing accuracy. In particular, based on the generalized Bezout identity, we derive a 2D (timefrequency) coprime condition, which, as far as the authors know, is the first necessary and sufficient condition to achieve the unique estimation of DD parameters in the literature. Under this unambiguous condition, we further propose an Adam-Guided Iterative Refinement (AGIR) algorithm to optimize the sensing accuracy. Numerical results demonstrate the advantage of the proposed framework over existing designs, owing to the freedom offered by the 2D coprime condition in optimizing the sensing accuracy.

</details>


### [259] [Integrity and Credibility in Navigation: From Error Characterization to Operational Assuran](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11190)
*Penggao Yan,Baoshan Song,Yuan Li,Ronghe Jin,Li-Ta Hsu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文区分导航完整性与估计器可信度：前者用误差与不确定性信息控制危险未告警使用风险，后者关注不确定性/风险声明是否被证据与建模过程所支撑；通过三个假设场景说明二者可能给出不同判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 导航完整性与估计器可信度虽都依赖误差与不确定性信息，但回答的问题不同，易被混淆。本文旨在澄清二者的概念差异，并说明在精度退化、不确定性报告被反驳、危险事件等情形下，完整性与可信度判定为何可能不一致。

Method: 概念性分析：将实际定位误差与所报告的统计表征相区分；把完整性形式化为在特定运行要求下对危险未告警使用风险的控制；把可信度描述为通过证据使用与建模过程对不确定性或风险声明的正当化。并构造三个假设场景进行对比分析。

Result: 三个假设场景表明：精度退化、不确定性报告与证据相矛盾、以及发生危险事件，会分别导致不同的可信度与完整性判定，二者并不必然同步。

Conclusion: 完整性与可信度评估回答不同问题：发生了什么、所报告声明为何应被相信、以及信息是否足以支撑预期运行，从而为导航系统的风险评估提供互补视角。

Abstract: Navigation integrity and estimator credibility use error and uncertainty information to address different questions. This perspective distinguishes actual positioning error from reported statistical characterizations, formulates integrity as control of hazardous unwarned-use risk under the requirement of a specified operation, and describes credibility as the justification of an uncertainty or risk claim by its evidence usage and modeling process. Three hypothetical scenarios show how deteriorated accuracy, a contradicted uncertainty report, and a hazardous event can lead to different credibility and integrity judgments. The resulting assessment asks what happened, why the reported claim should be believed, and whether the information is sufficient for the intended operation.

</details>


### [260] [gr-ntnisac: An Open GNU Radio Testbed for NTN-ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11307)
*Soham Dhiren Desai*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出gr-ntnisac：一个开源GNU Radio双USRP有线测试平台，将仿真的LEO卫星信道叠加到标准5G NR下行信号上，用于在已知真值的条件下评测被动接收机（延迟与多普勒逐径打分）。硬件上直射路径抑制深度34.8 dB（无射频的匹配仿真37.6 dB），仿真上限约40 dB，去除分数延迟滤波器和旋转叶片等限制后可达71.0 dB；诊断型对消器在同一数据上达到72.7 dB；在一次有线采集的载荷辅助接收机中，-25 dB移动路径在76.9%驻留时间内被检测到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星作为5G下行发射源可实现广域覆盖的被动感知，但接收机需处理数十kHz多普勒以及每个观测区间内变化的直射路径时延。此类接收机在真正上星测试前，必须先在真值已知的可复现环境中验证。

Method: 构建开源GNU Radio测试平台gr-ntnisac：对标准5G NR下行施加仿真LEO信道，经两台有线连接的USRP传输，并针对每条路径所设定的延迟与多普勒对接收机进行评分。同一份接收机代码可在仿真、录制采集和硬件三种模式下运行。以直射路径对消（抑制强卫星信号以显露弱回波）作为首个应用场景，并设置诊断型对消器（额外去除逐子载波响应与逐符号相位）作对照，辅以可控仿真归因分析。

Result: 硬件对消深度34.8 dB，无射频的匹配仿真为37.6 dB，表明电台并非主要限制。可控仿真显示：仿真器8抽头分数延迟滤波器与几乎位于直射路径延迟处的模拟旋转叶片分别将深度限制在约40 dB；二者去除后深度达71.0 dB。诊断型对消器在同一采集上达72.7 dB。在传导采集数据上，载荷辅助接收机在76.9%的驻留时间内检测到-25 dB的移动路径。

Conclusion: gr-ntnisac提供了一种真值可控、软硬件一致的标准化评测手段，可用于LEO-5G被动感知接收机在轨部署前的验证；当前直射路径对消深度受仿真器分数延迟滤波与场景内移动散射体限制，而非射频前端，且诊断型处理可进一步提升对消性能。

Abstract: A passive receiver can sense nearby objects from the echoes of a 5G downlink. When the transmitter is a low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite, one transmitter covers a wide area, but the receiver must handle tens of kHz of Doppler and a direct-path delay that changes within every observation interval. Such a receiver should be tested where the correct answer is known before it is tried on a satellite. This paper presents gr-ntnisac, an open GNU Radio testbed that applies an emulated LEO channel to a standard 5G New Radio downlink, sends it through two cabled USRPs, and scores the receiver against the delay and Doppler commanded for every path. The same receiver code runs in simulation, on recorded captures, and on hardware. As a first use, we measure cancellation of the direct path, the strong satellite signal that masks weak echoes. Depth is 34.8 dB on hardware and 37.6 dB in a matched simulation without radios, so the radios are not the main limit. Controlled simulation shows that the emulator's 8-tap fractional-delay filter and a simulated rotating blade at almost the direct path's delay each limit depth to about 40 dB; without either, depth reaches 71.0 dB. A diagnostic canceller that also removes the per-subcarrier response and per-symbol phase reaches 72.7 dB on the same captures. On a conducted capture, a payload-aided receiver detects a -25 dB moving path in 76.9 percent of dwells.

</details>


### [261] [Unrolled Time-Varying Graph Signal Restoration under Spatiotemporal Smoothness Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11359)
*Hayate Kojima,Hikari Noguchi,Koki Yamada,Yuichi Tanaka*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于深度算法展开（DAU）的时变图信号恢复方法，用时空正则化建模并展开共轭梯度迭代学习参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时变图信号（如传感器网络信号）在空间上非均匀分布且表现为时间序列，观测常含噪声与缺失值，恢复时需同时考虑空间与时间关系。

Method: 以优化问题建模信号特性：时空正则项结合Sobolev算子（空间平滑）与多抽头FIR滤波器（时间平滑）；将求解该问题的迭代共轭梯度法展开为网络，逐次迭代学习正则化参数与滤波器系数，支持监督批量、监督在线与非监督批量三种学习设定。

Result: 在多个合成与真实数据集上，监督批量方法几乎在所有情况下取得最低RMSE；监督在线与非监督批量方法优于各自设定下的现有方法，且常与现有批量方法相当。

Conclusion: 所提DAU方法能有效进行时变图信号恢复，监督批量设定性能最优，其余设定亦具竞争力。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose restoration methods for time-varying graph signals using deep algorithm unrolling (DAU). Time-varying graph signals, such as signals obtained from sensor networks, are nonuniformly distributed in space and observed as time series. Since these observed signals often contain noise and missing values, their restoration needs to consider both spatial and temporal relationships. Our approach is based on an optimization problem that models signal properties using a spatiotemporal regularizer that combines a Sobolev operator for spatial smoothness and a multi-tap FIR filter for temporal smoothness. We then unroll the iterative conjugate gradient method to solve this problem and learn the regularization parameters and filter coefficients in each iteration. Our method can be applied to supervised batch, supervised online, and unsupervised batch settings to learn these parameters. Experiments on several synthetic and real-world datasets show that the supervised batch method achieves the lowest RMSEs in almost all cases. The supervised online and the unsupervised batch methods outperform the existing methods of their own settings, and are often competitive with the existing batch methods.

</details>


### [262] [An Embodied Multiagent Framework Based on Token Communications for Cooperative ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11434)
*Jiahe Guo,Jun Du,Chunxiao Jiang,Jintao Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究具身无人机代理的协作式通感一体化网络，提出状态—意图令牌通信（SI-TokCom）框架，通过多代理具身策略学习实现高效的令牌选择、组合与物理动作决策，以最小化推进能耗并满足通信与感知速率需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空经济需要无人机支持的通感一体化（ISAC）来保障连接可靠性与环境感知，具身无人机代理通过"感知—决策—行动"闭环支持自主作业。但每个无人机仅能获取局部观测，有效协作须交换局部状态与意图，而直接共享信息会带来显著信令开销，并在动态环境中妨碍及时协调。

Method: 将问题建模为联合令牌通信（TokCom）与物理控制的优化问题：在通信与感知速率约束下最小化总推进能耗。提出由多代理具身策略学习驱动的状态—意图令牌通信（SI-TokCom）框架：使用独立的预训练码本对局部状态与意图进行紧凑交换，无人机代理联合学习令牌的选择与组合，并基于局部观测与接收到的令牌确定物理动作。

Result: 仿真结果显示，SI-TokCom 分别达到集中式基线通信速率与感知速率的 98.9% 和 99.1%；相较局部基线，相应速率分别提升 5.0% 和 43.6%，而推进能耗基本保持不变。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了令牌通信在 ISAC 系统中实现具身无人机代理间通信高效协作的潜力。

Abstract: The emerging low-altitude economy demands unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) for reliable connectivity and environmental awareness. In particular, embodied UAV agents offer a promising means of supporting autonomous operations through a closed loop linking perception, decision-making, and physical actions. However, each UAV has access only to local observations, and effective cooperation requires exchanging local states and intentions. Directly sharing such information can incur substantial signaling overhead and hinder timely coordination in dynamic environments. To deal with this problem, this paper investigates a cooperative ISAC network of embodied UAV agents and formulates a joint token communications (TokCom) and physical control problem to minimize total propulsion energy subject to communication and sensing rate requirements. Then, we propose a state--intent TokCom (SI-TokCom) framework driven by multi-agent embodied policy learning. Specifically, separate pretrained codebooks enable compact exchanges of local states and intentions, while UAV agents jointly learn to select and compose tokens and determine physical actions based on local observations and received tokens. Simulation results show that SI-TokCom achieves 98.9\% and 99.1\% of the centralized baseline's communication and sensing rates, respectively. Compared with the local baseline, it improves the corresponding rates by 5.0\% and 43.6\%, respectively, with essentially unchanged propulsion energy. These results highlight the potential of TokCom for communication-efficient cooperation among embodied UAV agents in ISAC systems.

</details>


### [263] [Model-Driven Deep Learning with Rank-One Sensing for Efficient CSI Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11558)
*Shunpu Tang,Qianqian Yang,Seung-Woo Ko,Jihong Park,Kaibin Huang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出低秩先验(LRP)引导的CSI反馈框架，直接在秩一信道分量上做结构化感知与重建，并用LRP骨干扩展DCRNet为DCRNetV2，在精度-复杂度权衡上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDD大规模MIMO下行CSI反馈开销随天线与子载波数增长，部署困难。现有深度学习反馈方法多把CSI当作通用图像，用卷积或Transformer处理，未充分利用低秩多径先验，且在UE与BS两端引入不可忽略的计算量。

Method: 提出LRP引导的CSI反馈框架：UE端LRP编码器进行可学习的秩一感知，获得路径感知测量；BS端LRP解码器通过秩一合成重建CSI，避免经典求解器的迭代恢复。为补偿有限秩近似残差，将此前DCRNet扩展为DCRNetV2，融入LRP骨干与门控空洞卷积残差分支。

Result: 在多数据集与多场景实验中，所提方法取得优于现有基于模型与基于深度学习的基线的精度-复杂度权衡：独立LRP以远低复杂度实现相较模型基线超过10 dB的NMSE提升；DCRNetV2以约五分之一复杂度达到与最先进Transformer类方法相当的精度。

Conclusion: 利用低秩多径先验进行结构化感知与重建可有效降低CSI反馈的计算与恢复复杂度，同时保持高精度；DCRNetV2在精度-复杂度权衡上具竞争力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Downlink channel state information (CSI) feedback is essential for beamforming optimization in frequency-division duplex (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. However, the feedback overhead increases with the number of antennas and subcarriers, posing a major challenge to practical deployment. Although recent deep learning (DL)-based methods reduce this overhead by compressing CSI at the user equipment (UE) and reconstructing it at the base station (BS), most of them treat CSI as a generic image and rely on convolutional or Transformer architectures. As a result, the low-rank multipath prior is insufficiently exploited, while non-negligible computation is introduced at both the UE and the BS. To address this issue, we propose a low-rank prior (LRP)-guided CSI feedback framework that performs structured sensing and reconstruction directly over rank-one channel components. Specifically, the LRP encoder conducts learnable rank-one sensing to obtain path-aware measurements at the UE, while the LRP decoder reconstructs CSI through rank-one synthesis at the BS, avoiding the iterative recovery required by classical solvers. To compensate for finite-rank approximation residuals, we extend our previous DCRNet into DCRNetV2 by incorporating the proposed LRP backbone and gated dilated-convolutional residual branches. Experiments on multiple datasets and scenarios show that the proposed methods achieve a better accuracy-complexity tradeoff than existing model-based and DL-based baselines. In particular, standalone LRP achieves more than $10$~dB NMSE improvement over model-based baselines with much lower complexity, while DCRNetV2 achieves comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art Transformer-based methods with only about one-fifth of the complexity. The source code is available at https://github.com/tangshunpu/DCRNetV2.

</details>


### [264] [An Efficient Correlation-based Evaluation of the GN-Model for General Multi-Span Optical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11624)
*Y. Jiang,Y. Gao,P. Poggiolini*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出相关高斯噪声模型（cGN），将多波段WDM系统中的非线性干扰（NLI）计算分解为由信道空间功率剖面的自相关和互相关（或其能谱）驱动，剩余计算仅为一维快速数值积分，且完整考虑了跨跨段相干干涉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多波段WDM系统包含异质跨段与非同一信道，信道具有不同空间功率剖面和多子载波结构，跨段使用不同光纤类型及色散/损耗剖面，还可能涉及前向与后向拉曼放大、信道间受激拉曼散射及多个集总增益/损耗元件。在此通用框架下，现有GN模型难以兼顾精度与计算效率，且常忽略或近似跨跨段NLI相干干涉，而该相干性可使NLI增加数dB。

Method: 提出相关高斯噪声模型（cGN）框架，对GN模型的NLI贡献进行高效分解。核心结论是：WDM梳中任意频率处的NLI功率谱密度本质上由各信道空间功率剖面的空间自相关与互相关（等价地为其能谱）驱动。计算完这些相关或谱后，剩余计算简化为快速、性质良好的一维数值积分。cGN完整计入每对跨段中NLI的相干干涉，且几乎不引入近似。

Result: cGN可适用于任意频段、任意带宽的一般系统，计算效率极高；能给出每个信道或子载波在多个频率处的NLI频谱；由于几乎未做近似，精度非常高；同时完整捕捉了现有解析与半解析GN公式常忽略或近似的跨跨段相干效应（该效应可带来数dB的NLI增量）。

Conclusion: cGN为多波段、异质跨段WDM系统提供了一种高精度、高效率的NLI频谱评估框架，克服了传统GN模型在相干干涉处理上的不足，并以开源软件形式在欧盟Zenodo网站免费发布，便于实际应用。

Abstract: Accurate and computationally efficient evaluation of non-linear interference (NLI) remains challenging in multi-band WDM systems comprising heterogeneous spans and nonidentical channels. In such systems, channels may have distinct spatial power profiles and multi-subcarrier structures. Spans may use different fiber types with span-dependent dispersion and loss profiles. These systems may further employ general amplification schemes, including forward and backward Raman amplification. Inter-channel stimulated Raman scattering and multiple lumped gain or loss elements may also be present.
  In this encompassing framework, we provide an efficient decomposition of the GN-model NLI contributions. We show that the NLI power spectral density at any frequency across the WDM comb is fundamentally driven by the spatial auto- and cross-correlations of the channels' spatial power profiles or, equivalently, by the corresponding energy spectra. For this reason we call this formalism the `correlation GN-model', or cGN. Once these correlations or spectra have been computed, the remaining calculations reduces to a fast, well-behaved one-dimensional numerical integral. Moreover, cGN fully accounts for coherent interference of NLI in every pair of spans. Such coherence is often neglected or approximated in existing analytical and semi-analytical GN-model formulations, although it can increase the NLI by several dB.
  In short, the cGN framework applies to any general systems over any band and any bandwidth, with very high computational efficiency. It is capable of providing the frequency spectrum of NLI at multiple frequencies across each channel or subcarrier. Its accuracy is very high because virtually no approximations are invoked.
  The cGN framework is available as freely downloadable software from the European Union Zenodo website.

</details>


### [265] [Outage-Aware Robust Sensing for UAV ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11720)
*Qiming Li,Lei Zhang,Haoran Xu,Lina Mohjazi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出面向多基站无人机跟踪的中断感知共形鲁棒功率分配框架，用自适应预测集刻画下一时隙链路可用性，仅对保留的非中断模式施加跟踪约束，将功率分配化为半定规划，兼顾可靠性与节能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC基础设施可为空中机器人提供外部感知层，但动态阻塞使下一更新时刻哪些感知链路具有信息量变得不确定。单一预测可用性模式可能遗漏低信息量结果，而保护所有模式既浪费功率，在全部链路阻塞时甚至不可行。

Method: 提出历史感知联合预测器，将雷达与跟踪历史映射为下一时隙可用性概率；采用自适应预测集保留合理的相关模式；仅对保留的非中断模式施加跟踪约束，将全阻塞模式单独视为物理感知中断；在每时隙波束方向固定下，将标量功率分配建模为半定规划；给出可靠性界，将可服务时隙跟踪失败与部署策略的误覆盖率和优化不可行性联系起来。

Result: 在五个随机种子的配对闭环仿真中，该方法实现0.01%的可服务时隙约束违反率，并且相比保护所有非中断模式降低47.0%的功率消耗。

Conclusion: 该框架通过共形预测与鲁棒优化的结合，在保证跟踪可靠性的同时显著降低功率开销，为动态阻塞下的多基站无人机跟踪提供了节能且可行的功率分配方案。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) infrastructure can provide an external perception layer for aerial robots, but dynamic blockage makes the set of informative sensing links at the next update uncertain. A single predicted availability pattern can miss low-information outcomes, whereas protecting all patterns wastes power and may become infeasible when all links are blocked. We propose an outage-aware conformal robust power-allocation framework for multi-BS UAV tracking. A history-aware joint predictor maps radar and tracking histories to next-slot availability probabilities, and adaptive prediction sets retain plausible correlated patterns. Tracking constraints are enforced only for retained non-outage patterns, while the all-blocked pattern is treated separately as a physical sensing outage. With per-slot beam directions fixed, the resulting scalar-power allocation is a semidefinite program. A reliability bound relates serviceable-slot tracking failure to deployed-policy miscoverage and optimization infeasibility. Across paired closed-loop simulations over five random seeds, the method attains a 0.01% serviceable-slot constraint-violation rate and uses 47.0% less power than protection over all non-outage patterns.

</details>


### [266] [AFDM Channel Parameter Estimation: Exploiting its Shift Properties and Input-Output Relationship](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11758)
*Jialiang Zhu,Zeping Sui,Zilong Liu,Arman Farhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于脉冲导频、无需网格搜索且低开销的AFDM信道参数估计方法，利用时域与仿射域的循环移位特性联立线性方程估计整数时延与多普勒，并通过多普勒泄漏估计分数多普勒，结合SIC框架处理多径，显著降低复杂度与导频开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AFDM因良好的后向兼容性、可达满分集以及抗高多普勒和硬件损伤能力而受关注，但现有信道参数估计方法要么导频开销大，要么依赖计算量巨大的网格搜索，因此需要一种低开销、低复杂度的估计方案。

Method: 利用AFDM固有的移位特性：脉冲导频上的多普勒效应等价于时域延迟移位并伴随相位旋转，且时延与多普勒均在仿射域引起循环移位。结合时域与仿射域特性构造两个线性方程以估计每条路径的整数时延与整数多普勒；分数多普勒则由脉冲导频周围的多普勒泄漏，基于AFDM输入输出关系估计。多径场景下引入逐次干扰消除（SIC）框架，先估计并重构、消除最强路径，再依次估计其余路径。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法相比基准方法显著降低计算复杂度，并允许更低的导频开销，同时实现更优的信道参数估计性能。

Conclusion: 所提基于脉冲导频的AFDM信道参数估计方法无需网格搜索、开销低且复杂度小，能够有效估计整数与分数多普勒及多径参数，性能优于现有基准方案。

Abstract: Affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) has attracted significant attention owing to its excellent backwards compatibility, full diversity achievability, as well as strong resilience to high Doppler and various hardware impairments. Existing AFDM channel parameter estimation methods, however, either require large pilot overhead or rely on computationally intensive grid search methods. This paper proposes a grid-search-independent, low-overhead, impulse-pilot-based channel parameter estimation method for AFDM systems by exploiting its inherent shift properties. Specifically, we show that the effect of a Doppler shift on the impulse pilot is equivalent to a delay shift in the time domain with a phase rotation. Additionally, both delay and Doppler shifts lead to cyclic shifts in the affine domain. By utilizing these properties in both the time and affine domains, two linear equations are formed to estimate the integer delay and Doppler of each path. The fractional part of the Doppler is estimated from the Doppler-induced leakage around the impulse pilot by exploiting the AFDM input-output relationship. For multipath channels, a successive interference cancellation (SIC) framework is developed, in which the strongest propagation path is first estimated, reconstructed, and canceled before the remaining paths are successively estimated. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces computational complexity and allows lower pilot overhead than the benchmarks. The proposed method also achieves improved channel parameter estimation and

</details>


### [267] [SmartBike: A Low-Power Edge IoT System for Cycling Safety and Real-Time Awareness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11824)
*Sogand Hashemi,Gonçalo Sarabanda Neves Loureiro,Catarina Pereira De Freitas Lima,Lyssa Ramaut,Liesbet Van der Perre*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartBike——一种面向骑行者安全的低功耗物联网平台，集成盲区监测、骑行者使用检测、定位与 BLE 边缘通信，节点续航约 21 个月。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市骑行虽可持续，但在密集车流中骑行者处境高度脆弱，原因在于情境感知能力有限，且传统自行车缺乏主动安全辅助系统。

Method: 系统由车载 IoT 节点与网关监测界面构成：节点集成三个 ToF 传感器用于盲区检测、IMU 用于运动感知与车载速度估计、GNSS 用于定位、鞍座压电换能器用于事件驱动唤醒；采用压电触发激活、应用定制化采样率与紧凑无连接 BLE 广播降低能耗；固件基于 Zephyr RTOS 的轻量状态机架构，网关负责被动 BLE 扫描、负载解码与实时仪表盘可视化。

Result: BLE 负载压缩至 11 字节；功耗分析显示传感占总能耗 90% 以上，无线通信占比更低；在 12600 mWh 电池下，典型通勤条件（日均约 40 分钟）估计续航约 21 个月。

Conclusion: SmartBike 验证了以极低功耗实现多功能骑行者安全监测的可行性，其能耗瓶颈在于传感而非通信。

Abstract: Urban cycling is a sustainable mode of transportation, but cyclists remain highly vulnerable in dense traffic because of limited situational awareness and the lack of active safety assistance on conventional bicycles. This paper presents SmartBike, a low power Internet-of-Things (IoT) platform for cyclist safety, combining blind spot monitoring, rider usage detection, localization, and wireless edge-to-gateway communication. The proposed system consists of a bike-mounted IoT node and a gateway assisted monitoring interface. The node integrates three time-of-flight sensors for blind spot detection, an IMU module for motion sensing and on-board speed estimation, a GNSS module for localization, and a saddle mounted piezo-electric transducer for event-driven wake up. To satisfy the energy constraints of the IoT node, the design employs piezo-triggered activation, application specific sensing rates, and compact connectionless Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertisements for low overhead transmission. The firmware is implemented in Zephyr RTOS using a lightweight state machine architecture, while the gateway performs passive BLE scanning, payload decoding, and real-time dashboard visualization. The BLE payload is reduced to 11 bytes, and power analysis shows that sensing accounts for more than 90% of the total energy budget, while wireless communication represents less overall consumption. With a 12600 mWh battery, the estimated lifetime reaches approximately 21 months under typical commuting conditions (Average 40 min per day).

</details>


### [268] [Large-Scale Partition-Based RIS Beamforming For Uplink RIS-Equipped Multi-User Systems: Asymptotic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11904)
*Samira Rahimian,Haris Gacanin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对大规模RIS分区辅助的多用户上行ZF接收系统，通过渐近分析得到用户平均SINR的闭式近似，并证明等分为近似和速率最优，进而提出低复杂度贪心配对迁移搜索以进一步提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS与接收天线阵列结合是多用户上行接收的低复杂度架构，但用户数大于2时，ZF SINR缺乏显式低维闭式表达，其分布难以解析，无法用于系统设计，因此需要解决该性能分析空白。

Method: 考虑K用户、K天线上行系统，基站ZF接收前配置L单元大规模RIS并划分为K个用户专用子表面。在子表面尺寸趋于无穷的渐近条件下，分析ZF SINR对应的正交投影算子收敛性，据此推导仅依赖确定性信道参数的平均每用户SINR闭式近似；将该表达式作为可处理的设计目标，证明等分区在首阶意义上近似和速率最优，并提出低复杂度贪心配对迁移搜索细化分区。

Result: 理论证明等分区在首阶意义上近似和速率最优，且与用户间路径损耗不对称性无关；蒙特卡洛仿真表明，当RIS相对用户数足够大时，闭式SINR与实际速率吻合良好；贪心搜索在等分基础上取得一致但适度的和速率增益。

Conclusion: 所推导的闭式SINR既是准确性能预测工具，也是实用设计工具，为多用户RIS辅助上行ZF接收的RIS分区设计提供了理论依据和低复杂度优化方法。

Abstract: Combining a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) with a receive antenna array is a promising low-complexity architecture for multi-user uplink reception, but its performance analysis for more than two users has remained an open problem: the zero-forcing (ZF) signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) no longer admits an explicit, low-dimensional closed-form expression, and its distribution is analytically intractable for design purposes. This paper addresses this gap for a K-user, K-antenna uplink system in which a large-scale, L-element RIS, partitioned into K user-dedicated sub-surfaces, precedes ZF reception at the base station. Through an asymptotic analysis in which the sub-surface sizes grow without bound, we show that the orthogonal projector underlying the ZF SINR converges to a rank-one matrix aligned with the desired user's channel. We use this convergence to derive a closed-form asymptotic approximation for the average per-user SINR that depends only on deterministic channel parameters. Treating this expression as a tractable design objective, we prove that equal partitioning is approximately sum-rate-optimal at leading order regardless of path-loss asymmetry across users. We also develop a low-complexity greedy pairwise-transfer search that refines the partition beyond this leading-order optimum. Monte Carlo simulations across a range of system and RIS sizes confirm that the closed-form SINR tracks the exact simulated rate closely once the RIS is large relative to the number of users. The greedy search also yields consistent, if modest, sum-rate gains over equal partitioning, validating the theory as both an accurate performance predictor and a practical design tool.

</details>


### [269] [Pinching-Antenna-Assisted Integrated AirComp-NOMA: Joint Transceiver and Antenna-Position Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11973)
*Saeid Pakravan,Wessam Ajib,Wei-Ping Zhu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文将空口计算（AirComp）与非正交多址接入（NOMA）相结合，研究夹持天线（pinching-antenna, PA）辅助的上行链路，通过联合设计AirComp收发机、PA位置与SIC解码顺序，在满足NOMA QoS、发射功率和PA部署约束下最小化AirComp均方误差（MSE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AirComp与NOMA融合可实现数据聚合与信息传输并发，但会使计算精度与通信服务质量（QoS）紧密耦合。现有方案缺乏缓解该耦合的手段，需要额外的空间自由度来解耦计算精度与通信QoS之间的权衡。

Method: 利用夹持天线的灵活位置提供额外空间自由度。基于上行SIC的递归结构，建立精确的NOMA可行性条件并推导最优SIC排序规则，从而消除NOMA功率变量与解码顺序的组合搜索，将原问题降维为连续优化问题。进而提出迭代算法：包含AirComp发射系数与接收缩放的最优更新，以及面向PA布放的保可行性Majorization方案。

Result: 所提算法在保持NOMA可行性的同时，产生单调非增的计算MSE序列。数值结果表明，在NOMA QoS要求下联合优化AirComp收发机与PA位置可带来计算精度增益。

Conclusion: 通过夹持天线引入的空间自由度并联合优化AirComp收发机、PA位置与SIC顺序，能够有效解耦计算精度与通信QoS的强耦合关系，在保证NOMA可行性与收敛性的前提下显著提升AirComp的计算精度。

Abstract: Integrating over-the-air computation (AirComp) with non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) enables concurrent data aggregation and information transmission, but tightly couples computation accuracy with communication quality of service (QoS). This paper investigates a pinching-antenna-assisted uplink, where flexible pinching-antenna (PA) placement provides additional spatial degrees of freedom to manage this coupling. We minimize the AirComp mean-squared error (MSE) subject to NOMA QoS, transmit-power, and PA deployment constraints by jointly designing the AirComp transceiver, PA positions, and successive interference cancellation (SIC) order. Exploiting the recursive structure of uplink SIC, we establish an exact NOMA feasibility condition and derive an optimal SIC-ordering rule. These structural results eliminate the NOMA power variables and the combinatorial search over decoding orders, reducing the original problem to a continuous optimization problem. We then develop an iterative algorithm with optimal AirComp transmit-coefficient and receive-scaling updates and a feasibility-preserving majorization scheme for PA placement. The proposed algorithm preserves NOMA feasibility while generating a monotonically nonincreasing computation-MSE sequence. Numerical results demonstrate the computation-accuracy gains of jointly optimizing the AirComp transceiver and PA positions under NOMA QoS requirements.

</details>


### [270] [Joint Pinching-Antenna Position and Power Optimization for Dual-Waveguide ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11987)
*Saeid Pakravan,Imene Trigui,Wessam Ajib,Wei-Ping Zhu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文研究双波导紧缩天线（PA）辅助的通感一体化（ISAC）系统，在用户同时作为感知目标、收发波导空间分离的设定下，联合优化收发PA位置与发射功率，以在感知SNR与二维定位CRB约束下最大化通信速率，并提出交替优化算法求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧缩天线可通过沿介质波导控制辐射位置，为ISAC提供空间可重构性。论文针对通信用户同时充当感知目标、从而使通信与感知链路通过共同几何耦合的场景，希望借助空间分离的收发波导分别控制前向与回向感知路径，以提升系统性能，并解决由此带来的非凸联合优化问题。

Method: 构建双波导PA辅助ISAC系统模型，联合优化发射与接收PA位置及发射功率，目标为最大化聚合通信速率，约束包括最小感知SNR、二维定位CRB要求以及功率、能量和部署约束。为求解非凸问题，提出交替优化算法，结合有界注水功率更新与近端一阶联合PA位置更新。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提设计方案相比对比基准可获得更高的通信速率，并且在定位要求更严格时增益更为显著。

Conclusion: 双波导PA辅助ISAC系统中，联合优化收发PA位置与功率能够有效提升通信速率并满足感知与定位约束；所提交替优化算法在严格定位需求下表现出更明显优势。

Abstract: Pinching-antenna (PA) systems provide spatial reconfigurability for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) through controllable radiation locations along dielectric waveguides. This paper investigates a dual-waveguide PA-assisted ISAC system in which the communication user also serves as the sensing target, coupling the communication and sensing links through a common user/target geometry. Spatially separated transmit and receive waveguides provide separate spatial control over the forward and return sensing paths. We jointly optimize the transmit and receive PA positions and transmit power to maximize the aggregate communication rate subject to minimum sensing-SNR and two-dimensional localization Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) requirements, along with power, energy, and deployment constraints. To solve the resulting non-convex problem, we develop an alternating optimization algorithm that combines a bounded water-filling power update with a proximal first-order joint PA-position update. Numerical results show that the proposed design achieves higher communication rates than the considered benchmarks, with more pronounced gains under stringent localization requirements.

</details>


### [271] [Reputation-Graded Wavelet-Packet Subtree Allocation for IoT Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12038)
*Surya Jayakumar,Arun Narayanan,Indrakshi Dey*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文提出将访问控制下沉到波形层面：用WPDM把信道组织为二叉正交脉冲树，以传感器信誉决定其可用子树深度，实现物理层权限隔离与低信任节点带宽逐级回收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT传感网的传统访问控制位于物理层之上，融合中心只能决定是否接受报告，而受损节点的射频仍持续占用共享信道，无法在波形层面被剥夺占用权。因此需要把"权限"编码进波形本身。

Method: 采用小波包分复用（WPDM）将信道构建为二叉正交脉冲树；信誉高者拥有宽子带，低信誉者仅获窄子带，融合中心逐级回收。理论证明完美定时下分配可精确隔离传感器；存在定时偏移时，低通叶子节点泄漏能量随树层数每级下降四倍。在脉冲Class-A噪声下，推导出子带外传输的局部最优检测器，按预测泄漏量对每个叶节点加权。同时给出围堵受损节点所需时间的界，并推导最优树深。

Result: 仿真中，被降级节点在自身配额内发射时，相比固定分配WPDM及具有相同信誉分层的OFDM，全局误判概率降低68%；相比密码学重新认证方案降低44%，且当受损传感器超过24%时优于后者。

Conclusion: 将访问权嵌入正交脉冲树的子带深度，可在物理层实现与信誉绑定的可回收权限，配合泄漏加权的局部最优检测，显著提升受损节点存在下的判决可靠性。

Abstract: Access control in Internet of Things (IoT) sensor networks usually acts above the physical layer: the fusion centre decides which reports to accept, while the radio of a compromised node keeps occupying the shared channel. This paper places the entitlement in the waveform: wavelet packet division multiplexing (WPDM) builds the channel as a binary tree of orthogonal pulses, and each sensor's reputation sets the depth of the subtree it may use: trusted sensors hold wide subbands, and low-trust sensors hold narrow subbands that the fusion centre withdraws one at a time. We prove that the allocation isolates sensors exactly under perfect timing, and that under a timing offset the energy leaking out of the lowpass leaf falls fourfold per tree level. The locally optimum detector of out-of-subtree transmission in impulsive Class-A noise weights each leaf in proportion to this predicted leakage. We bound the time needed to confine a compromised node and derive the optimal tree depth. In simulation, with demoted nodes radiating within their allocation, the scheme lowers the probability of a false global decision by 68% relative to fixed-allocation WPDM and to OFDM with the same reputation tiers, and by 44% relative to cryptographic re-attestation, which leads once more than 24% of the sensors are compromised.

</details>


### [272] [Statistical Analysis of 3D Ambiguity Functions for Random MIMO-OFDM Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12162)
*Pinjun Zeng,Yuyang Lu,Jialan Tang,Xiaoyang Chen,Yifeng Xiong,Fan Liu,Shi Jin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对随机MIMO-OFDM通信波形，构建了跨时延、多普勒与角度的三维模糊函数（3D-AF），给出了期望平方3D-AF的闭式表达，并揭示星座四阶矩（峰度）对模糊旁瓣的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机通信符号虽可用于ISAC感知，但匹配滤波响应随数据变化；已有随机OFDM感知统计分析多集中于时延与多普勒，MIMO阵列与预编码引入的空间维度研究不足。

Method: 将点目标3D-AF表示为随机通信符号的二次型，其确定矩阵包含时延/多普勒频移、收发阵列响应及各子载波预编码；据此推导期望平方3D-AF闭式解，并定义混合域下的EISL与ESL指标；进一步扩展到慢时间多普勒的相干多符号处理，得到快-慢时间（FST）近似。

Result: 获得期望平方3D-AF的闭式表达，显式刻画星座四阶矩（峰度）对模糊旁瓣的作用，并给出混合时延-多普勒-角度搜索域上的EISL与ESL度量，以及相干多符号处理的FST近似。

Conclusion: 该工作为随机MIMO-OFDM通信信号在时延、多普勒和角度域诱发的感知模糊提供了统计表征框架。

Abstract: Random communication symbols allow integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems to exploit payload signals for sensing, but the resulting matched-filter response varies with the transmitted data. Existing statistical analyses of sensing with random orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms have largely focused on delay and Doppler, while the spatial dimension introduced by multi-input multi-output (MIMO) arrays and precoding has received much less attention. This paper develops a three-dimensional ambiguity function (3D-AF) for random MIMO-OFDM waveforms over delay, Doppler, and angle domains. For point-target sensing, we express the 3D-AF as a quadratic form of the random communication symbols, with a deterministic matrix that captures the delay and Doppler shifts, the transmit and receive array responses, and the precoders on different subcarriers. Based on this representation, we derive a closed-form expression for the expected squared 3D-AF and show explicitly how the constellation fourth-order moment (or kurtosis) affects the ambiguity sidelobes. The same characterization yields expected integrated sidelobe level (EISL) and expected sidelobe level (ESL) metrics over mixed delay-Doppler-angle search domains. The framework is further extended to coherent multi-symbol processing with slow-time Doppler, leading to the corresponding fast-slow time (FST) approximation. These results provide a statistical characterization of the sensing ambiguity induced by random MIMO-OFDM communication signals in delay, Doppler, and angle.

</details>


### [273] [Localization in Multi-Panel Massive MIMO With Clock Asynchronism: A Unified Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12178)
*Yuhao Zhang,Guangjin Pan,Musa Furkan Keskin,Carmen D'Andrea,Stefano Buzzi,Henk Wymeersch*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出统一定位框架UNILocMP，融合基于模型的几何方法与信道图表（CC），解决多面板大规模MIMO在时钟异步下的定位问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多面板大规模MIMO在时钟异步条件下的定位存在挑战：部分用户可与多个面板保持视距（LoS）链路，部分用户仅有单面板或无LoS链路，单一方法难以统一处理。为此需要结合模型驱动与数据驱动方法，并提升定位精度与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出UNILocMP统一框架，结合模型几何与信道图表（CC）。将用户分为多LoS用户（与至少两个面板保持LoS）和单/非LoS用户（仅与一个或没有面板保持LoS）。对多LoS用户采用联合位置与时钟偏差估计；对单/非LoS用户训练无监督CC模型，引入两阶段数据增强策略，并提出时钟偏差感知的相异度量。

Result: 数值验证表明，UNILocMP优于基于模型和基于CC的基线方法，性能接近全监督指纹定位。此外，在总天线数固定时，多面板架构相比单面板基站部署显著提升定位精度与鲁棒性，尤其在存在时钟异步的情况下。

Conclusion: UNILocMP通过融合模型几何与信道图表，有效应对时钟异步下的多面板大规模MIMO定位，多面板架构在固定天线总数时可显著提升定位性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a unified localization framework, termed UNILocMP, that combines model-based geometry and channel charting (CC) for multi-panel massive multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) under clock asynchronism. Owing to the multi-panel architecture, users are classified into multi-line-of-sight (LoS) users, which maintain LoS links with at least two panels, and single/non-LoS users, which maintain a LoS link with only one panel or with none of the panels. For multi-LoS users, a joint position and clock bias estimation is developed; while for single/non-LoS users, an unsupervised CC model is trained with a two-stage data augmentation strategy, where a clock-bias aware dissimilarity metric is introduced. It is numerically validated that the proposed UNILocMP outperforms model-based and CC-based baselines and achieves acceptable performance compared with fully-supervised fingerprinting. Moreover, for a fixed total number of antennas, the multi-panel architecture significantly improves localization accuracy and robustness compared with a single-panel base station (BS) deployment, particularly in the presence of clock asynchronism.

</details>


### [274] [Deep-Unfolded Penalized MLEM for Rapid Poisson Image Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12198)
*Zohar Davidov,Alon Osovizky,Max Ghelman,Nir Shlezinger*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出深度展开的惩罚MLEM框架，将少量迭代映射为可训练层，学习逐层正则化与泊松模型参数，并加入数据相关的灵敏度归一化校正，在固定迭代预算下提升重建分辨率，质量媲美长迭代MLEM与直接数据驱动模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最大似然期望最大化（MLEM）用于泊松图像重建时需大量迭代才能精确恢复，且对采集模型失配敏感。需要一种在有限迭代内即可获得高质量重建并缓解模型失配的方法。

Method: 提出深度展开的惩罚MLEM框架：将预设的少量迭代映射为可训练层，同时保留解析的前向/反向投影及MLEM的乘性结构。展开架构学习逐层相关的正则化项和泊松模型参数，并对灵敏度归一化进行数据相关的校正，以缓解模型失配。

Result: 数值实验表明，该方法在固定迭代预算下提升了重建分辨率，且重建质量可与长时间运行的MLEM以及直接数据驱动模型相媲美。

Conclusion: 深度展开的惩罚MLEM在保留传统迭代结构可解释性的同时，通过可学习参数与归一化校正，实现了高效、高质量且更鲁棒的泊松图像重建。

Abstract: Maximum likelihood expectation maximization (MLEM) is a common approach for Poisson image reconstruction, but accurate recovery requires many iterations and is sensitive to mismatch in the assumed acquisition model. We propose a deep-unfolded penalized MLEM framework that maps a prescribed small number of iterations into trainable layers while retaining the analytical forward/backward projections and the multiplicative structure of MLEM. The unfolded architecture learns layer-dependent regularization and Poisson-model parameters, together with a data-dependent correction of the sensitivity normalization to mitigate model mismatch. We numerically show that our method improves reconstruction resolution at a fixed iteration budget and attains reconstruction quality comparable to long MLEM runs and direct data-driven models.

</details>


### [275] [Tri-Hybrid Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12290)
*Janith Dassanayake,Gayan Aruma Baduge*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 面向无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统，提出数字-模拟-电磁三层级联的tri-hybrid预编码，联合优化三层预编码与AP发射功率以最大化全局能量效率(GEE)。采用交替优化：子问题一用加权最小均方误差、黎曼流形优化和Lorentz相位梯度上升最大化SE；子问题二用Dinkelbach与逐次凸近似做功率分配。仿真显示GEE比全数字与经典混合预编码分别提升87%和11%，联合功率优化较等功率基线提升22% SE与16% GEE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO中，全数字预编码射频链路开销高、能效差，而经典混合预编码难以充分挖掘电磁层自由度；需在每AP功率与前传约束下同时兼顾频谱效率(SE)与全局能量效率(GEE)。

Method: 提出数字、模拟、电磁处理三层级联的tri-hybrid预编码架构，联合优化三层预编码矩阵与AP发射功率以最大化GEE，并满足每AP功率与前传约束。设计交替优化算法：子程序一通过加权最小均方误差(WMMSE)、黎曼流形优化及Lorentz相位上的梯度上升最大化总SE以求解预编码；子程序二通过Dinkelbach分式规划与逐次凸近似(SCA)进行功率分配。并分析算法收敛性与计算复杂度。

Result: 在20dBm发射功率下，所提设计相较全数字预编码和经典混合预编码分别提升GEE约87%和11%；联合功率优化相较等功率基线获得22%的SE增益和16%的GEE增益，并在SE上优于共址架构。此外，识别出GEE最优的AP数量与射频链路数量区间，并表明增大动态超表面天线尺寸在低功率区间可提升GEE，且带来的有源功耗开销可忽略。

Conclusion: tri-hybrid预编码结合三层联合优化与功率分配，可在无蜂窝大规模MIMO中显著提升能量效率与频谱效率，并给出AP/射频链路配置及动态超表面天线尺寸的能效最优设计准则。

Abstract: This paper proposes a tri-hybrid precoder design, cascading digital, analog, and electromagnetic processing layers, for cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CFmMIMO) systems. We jointly optimize the three-layer precoders and access point (AP) transmit power to maximize global energy efficiency (GEE) under per-AP power and fronthaul constraints. To solve this, we develop an alternating optimization algorithm. The first sub-routine maximizes sum spectral efficiency (SE) for precoder design using weighted minimum mean square error, Riemannian manifold optimization, and gradient ascent over Lorentzian phases. The second optimizes power allocation via Dinkelbach's fractional programming and successive convex approximation. Convergence and computational complexity are also analyzed. Simulation results show the proposed design improves GEE by 87% and 11% over fully digital and classical hybrid precoders, respectively, at 20dBm transmit power. Moreover, joint power optimization yields 22% SE and 16% GEE gains over equal-power baselines, while outperforming colocated architectures in SE. Finally, we identify GEE-optimal regimes for AP and RF chain counts, and demonstrate that increasing dynamic metasurface antenna sizes enhances GEE in low-power regimes with negligible active power overhead.

</details>


### [276] [Interference-Aware Downlink Power Control for High-Altitude Platform Stations with QoS and Max-Min Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12380)
*Rajan Shrestha,Hayder Al-Hraishawi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对HAPS下行链路功率分配，在统计CSI、3GPP NTN路损与Rician衰落模型下推导SINR闭式表达，提出QoS约束功率最小化与max-min公平两种功率控制方案，性能优于启发式分配并逼近LP基准且计算量极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HAPS是非地面网络中实现广域覆盖的重要组成，但需在大用户覆盖范围内服务多用户，必须设计高效功率控制机制以应对其独特传播特性和严格功率约束。

Method: 在统计信道状态信息、3GPP NTN路径损耗和Rician衰落模型下，推导采用均值信道MRT预编码的SINR闭式表达式，刻画几何相关的用户间干扰耦合；据此提出QoS约束功率最小化方案（闭式解或低复杂度不动点迭代）与max-min SINR公平方案（二分法求解）。

Result: 在中高目标速率下所需发射功率最多降低6 dB，最差用户SINR优于均匀功率、逆路损和几何感知启发式分配；在R_req=2.5 bits/s/Hz、P_max=35 dBm时QoS可行概率约0.95（对比方案不足0.4）；性能与LP基准相当，K=20时平均计算时间减少约99.97%。

Conclusion: 所提框架为HAPS功率控制提供了可解析、低复杂度的解决方案，在功率效率、公平性和可行性方面显著优于现有启发式方法，且计算开销远低于LP基准。

Abstract: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) are a promising component of non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) for wide-area connectivity. However, serving multiple users over large user footprints requires efficient power-control mechanisms that account for the unique propagation characteristics and strict power constraints of HAPS. This paper develops a tractable analytical and optimization framework for downlink power allocation in HAPS systems under statistical channel state information, 3GPP NTN path loss, and Rician fading. A closed-form expression for the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) with mean-channel maximal-ratio transmission (MRT) precoding is derived, capturing geometry-dependent inter-user interference coupling. Based on this, two power-control schemes are proposed: quality-of-service (QoS)-constrained power minimization and max-min SINR fairness. The QoS solution is obtained in closed form or through a low-complexity fixed-point iteration, while the max-min solution is obtained through bisection. Numerical results demonstrate up to 6 dB reduction in required transmit power at moderate-to-high target rates and improved worst-user SINR compared to the uniform power, inverse path-loss, and geometry-aware heuristic allocations. The proposed QoS-optimal scheme also achieves a QoS feasibility probability of approximately 0.95 at R_req = 2.5 bits/s/Hz and P_max = 35 dBm, while the uniform power, inverse path-loss, and geometry-aware heuristic allocations achieve less than 0.4. Moreover, the proposed schemes achieve performance comparable to the linear programming (LP)-based benchmarks at a fraction of the computational cost, reducing the average computation time by approximately 99.97% when K = 20.

</details>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [277] [Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10552)
*Yufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示参数高效微调比较中"共享学习率"的系统性混淆：当各方案可训练参数量差异大时，共享学习率会压低大参数方案的均值并放大其方差，从而伪造出最小参数方案的"显著优势"。在SVD后处理式KV缓存压缩场景中，冻结解码器、仅微调编码器在共享学习率下看似明显胜出，但为每个方案单独调优学习率后该优势消失，仅编码器微调与替代方案持平，同时真实节省3倍可训练参数与3倍优化器状态内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在比较参数高效微调（PEFT）配方时，常见做法是让所有对比方案共用同一学习率。但当各方案可训练参数量差异很大时，共享学习率会不成比例地惩罚参数量更大的方案——既降低其性能均值，又增大其方差，从而制造出小参数方案"跨多种子显著更优"的假象，而这种优势并非真实效应。作者希望在一个具体且实用的场景（SVD后处理式KV缓存压缩）中记录这一混淆，并给出正确的比较与更优的部署方案。

Method: 场景为后处理SVD式KV缓存压缩：将已预训练模型的key/value权重因式分解为下投影（encoder）与上投影（decoder），得到低秩（类MHA风格）缓存，再通过短程微调（healing）恢复截断损失的精度。对比三种healing方案：仅encoder、仅decoder、以及两者同时微调。关键做法是摒弃共享学习率，改为对每个方案单独进行学习率调优（per-arm LR tuning），并在每套配置上运行3个随机种子。在视觉语言模型Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct上，于该协议覆盖的一个压缩比下验证；并在纯文本testbed上跨两个骨干网络进行复现。

Result: 在共享学习率下，冻结decoder、仅healing encoder 看起来明显优于healing decoder或两者同时微调；然而一旦给每个方案配上各自调优的学习率，这一表面优势完全消失。仅encoder微调转而与其它替代方案达到性能持平（parity），同时带来可实测的真实收益：可训练参数减少3倍，优化器状态内存减少3倍。该结论在Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct上以逐方案学习率调优+每配置3个种子得到验证，并在纯文本testbed上跨两个骨干网络复现。

Conclusion: 仅encoder的healing是一种低内存的即插即用配方，可在训练时对低秩KV缓存压缩进行改造（retrofit）。更重要的是，本文记录并纠正的"共享学习率陷阱"是一个具有警示意义的结果：在比较任何可训练参数量不同的微调配方时，都必须避免共享学习率，否则会得到虚假的显著性结论。

Abstract: Comparing parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes under a single, shared learning rate is a common but flawed practice: when the arms being compared have very different trainable-parameter counts, a shared rate can simultaneously depress the larger arms' means and inflate their variance, manufacturing a large, seemingly multi-seed-significant advantage for the smallest arm that is not a real effect. We document this confound in a concrete setting: post-hoc SVD-based KV-cache compression, where an already-pretrained model is converted to a low-rank (multi-head-latent-attention-style) cache by factorizing its key/value weights into a down-projection ("encoder") and an up-projection ("decoder"), after which a short fine-tune ("healing") recovers the accuracy lost to truncation.
