Method: 从共享图表示出发，通过控制中心粒度与邻域混合构造决策源；对每个源进行复制以检验稳定性，并利用节点对共分配（co-assignment）选取互补子集；将所选源的一致预测排序后用于学生模型训练。

Result: 在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 公开固定划分、5 个随机种子上，相较三种常规初始化 GCN 源，固定预算训练伪标签精度提升 1.19–4.39 个百分点；在匹配结构过滤条件下，三源共识在全部 45 个数据集-槽-种子比较中均优于各组成源。收益主要体现在伪标签质量，下游准确率具竞争力但并非每个数据集都领先。

Conclusion: 结果表明确认源构建（而非单纯增加模型数量）是共识式伪标签学习的重要设计问题。

Abstract: Consensus can make pseudo-label learning more reliable, but only when its predictors contribute genuinely different evidence. Multiple models that repeat the same boundary provide additional votes without additional information. We address this problem by con structing decision sources through controlled changes to within-class structure. Starting from a shared graph representation, we vary center granularity and neighborhood mixing, reproduce each resulting source to test its stability, and select a complementary subset using node pair coassignment. Unanimous predictions from the selected sources are then ranked for student training. On the public fixed splits of Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed, evaluated with five random seeds, the constructed sources improve fixed-budget training pseudo-label precision by 1.19 to 4.39 percentage points over three conventionally initialized GCN sources. Under matched structural filters, three-source consensus is more precise than each constituent source in all 45 dataset slot eed comparisons. The gains are strongest in pseudo-label quality: downstream accuracy remains competitive but does not lead on every dataset. These results identify source construction rather than model count alone as an important design problem for consensus-based pseudo-label learning.

</details>


### [381] [Beyond Action Entropy: Quotient-Space Exploration for Genome-Scale Metabolic Model Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11627)
*Xuan Gong,Hanbo Huang,Wenbin Dai,Jing Wang,Lei Bai,Xiang Xiao,Weishu Zhao,Shiyu Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 QuotientPO，将等价修复折叠为规范机制并在商空间上直接优化探索，用于基因组尺度代谢模型（GEM）修复，配合核化 Rényi 估计器区分不同修复核心的拥挤程度，在 2,212 个测试 GEM 上将 Success@32 从 17.93% 提升至 20.10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从功能观测修复科学模型与监督预测本质不同：反馈可能仅证明解有效，却不揭示哪个结构修正起决定作用。在 GEM 修复中，多个反应编辑可解释同一表型，且许多看似不同的编辑实为同一生物机制，这种多对一结构导致常规探索的隐藏失效模式——输出空间的多样性未必对应科学假设的多样性。

Method: 提出 QuotientPO：将等价修复坍缩为规范机制，并在所得商空间上直接优化探索；为在有限采样下使商空间探索具有信息量，推导核化 Rényi 估计器，以刻画不同修复核心之间的分级拥挤程度，超越粗略的精确匹配计数。

Result: 在 2,212 个留出 GEM 上，QuotientPO 将 Success@32 从 17.93% 提升至 20.10%（相对提升 12.1%），并在相同采样预算下持续增加不同成功核心的发现数量。

Conclusion: 商空间探索是应对验证器诱导等价下机制级发现的一种有原则的方法。

Abstract: Repairing scientific models from functional observations differs fundamentally from supervised prediction: feedback may certify a solution without revealing which structural correction is responsible. We study this setting for genome-scale metabolic model (GEM) repair, where multiple reaction edits can explain the same phenotypes and many apparently distinct edits correspond to the same biological mechanism. This many-to-one structure creates a hidden failure mode for conventional exploration: diversity in the output space need not translate into diversity of scientific hypotheses. We introduce QuotientPO, which collapses equivalent repairs into canonical mechanisms and optimizes exploration directly over the resulting quotient space. To make quotient exploration informative under finite rollouts, we derive a kernelized Rényi estimator that resolves graded crowding among distinct repair cores beyond coarse exact-match counts. On 2,212 held-out GEMs, QuotientPO improves Success@32 from 17.93% to 20.10% (+12.1% relative) while consistently increasing distinct successful-core discovery under the same sampling budget. These results establish quotient-space exploration as a principled approach to mechanism-level discovery under verifier-induced equivalence.

</details>


### [382] [Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11665)
*Jiran Tao,Yifan Wu,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Evi-VN 框架，首次利用特征隔离的证据链校正多个 GNN 共享的困难区域，实现对伪装欺诈者的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线平台中机器人、虚假评论和诈骗账号模仿正常用户，导致图邻域与行为属性被混淆；多种 GNN 在共享困难区域出现重叠错误，而现有欺诈专用 GNN 未充分利用异构证据且统一多模态融合可能干扰可靠节点。

Method: Evi-VN 不构建新的欺诈检测器，而是学习并校正共享盲区。通过特征隔离的证据链，跨结构化、文本、视觉与声学源连接行为、内容与上下文；并借助虚拟类节点，仅对可能的困难样本选择性地应用证据，从而保留现有 GNN 的可靠预测与输入设计。

Result: 在机器人、虚假评论、退款证据和电信欺诈任务上的实验验证了上述优势；共享困难区域使 Evi-VN 即使在证据模型不完美时也能增强通用、欺诈专用及未见过的 GNN。

Conclusion: Evi-VN 通过证据链校正 GNN 共享困难区域，有效暴露图邻域难以捕捉的伪装，并可增强多种 GNN 的欺诈检测能力。

Abstract: Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Crucially, Evi-VN selectively applies this evidence only to likely hard samples via virtual class nodes, preserving both the reliable predictions and the input design of existing GNNs. Shared hard regions also let Evi-VN enhance generic, fraud-specific, and unseen GNNs even with imperfect evidence models. Experiments across bot, fake-review, refund-evidence, and telecom-fraud tasks validate these advantages.

</details>


### [383] [Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11670)
*Nikhil Verma,Siddharthan Dileep,Anoop Singh,Srikanth Sastry,Ramya Hebbalaguppe,Sayan Ranu,N. M. Anoop Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 扩散模型的记忆现象在学习能量景观的几何结构中先于生成样本出现，称为"潜在记忆"；循环去噪可探测该结构，揭示训练样本与退化吸引子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准记忆检测仅在单次生成产生近拷贝时才报警，导致已发布模型在输出失败前处于未被审计状态。作者希望找到一种能提前、从分布几何层面识别记忆的方法。

Method: 使用分数散度与吸引域体积度量学习能量景观；发现训练样本周围在记忆样本出现前先形成局部吸引域，其起始时间遵循与记忆时间相同的O(n)标度。用循环去噪（反复施加部分加噪与去噪）探测吸引域，并在精确经验分数下证明靠近孤立训练样本的循环可高概率恢复并返回该样本。在Gaussian mixture、CelebA、CIFAR-10及Stable Diffusion v1.4上验证，并测量条件-无条件散度差距。

Result: 循环去噪可从单次样本无拷贝的CelebA/CIFAR-10检查点恢复训练图像；在单次拷贝率0.1%的CelebA检查点，500次循环将记忆比例提升至30%以上。同时发现非匹配任何单张训练图像的退化吸引子，随训练减弱。在Stable Diffusion v1.4上，循环条件-无条件散度差距区分记忆与非记忆提示，AUC达0.944，1% FPR下TPR为0.866。

Conclusion: 扩散模型所记忆的内容是其学习分布几何与稳定性的性质，需通过考察分布结构而非仅生成输出来评估记忆，循环去噪为一种有效的结构化审计手段。

Abstract: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also reveals degenerate attractors that match no single training image and fade as training proceeds, so residence in a basin does not by itself imply memorization. These findings hold on a Gaussian mixture, CelebA, and CIFAR-10 across optimizers, architectures, noise schedules, and training-set sizes, and extend to off-the-shelf Stable Diffusion v1.4, where the cycled conditional-unconditional divergence gap separates memorized from non-memorized prompts with an AUC of 0.944 and a TPR of 0.866 at 1% FPR. More broadly, what a diffusion model has memorized is a property of the geometry and stability of its learned distribution, and assessing it requires examining this structure rather than generated outputs alone.

</details>


### [384] [4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11716)
*Jongwook Kim,Sangheon Yun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种4-张量注意力模型，用于预测场景的下一语义状态，在ROCStories上以更少训练时间和更低交叉熵优于自由运行的一维Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望以统一的注意力更新机制来预测场景的下一语义状态，并将编码器、渲染器和规划器置于更新之外，从而单独检验该更新本身的效果。

Method: 采用4-张量注意力模型，窗口中的状态具有位置(x,t)以及语义纤维和时间上下文纤维两条纤维，并由一个softmax在窗口上联合归一化注意力；帧与智能体情境均写成这些状态。在ROCStories上训练，每个窗口在语义层施加相同的下一句预测任务，并与自由运行的一维Transformer进行对比。

Result: 验证集上（每组设置一个随机种子），4-张量模型在三个匹配设置下的末句交叉熵均低于自由运行的一维Transformer：H=2,L=2时低5.3%，H=4,L=2时低2.6%，H=4,L=3时低2.4%。在H=4,L=2时参数量几乎相同（172.5M与175.9M）。在相同两块GPU上，4-张量运行2.4小时完成，基线运行45.2小时完成，基线采用自由运行解码，每个目标token需一次顺序前向传播。

Conclusion: 4-张量注意力更新在语义层下一状态预测任务上相比自由运行的一维Transformer取得了更低的交叉熵和显著更短的训练时间，且参数量相近，表明该更新机制本身具有效率与效果优势。

Abstract: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

</details>


### [385] [Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11683)
*Danil Davydov,Bader Rasheed,Dmitriy Vatolin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在 FaceForensics++ 上验证 Noiseprint++ 噪声残差通道对 RGB Xception 人脸换脸检测是否具有互补信息：三模型消融显示融合不如纯 RGB，噪声分支单独近随机；七级瓶颈诊断定位到 InstanceNorm 抹除了残差的一阶/二阶统计量（AUC 0.747→0.554），结论是噪声残差与 RGB 冗余而非互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将学习到的相机噪声指纹与 RGB 外观骨干融合，被视为实现"生成器无关"深度伪造检测的可行路径，因为噪声残差源于图像成像物理，而非特定生成器的纹理统计。本文旨在检验这一直觉是否成立：Noiseprint++ 残差通道相对 RGB Xception 骨干，对人脸换脸检测是否携带互补信息。

Method: 在 FaceForensics++ 上做三模型消融（仅 RGB、仅残差、晚期融合）；进一步采用七级 bottleneck 诊断定位信息损失环节；用五折交叉验证 AUC 量化统计信号；并设置 context-crop 对照排除裁剪几何因素，以及两种去除瓶颈的固定融合变体作为补充验证。

Result: 融合未优于纯 RGB，残差单独分支接近随机水平；七级瓶颈诊断表明噪声图确实含判别信号，但该信号是统计性的，由残差的逐样本一阶与二阶矩（均值、方差、能量）承载，而按 TruFor 模板置于噪声分支输入的逐样本 InstanceNorm 恰好把这些矩标准化掉（五折交叉验证 AUC 从 0.747 降至 0.554）；context-crop 对照排除裁剪几何影响，两种固定融合变体恢复统计信号后，在所有数据集上仍无法超越 RGB。

Conclusion: 在该操作分布下，噪声残差与 RGB 是冗余关系而非互补关系。论文为采用噪声残差融合做人脸换脸检测的实践者提供了具体建议，例如谨慎使用输入端 InstanceNorm 以免抹除判别性统计量。

Abstract: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.

</details>


### [386] [Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11724)
*Kushal Kanwar,Dushyant Singh Chauhan,Kapil Rana,Gopendra Vikram Singh,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图文模因中性别化经济依赖判断的偏差问题，提出CGER-Net，通过"证据充分性估计+证据门控推理"机制抑制证据不足时的过度推断，在EconMeme-GE数据集上将模糊样本的性别过度承诺率最多降低44%，同时保持清晰样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模因理解被广泛用于分析社会敏感内容，但现有模型在模糊情境下解读经济依赖与社会角色时存在偏见。许多模因仅以稀疏文本或符号化视觉线索表达经济关系，证据不足以支撑性别归因；在这种信息不充分（underspecified）的场景中，模型易依赖预训练相关性，产生幻觉性和刻板化的经济角色指派。作者将这种"在缺乏充分证据时仍推断角色"的现象定义为认知性过度承诺（epistemic overcommitment），并视其为主要偏见来源。

Method: 提出CGER-Net——一个基于语境（context-grounded）的多模态框架。其核心包含两点：(1) 证据充分性估计，判断输入是否为性别化经济推理提供了足够证据；(2) 证据门控推断（evidence-gated inference），当线索明确时给出有信心的归因，否则倾向于有原则的弃权（abstention）。同时构建了EconMeme-GE数据集，对图文模因在Men、Women、Neutral、Ambiguous四类上进行标注。

Result: 在多个强当代多模态基线上，CGER-Net在模糊实例上的性别过度承诺率（Gender Overcommitment Rate）最多降低44%，同时在非模糊样本上保持相当的准确率。人工评估显示，79%的生成理由（rationales）被判定为与可用证据在认知上一致。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对"何时不应推断"进行建模，对于可靠且负责任的多模态分析至关重要。

Abstract: Multimodal meme understanding is increasingly used to analyze socially sensitive content, yet existing models often exhibit biased behavior when interpreting economic dependence and social roles under ambiguity. Many memes express economic relationships through sparse text or symbolic visual cues, providing insufficient evidence for gendered attribution. In such underspecified settings, models tend to rely on pretraining correlations, leading to hallucinated and stereotypical economic role assignments. In this work, we study gendered economic dependence in image-text memes through the lens of contextual sufficiency and identify epistemic overcommitment-inferring roles without adequate evidence-as a primary source of bias. We propose CGER-Net, a context-grounded multimodal framework that estimates whether the input provides sufficient evidence for gendered economic reasoning and applies evidence-gated inference to enable confident attribution when cues are explicit while favoring principled abstention otherwise. We evaluate CGER-Net on EconMeme-GE, a curated dataset of image-text memes annotated as Men, Women, Neutral, or Ambiguous. Across strong contemporary multimodal baselines, CGER-Net reduces Gender Overcommitment Rate by up to 44% on ambiguous instances while maintaining comparable accuracy on unambiguous cases. Human evaluation further shows that 79% of generated rationales are judged as epistemically aligned with the available evidence. These results highlight the importance of modeling when not to infer for reliable and responsible multimodal analysis.

</details>


### [387] [Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12002)
*Jiahao Lu,Mohan Kankanhalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Agentic-TTT：学习一个测试时策略，自主决定何时进行测试时训练（TTT）、调用哪种 TTT 算法、以及是否复用已有技能，从而提升模型自我改进的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTT 通过测试输入信号更新 LLM 参数，在 IMO 竞赛等预设场景中效果显著，是把部署经验转化为参数更新的自我改进机制。但 TTT 并非普遍有效：各算法适用场景不同，方法选择不当会浪费测试时算力甚至损害性能。因此参数级自我改进需要"能动性"，即模型需自行判断 TTT 是否必要、调用哪种算法、能否复用已有技能。现有工作缺乏承担这些决策的机制。

Method: Agentic-TTT 将 TTT 过程封装为可调用工具，把累积技能视为不断演化的部署环境，并利用决策带来的观测效用增益来训练测试时策略。

Result: 在所提基准上，Agentic-TTT 将效用相对骨干模型提升近两倍，能学习在效用与算力之间权衡，并可泛化到训练中未见的领域。

Conclusion: 结果表明通向自主自我改进的路径：模型能够自主决定如何从自身部署经验中学习。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

</details>


### [388] [Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11730)
*Dmitrii Andriianov,Andrey Veprikov,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出谱权重衰减（spectral weight decay），一种后步解耦的核范数更新，采用加性而非乘性的谱收缩来替代忽略谱结构的标准权重衰减，从而降低有效秩、提升压缩与推理效率并增强抗噪能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准权重衰减将每个权重矩阵视为向量，忽略其谱结构。作者希望利用谱结构实现更紧的权重张量收缩，改善模型压缩与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出谱权重衰减：一种后步解耦的核范数（nuclear-norm）更新，对权重矩阵做加性谱收缩而非乘性收缩；将更新与近似近端下降（proximal descent）建立联系，并分析其对更新顺序的敏感性，指出在接近秩亏（rank deficiency）时其敏感性超过常规ℓ2权重衰减。

Result: 在124M–500M参数的LLaMA模型上，谱权重衰减降低有效秩，并在匹配验证损失下改进SVD-LLM压缩：500M、4%失真预算时达到1.89×压缩与1.18×GPU推理加速（标准权重衰减为1.14×与1.01×）。在60%标签噪声的固定训练时限下，相比匹配的ℓ2正则，MNIST干净测试准确率提升最高17.8个百分点，四个BERT-base任务平均提升4.6个百分点。

Conclusion: 谱权重衰减通过加性谱收缩利用权重矩阵的谱结构，有效降低有效秩、提升压缩与推理效率，并在强噪声与分布多样的任务中优于ℓ2权重衰减，代码已开源。

Abstract: Standard weight decay treats each weight matrix as a vector and ignores its spectral structure. We introduce spectral weight decay, a post-step decoupled nuclear-norm update that applies additive rather than multiplicative spectral shrinkage. We connect the update to approximate proximal descent and show that its sensitivity to update order can exceed that of conventional $\ell_2$ weight decay near rank deficiency. Across LLaMA models with $124$M to $500$M parameters, spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss. At $500$M and a $4\%$ distortion budget, it reaches $1.89\times$ compression and $1.18\times$ GPU inference speedup, compared with $1.14\times$ and $1.01\times$ after standard weight decay. Under fixed-horizon training with $60\%$ label noise, it also improves final mean clean-test accuracy over matched $\ell_2$ regularization by up to $17.8$ points on MNIST and $4.6$ points across four BERT-base tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SpectralWD.

</details>


### [389] [Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11734)
*Haoran Zhang,Haixuan Liu,Xingjian Su,Yong Liu,Zhi Chen,Yuxuan Wang,Jianmin Wang,Mingsheng Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Timer-M1：基于基元（primitives）数据合成与预训练的多元时间序列基础模型，面向零样本预测，在FEV、TIME、GIFT-Eval等基准上表现领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 各领域时间序列共享基础的时序与关系模式（称为基元），但其在不同上下文中的表现形式与演化方式各异。现有零样本与任务通用预测的基础模型在复杂真实场景下泛化能力仍显不足，因此需要一种以基元为核心的预训练范式来提升跨领域、跨任务的泛化性。

Method: 提出基元驱动的数据合成与预训练流水线：合成阶段生成跨领域共享的时序基元序列，并借助关系基元将真实与合成序列组装为多元样本；随后按通道角色（目标变量、仅历史协变量、已知未来协变量）将样本组织为episode，使模型利用可用外生信息在可预测变量上优化。模型结构上，Timer-M1采用门控二维Transformer块，在层间动态分配跨变量注意力。

Result: 在三个大规模预测基准上，Timer-M1在FEV与TIME上排名第一，在GIFT-Eval上排名第二（与最新时间序列基础模型相比）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于基元的预训练是通向跨领域、跨任务设定的稳健通用预测技术的有效路径。

Abstract: We introduce Timer-M1, a pretrained multivariate time series foundation model that learns with primitives for zero-shot forecasting. Across domains, time series share elementary temporal and relational patterns, termed primitives, yet differ in how these primitives manifest and evolve across different contexts. Despite progress in zero-shot and task-general forecasting, existing foundation models may still struggle to generalize to complex real-world scenarios. To this end, we develop a primitive-based data synthesis and pretraining pipeline. The synthesis pipeline generates series with temporal primitives shared across domains and then assembles real and generated series into multivariate samples using relational primitives. Afterwards, samples are organized into episodes by assigning distinct channel roles as target variates, past-only covariates, and known-future covariates, ensuring that the model is optimized on predictable variates using available exogenous information. Technically, Timer-M1 further adapts gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks that dynamically allocate cross-variate attention across layers. Across three large-scale forecasting benchmarks, Timer-M1 ranks first on both FEV and TIME and second on GIFT-Eval among most recent time series foundation models. These results support effective primitive-based pretraining as a route to robust general forecasting technique across domains and task settings.

</details>


### [390] [Uncovering and Fixing Collider Bias in Bayesian PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11737)
*Michael Obermayr,Robert Peharz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示B-PINNs的碰撞体结构会导致物理参数后验严重系统性偏差，提出层级链式模型替代方案，并通过离散化随机动力学使链式后验可用粒子MCMC精确采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B-PINNs广泛用于稀疏或含噪观测下的参数与状态推断，但其常见的碰撞体（collider）结构假设物理参数与轨迹参数先验独立、仅通过微分方程残差的虚拟似然耦合。作者发现这一建模选择可能在物理参数后验中引入严重系统性偏差：即使先验有利地位于真实参数附近，后验仍会远离并集中到偏离真值处。因此需要诊断该偏差并寻找无偏的替代建模方式。

Method: 1) 从碰撞体结构出发，理论分析其后验偏差，识别出两种不同的偏差机制，并推导偏差幅度的解析近似；2) 提出层级链式模型：物理参数生成轨迹、轨迹再生成观测，从而避免碰撞体偏差；3) 针对链式模型中因物理相关归一化常数导致的doubly intractable推断难题，通过对底层随机动力学进行离散化，使链式后验可用粒子MCMC精确采样；4) 建立诊断准则以预测标准B-PINNs何时仍然可靠。

Result: 实验验证了所预测的偏差现象，并表明链式表述能够成功避免该偏差；同时给出的解析近似与诊断准则可预判标准B-PINNs的可靠性。

Conclusion: 标准B-PINNs的碰撞体建模范式存在结构性后验偏差，作者通过两种机制的解析刻画和诊断准则界定了其适用边界，并提出链式模型加离散化粒子MCMC的可行替代方案，在实验中有效消除了偏差。

Abstract: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks (B-PINNs) are a popular framework for parameter and state inference from sparse or noisy observations. They are commonly formulated via a collider structure, in which physical and trajectory parameters are assumed to be a priori independent and become coupled through virtual likelihoods on differential-equation residuals that enforce physical consistency. We show that this modeling choice can induce severe systematic bias in the posterior over physical parameters: even when the prior is favorably centered on the ground-truth parameters, the resulting posterior can drift away and concentrate far from them. As a remedy, we advocate a hierarchical chain model in which physics generates trajectories, which in turn generate observations. The chain model does not suffer from this posterior bias, but it poses a harder, so-called doubly intractable, inference problem due to a physics-dependent normalization constant. This challenge can be resolved by discretizing the underlying stochastic dynamics, after which the chain posterior can be sampled exactly with particle MCMC. We identify two distinct mechanisms characterizing the collider bias, derive analytical approximations of their magnitudes, and establish diagnostic criteria for predicting when standard B-PINNs remain reliable. Experiments confirm the predicted bias and show that the chain formulation successfully avoids it.

</details>


### [391] [When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12161)
*Fei Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析KL正则与奖励交互中的七种失败模式，并提出零和校准策略优化（ZCPO），用条件KL衡量的相对漂移校准组内奖励系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者观察到移除参考策略KL正则有时能改进组策略优化，由此出发研究参考策略信息应以何种方式进入组相对更新。

Method: 系统分析KL与奖励交互中的七种潜在失败模式（奖励裁剪后的残差KL更新、梯度抵消后、组内奖励相同、KL随响应长度增长及相对贡献失衡、KL集中于少量token、k1并入奖励时的采样噪声），并提出ZCPO：用条件KL度量的相对漂移校准组内奖励系数，并整合进基础代理目标。

Result: 数学推理实验与消融实验支持该设计在作者设定下的有效性。

Conclusion: 参考策略信息应通过条件KL刻画的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数，而非简单进行KL正则；ZCPO为此提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.

</details>


### [392] [Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11740)
*Konstantinos Fotopoulos,Petros Maragos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种受乘性权重更新（MWU）启发的形态学神经网络权重更新方法，用相关性奖励替代梯度信号，在九个基准中的八个上取得提升，最高达32.84个百分点，并显著降低运行间波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络通常用一阶方法和反向传播训练，但形态学层的权重雅可比稀疏，导致参数梯度质量差，这种训练方式是否最优尚不清楚。

Method: 将每个形态学感知机视为对数空间中的专家建议学习问题，提出基于乘性权重更新（MWU）的权重更新方案，采用相关性奖励，偏好与期望输出变化方向一致的输入，而不依赖强梯度信号是否到达其权重。

Result: 在全连接层（作为独立模型及作为更大Transformer网络的一部分）上进行实证评估，九个基准中八个有提升，最高提升32.84个百分点，同时大幅降低运行间方差。

Conclusion: 相关性训练为梯度质量差的形态学层提供了有效的替代优化途径，可提升性能并增强训练稳定性。

Abstract: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.

</details>


### [393] [TraceRelay: Attention-Aligned Recurrence over Rolling Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11743)
*Sungwoo Goo,Hwi-yeol Yun,Sangkeun Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceRelay：一种注意力对齐的循环架构，将持久表示分布在滚动序列的低维 trace 上，通过延迟递送、固定加性相位递推与左向注意力读取残差增强流，并以分段前缀和实现并行预填充。在 3 类任务、36 组小模型运行中验证了循环相位继承的关键作用及循环表示维度与任务间的差异化影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列模型在长序列上需兼顾并行预填充与有界缓冲的持续计算，且缺乏对"循环表示的持久化方式"与注意力对齐机制的系统研究。作者希望探索将持久状态分布到低维 trace 序列上、并与因果注意力对齐的设计，以及循环表示维度选择对不同任务的影响。

Method: 架构采用"注意力对齐的循环"设计：局部右向注意力从低层表示生成增量，递送延迟至所有被注意输入落入因果过去；固定加性相位递推累积延迟增量；左向注意力读取残差增强后的流；分段前缀和支持并行预填充与有界缓冲续算。实验在 Equal Repeats、有界 Dyck 闭合类型预测与因果 Most-Freq 生成三个任务上，进行 36 组小模型运行，每种设置三个随机种子，训练长度 256 并外推到更长序列。

Result: 训练长度 256 时，带循环相位继承的 Equal Repeats 模型准确率 98.81–99.69%，而无继承的独立训练变体仅 50.73–51.63%，尽管后者获得更多更新；长度超出训练范围后准确率急剧下降。在最长评测长度上，中层循环 trace 维度更大的模型在 Dyck 上更优（长度 4096 时闭合准确率 76.34% vs 55.49%），而 trace 维度更小的模型在五符号 Most-Freq 上更优（长度 1024 时精确生成 70.74% vs 55.60%）。

Conclusion: 循环相位继承对模型性能起决定性作用，远胜于增加训练更新量；循环表示维度的影响具有任务依赖性，呈现相反的偏好方向。这些对比案例表明需要进一步研究如何针对不同任务选择循环表示规模，但本文尚未建立跨任务或跨模型配置的通用规则。

Abstract: We present TraceRelay, an attention-aligned recurrent architecture that distributes persistent representations over a rolling sequence of low-dimensional traces. Local right looking attention forms increments from lower-layer representations; delivery is delayed until all attended inputs are in the causal past. A fixed additive phase recurrence accumulates the delayed increments, and left-looking attention reads the resulting residual augmented stream. A stride-wise prefix sum supports parallel prefill and bounded-buffer continuation. We study 36 small-model runs on Equal Repeats, bounded Dyck closing-type prediction, and causal Most-Freq generation, using three seeds per setting. At trained length 256, Equal Repeats models with recurrent phase inheritance reach 98.81-99.69% accuracy versus 50.73-51.63% for separately trained variants without inheritance, despite the latter receiving more updates. Accuracy drops sharply at lengths beyond the training range. At the longest evaluated lengths, models with more dimensions in the middle layer's recurrent traces perform better on Dyck (76.34% versus 55.49% close accuracy at length 4096), whereas models with fewer trace dimensions perform better on five-symbol Most-Freq (70.74% versus 55.60% exact generation at length 1024). These contrasting cases motivate further study of how the size of recurrent representations should be chosen for different tasks, without establishing a general rule across tasks or model configurations.

</details>


### [394] [SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12327)
*Qitong Wang,Xinwei Niu,Mingluo Su,Shanwei Zhao,Shiai Zhu,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SparseDecoding 剪枝框架，通过使用解码阶段自生成激活构建校准矩阵并对齐剪枝目标，配合优化的 N:M SpMV 内核，在保持生成质量的同时实现最高 1.48 倍的端到端解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 解码阶段受内存带宽限制，延迟显著。基于 Hessian 的免训练逐层剪枝可减少解码时读取的非零参数量，但现有方法用预先采集的自然序列计算 Hessian，而解码时输入为自生成 token，导致分布偏移：自然序列与生成序列上的 Hessian 不一致，使生成阶段激活分布偏离剪枝所用分布，损害剪枝模型性能。此外，现有能带来实际加速的剪枝方法主要针对稀疏矩阵-矩阵乘（SpMM），对解码主导的稀疏矩阵-向量乘（SpMV）支持有限。

Method: SparseDecoding 从算法与系统两个层面展开。算法层面：从稠密模型自回归生成过程中逐层采集激活构建校准矩阵，并排除 prefill 阶段，使剪枝目标与解码激活对齐。系统层面：设计优化的 N:M 稀疏矩阵-向量内核，采用位掩码索引（bitmask indexing）与固定步长遍历（fixed-step traversal）。

Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B / 32B 等代表性 LLM 上的大量实验表明，该方法在长文本生成基准上持续优于标准固定文本校准，在 A100 GPU 上实现最高 1.48 倍端到端墙钟解码加速。

Conclusion: 通过将剪枝校准与解码激活对齐并针对 SpMV 优化稀疏内核，SparseDecoding 同时提升了剪枝模型的生成精度与解码效率，缓解了分布偏移问题，弥补了现有方法在解码场景下的系统支持不足。

Abstract: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

</details>


### [395] [The Ball and the Box: Two Geometries of Computation in Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11744)
*Xiaoyu Li,Lequan Lin,Dai Shi,Jiaojiao Jiang,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究叠加表示下布尔门计算所需的维度，推导了高斯随机字典与均匀稀疏布尔输入情形下单阈值层的尖锐维度阈值，揭示了期望错误数与联合可靠性两类误差准则之间的阈值差距，并给出与、或、多数门的显式阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经表示可编码的特征数多于其维度（叠加现象），但计算布尔门时究竟需要多少维度尚不清晰。作者希望厘清不同误差准则下计算布尔门的维度需求，并解释不同准则之间可能存在的阈值差异。

Method: 针对单阈值层、高斯随机字典和均匀随机稀疏布尔输入，分别按"期望错误数消失"和"每个输出以高概率正确"两种误差准则推导维度阈值；通过共享读出（shared reads）分析误差来源，刻画期望计数阈值的球几何与联合可靠性阈值的盒几何，并优化共享读出权重与偏置。

Result: 得到两类误差准则下尖锐的维度阈值，且"期望错误数消失"所需维度多于"每个输出高概率正确"；阈值差距由共享读出解释——稀有实现可同时产生大量错误。给出合取、析取、多数门的显式阈值；对成对合取还描述了阈值附近的转变，与精确模拟一致。

Conclusion: 布尔门计算的维度需求强烈依赖误差准则，且共享读出会导致两类准则的阈值分离；球几何与盒几何分别刻画期望计数与联合可靠性阈值，理论预测与模拟吻合。

Abstract: Neural representations can encode more features than they have dimensions, a phenomenon known as superposition. We study the dimension needed to compute Boolean gates from such representations. For a single threshold layer with a Gaussian random dictionary and uniformly random sparse Boolean inputs, we derive sharp dimension thresholds under two error criteria. A vanishing expected error count can require more dimensions than correctness of every output with high probability. Shared reads explain the gap: rare realizations can produce many errors at once. The expected-count threshold has ball geometry, while joint reliability has box geometry when a gate is evaluated on every feature tuple. Optimizing shared readout weights and biases gives explicit thresholds for conjunction, disjunction, and majority. For pairwise conjunction, the analysis also describes the transition near the threshold, in agreement with exact simulations.

</details>


### [396] [SR-TTA: Spatial-Redundancy Test-Time Adaptation for Interference-Robust Respiration Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11755)
*Jingyuan Liu,Zheng Chang,Haoqiu Xiong,Zhuangzhuang Cui,Sofie Pollin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究无蜂窝大规模MIMO基站上以通信基础设施复用实现呼吸感知，提出学习式复数权重波束成形结合空间冗余测试时自适应（SR-TTA），在带内运动干扰下将呼吸率误差从5.8降至0.8 bpm，并在真实测试台上把失败率从47%降至7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G网络希望将感知作为原生服务复用通信基础设施。现有手工设计的信道融合方法在良性条件下接近最优，但在频率落入呼吸频段的强带内运动干扰下会失效。作者希望找到一种无需标签、可在部署时自适应的融合方案，并明确哪种无标签信号能有效区分带内干扰与呼吸。

Method: 在64天线无蜂窝大规模MIMO信道上，将信道融合为呼吸波形。首先采用学习式复数权重波束成形，通过空间零陷抑制带内干扰；再提出空间冗余测试时自适应（SR-TTA），在带外频谱否决约束下最大化随机天线子集间的一致性。同时给出与O-RAN架构的映射：O-DU距离门控、自适应xApp和校准rApp。

Result: 基于频率和方差的准则无法区分带内干扰与呼吸；SR-TTA在带外频谱否决下保持良性性能。在模拟带内干扰下，呼吸率误差从5.8降至0.8 bpm。在真实测试台记录上，一次性跨被试校准加SR-TTA将失败率从47%降至7%，与使用无标签测试时自适应的手工组合器持平。

Conclusion: 空间冗余是有效的无标签自适应信号，SR-TTA可在带内干扰下恢复呼吸感知，并可与手工组合器经测试时自适应达到同等性能；该流程可映射到O-RAN架构部署。

Abstract: Future 6G networks aim to expose sensing as a native service by reusing communication infrastructure. We study respiration sensing on a cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) base station, where a 64-antenna channel must be fused into a breathing waveform. The state-of-the-art hand-crafted fusion is near-optimal in benign conditions. It collapses, however, under strong in-band motion interference, whose frequency falls inside the respiration band. We show that a learned complex-weight beamformer recovers respiration by spatial nulling, and that the remaining gap to a per-recording oracle can be closed at deployment by label-free test-time adaptation. Crucially, we identify which label-free signal makes this work. Frequency- and variance-based criteria cannot separate an in-band interferer from breathing. Our spatial-redundancy test-time adaptation (SR-TTA), which maximizes consistency across random antenna subsets under an out-of-band spectral veto, preserves benign performance in our tests. The respiration-rate error drops from 5.8 to 0.8 breaths per minute (bpm) under simulated in-band interference, and the pipeline maps onto the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture as O-RAN distributed-unit (O-DU) range-gating, an adaptation xApp, and a calibration rApp. On real testbed recordings, a one-time cross-subject calibration plus SR-TTA reduces failures from 47% to 7%, drawing level with the hand-crafted combiner using label-free test-time adaptation.

</details>


### [397] [RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11761)
*Frederikke Isa Marin,Panagiotis Antoniadis,Dionysia Danai Brilli,Andreas Bjerregaard,Rachael DeVries,Yan Li,Ole Winther,Wouter Boomsma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RAGenome，首个基于检索的基因组语言模型（gLM），可将预训练上下文扩展至现有MSA类gLM的100倍，在100种脊椎动物全基因组比对数据上训练，兼顾跨物种进化建模与种内长程交互，将基因发现性能从0.45提升至0.60，同时保持致病变异优先排序任务的竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组决定细胞生物学特性，理解基因组功能对生物学与生物医学意义重大。标准gLM借鉴自然语言与蛋白质序列的语言模型思路，但计算开销极大且部分下游任务不如传统方法；基于MSA的预训练虽为高效替代方案，却受限于短输入上下文，只能处理变异效应预测等短程任务，无法捕捉种内长程相互作用。

Method: 提出RAGenome——首个基于检索（retrieval-based）的基因组语言模型，将预训练上下文长度扩展至现有MSA类gLM的100倍。模型在100种脊椎动物的全基因组比对（whole-genome alignments）数据上进行训练，通过检索机制统一建模跨物种进化关系与种内长程交互。

Result: RAGenome显著提升了MSA类gLM的长程能力：基因发现（gene finding）性能从0.45提升到0.60；在纯进化类任务（如致病变异优先排序）上仍保持竞争力；整体以远低于标准gLM的训练成本获得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: RAGenome在单一、灵活、可扩展的框架内统一了进化建模与长程能力，以更低训练成本实现有竞争力的gLM性能，为基因组语言建模提供了高效可扩展的新范式。代码已开源于 https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome。

Abstract: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100$\times$ longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.

</details>


### [398] [In-Ride Alcohol-Impairment Detection in E-Scooterists with False-Alarm Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11783)
*Marco Capuccini,Rahul Rajendra Pai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于车载传感器与惯性/油门测量的骑行者酒精损伤检测器，具备可证明的误报率上界，在141次骑行数据上验证有效并满足嵌入式实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享电动滑板车已成为广泛使用的城市交通方式，酒驾是导致严重事故的重要因素，但现有对策仅限于单点反应测试或直接夜间停服，缺乏对骑行过程的连续评估手段。

Method: 提出在行程进行中利用车载传感器持续评估骑行者状态的方法：基于惯性测量单元与油门信号构建损伤检测器，并对误报率给出可证明的上界；通过141次骑行、25名参与者在清醒及两个目标血液酒精浓度水平下的传感器数据进行实验，与基线方法和消融版本对比。

Result: 在0.023的误报率上界下，检测器识别出较高血液酒精浓度下91%的骑行、较低浓度下50%的骑行，中位检测时间分别为25秒和27秒；基线方法与消融版本或超出该上界、或损失检测性能，部分情况下还会延迟报警；嵌入式实现满足实时性要求。

Conclusion: 该方法使车载端实时缓解干预成为可能，无需数据离开车辆，也无需对清醒用户施加骑行前测试或夜间停服，同时允许运营方在误报率与用户体验之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Shared e-scooter services have become a widely adopted urban transport mode. While most users ride responsibly, alcohol intoxication stands out among the factors contributing to severe crashes. Nonetheless, countermeasures remain limited to single-point reaction tests and night bans that suspend the service altogether. This paper proposes a new approach in which onboard sensors evaluate the rider as the trip unfolds, raising an alarm as soon as enough evidence of impairment has accumulated. Specifically, we introduce a detector that operates on inertial and throttle measurements, with a provable bound on the rate of false alarms. Experiments on sensor data from 141 rides, in which 25 participants rode while sober and at two target blood alcohol concentration levels, confirm that the bound holds, whereas baselines and ablations either exceed it or lose detection performance, and in some cases delay the alarm. At a bound of 0.023, the detector identifies 91% of the rides performed at the higher concentration and 50% of those at the lower one, with median detection times of 25 and 27 seconds, respectively. We further show that an embedded implementation meets the real-time requirement, making mitigation actions feasible onboard, without requiring data to leave the vehicle. Overall, this work lays the ground for interventions that reach impaired riders as soon as possible, sparing the sober ones the burden of a pre-ride test or the suspension of the service at night, while letting operators budget false alarms against user experience.

</details>


### [399] [Discovering Global False Negatives On the Fly for Self-supervised Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20612)
*Vicente Balmaseda,Bokun Wang,Ching-Long Lin,Tianbao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GloFND，一种在自监督对比学习中在线自动学习每个锚点阈值以全局识别假负样本的优化方法，计算开销与数据集规模无关，在图像和图文数据上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督对比学习通常以锚点图像与数据集（除锚点外）中任意样本构建负样本对，容易产生语义相似的"假负样本"，导致其嵌入被错误地推开，损害表征学习质量。已有假负样本发现方法多在小批量内局部检测，存在局限。

Method: GloFND为基于优化的方法，在训练过程中为每个锚点数据在线自动学习一个阈值，用以判定其假负样本；该方法在整个数据集范围内全局检测假负样本，而非仅在mini-batch内部局部检测；同时其每次迭代的计算开销与数据集规模无关，保持良好的可扩展性。

Result: 在图像数据与图文（image-text）数据上的实验结果表明，所提方法有效，验证了其在假负样本识别与表示学习方面的优势。

Conclusion: GloFND通过在线学习每个锚点的自适应阈值，实现全局且计算高效的假负样本识别，缓解了假负样本导致的嵌入误分离问题，代码已开源于 https://github.com/vibalcam/GloFND。

Abstract: In self-supervised contrastive learning, negative pairs are typically constructed using an anchor image and a sample drawn from the entire dataset, excluding the anchor. However, this approach can result in the creation of negative pairs with similar semantics, referred to as "false negatives", leading to their embeddings being falsely pushed apart. To address this issue, we introduce GloFND, an optimization-based approach that automatically learns on the fly the threshold for each anchor data to identify its false negatives during training. In contrast to previous methods for false negative discovery, our approach globally detects false negatives across the entire dataset rather than locally within the mini-batch. Moreover, its per-iteration computation cost remains independent of the dataset size. Experimental results on image and image-text data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/vibalcam/GloFND.

</details>


### [400] [Compile the Table: Query-Calibrated Operator Compression for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11784)
*Xu Zhao,Jiaming Zhao,Bin Zhao,Yong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QCOC通过将上下文样本的KV缓存一次性编译为紧凑的联合KV原型内存并在查询间复用，在保持接近全上下文的精度同时大幅提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格上下文学习（ICL）的上下文压缩方法存在精度与吞吐的权衡：固定子集会损失精度，而查询特定检索限制了跨查询的缓存复用与批处理，降低吞吐。作者希望同时实现紧凑内存复用与高精度。

Method: QCOC（Query-Calibrated Operator Compression）利用上下文样本的可交换性与重复使用性，将其完整KV缓存一次性编译为跨查询共享的紧凑内存：不再保留原始样本，而是把其状态聚类为联合KV原型，保留每簇多重性及原样本总数，并通过锚定闭式解，用上下文样本产生的注意力查询向量校准原型值。原型压缩带来加速，值拟合有助于保持精度。

Result: 在64个留出的OpenML-CC18数据集上，QCOC在两种保留数量下均在对比的压缩与检索方法中取得最高平均精度。在七个长表的12种配置中，QCOC在10种中位列压缩方法第一，平均仅低于全上下文0.23个百分点。将8,192个上下文样本压缩到512个内存槽，缓存压缩比达10.5倍；排除一次性编译，在单核CPU上对1,000个查询进行在线服务比较时，QCOC比动态检索基线快至多508倍，比全上下文推理快1.98倍。

Conclusion: QCOC实现了紧凑内存复用与跨查询高效推理，同时保持接近全上下文的精度，验证了通过编译并复用KV缓存原型来解决表格ICL压缩中精度-吞吐权衡的有效性。

Abstract: Tabular in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a training-free and accurate paradigm for tabular prediction, but current approaches to compressing its in-context examples face an accuracy-throughput tradeoff: fixed subsets can sacrifice accuracy, while query-specific retrieval limits cache reuse and batching across queries, reducing throughput. We propose QCOC (Query-Calibrated Operator Compression), which exploits the exchangeability and repeated use of in-context examples by compiling their full KV cache once into compact memory shared across subsequent queries. Instead of retaining raw examples, QCOC clusters their states into joint-KV prototypes, preserves per-cluster multiplicities and the original example count, and calibrates prototype values against attention query vectors produced by the in-context examples through an anchored closed-form solution. Prototype compression drives the speedup, while value fitting helps preserve accuracy. On 64 held-out OpenML-CC18 datasets, QCOC achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared compression and retrieval methods at both retained counts. Across 12 configurations on seven long tables, it ranks first among compressed methods in ten and averages 0.23 percentage points below full context. Compressing 8,192 in-context examples to 512 memory slots yields a 10.5x cache compression ratio; excluding one-time compilation, in a single-core CPU online-serving comparison over 1,000 queries, QCOC is up to 508x faster than dynamic retrieval baselines and 1.98x faster than full-context inference. These results show that QCOC enables compact-memory reuse and efficient inference across queries while retaining accuracy close to full context.

</details>


### [401] [PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11803)
*Venkat Margapuri,Mustafa Teber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出协同演化框架PRAXIS，将生成器、学习器与符号档案建模为相互作用的动力系统，并从理论上界定目标漂移、档案筛选与平均稳定性，在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理和算法图推理任务上验证了理论机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自改进学习系统会自适应地调整数据选择、优化过程与辅助符号组件，导致目标函数非平稳，超出标准学习假设（如固定目标、独立同分布数据）的适用范围，因此需要新的理论刻画与框架。

Method: 构建PRAXIS协同演化框架，将生成器、学习器和符号档案视为相互作用的动力过程；采用KL约束的生成器更新与受控的档案权重移动来控制单步目标漂移；通过档案更新机制对程序进行相对固定比较器的抑制；并用随机梯度下降分析平均稳定性。

Result: 理论结果包括：KL约束的生成器更新与受控档案权重移动可界定单步目标漂移；在亚高斯噪声下，档案更新能对任意固定比较器保持持续累积效用优势从而抑制某程序；SGD获得平均稳定性保证，其退化程度由累积目标漂移控制。实验显示生成器趋于稳定、学习器损失下降、档案集中，与理论机制一致。

Conclusion: PRAXIS为自改进学习系统提供了协同演化的理论框架，揭示目标漂移、档案动态与优化稳定性之间的定量关系，并在多类任务中验证了理论预测的机制性现象。

Abstract: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.

</details>


### [402] [Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12390)
*Ziming Dai,Dabiao Ma,Ziheng Guo,Jack Dong,Zimu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLM-BlockFE：一种LLM引导的离线特征构造框架，将长文本转为可执行特征程序，实现线上推理零LLM调用，并借助块级回滚与多轨迹交错搜索提升特征质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业风控系统多依赖结构化数据建模，但长文本中含大量有价值信息；人工特征工程成本高，而在线调用LLM处理实时输入难以满足部署要求。因此需要在离线阶段利用LLM挖掘长文本信息，同时保证线上推理高效。

Method: 以增量追加不可变代码块的方式构建特征程序，用下游模型评估候选特征；引入基于深度校准信用分配的块级回滚机制，并采用交错推进多条独立搜索轨迹的方式（共享各轨迹探索方向的固定描述）降低冗余探索。搜索完成后冻结程序，部署用于抽取结构化特征供下游预测模型使用。

Result: 在两个公开与两个私有数据集的全量对比中，相较最强基线取得0.0069至0.0358的绝对AUC提升；在五个已上线的金融风控应用中，上线后监控显示相较原有人工设计策略KS绝对提升0.02至1.56个百分点。

Conclusion: LLM-BlockFE有效结合LLM的文本理解能力与程序化特征构造，在保证线上高效推理的同时，稳定提升风控预测效果，并已在真实金融风控场景中验证其业务价值。

Abstract: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.

</details>


### [403] [From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05711)
*Vicente Balmaseda,Ching-Long Lin,Tianbao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCION在单一模型中联合进行生成与自监督表征学习，无需标签或预训练模型，实现自条件生成；在ImageNet 256×256上以JiT-B取得8.92 FID，超越依赖DINOv2的iREPA与RCG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖类别标签、冻结预训练编码器或单独训练的自动编码器，生成能力受限于监督标注或域内预训练。作者希望在同一模型中联合实现生成与自监督表征学习，从而摆脱标签与预训练依赖，实现自条件生成。

Method: 提出SCION：使用单一像素空间编码器，以流匹配时间步与一个条件嵌入为条件。表征学习时，条件嵌入为跨图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器的[CLS] token 作为语义表征由对比损失训练；生成训练时，条件嵌入改为图像自身的[CLS]表征，patch token 经解码器重建图像。为在推理时无参考图像采样，联合学习嵌入上的先验分布。通过梯度范数平衡与停止梯度机制实现单次联合优化。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，采用JiT-B配方且无表征引导时达8.92 FID，优于类别无条件iREPA（对齐预训练DINOv2，46.44）和以DINOv2为条件的RCG（14.27）；采用JiT-L时无引导为5.89 FID，加入表征引导为3.47 FID，超过使用ADM配方的RCG（6.24）。

Conclusion: SCION验证了自监督、自包含的联合生成与表征学习框架的可行性，无需标签或预训练模型即可取得具竞争力的生成质量，说明调和对比学习与流匹配的目标冲突可通过条件嵌入共享与梯度控制实现，为统一生成与表征学习提供了新思路。

Abstract: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

</details>


### [404] [Recovery Guarantees for Posterior Sampling of One-Bit Compressed Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11834)
*Jing Ma,Yujia Wu,Zhaoqiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于先验分布的噪声一比特压缩感知样本复杂度，证明后验采样在测量数随近似覆盖数对数（乘以一比特分离间隔因子）增长时可高概率精确恢复，且对先验失配有鲁棒性，并给出近乎匹配的下界；同时用扩散先验的即插即用算法在FFHQ和ImageNet上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有噪声一比特压缩感知的样本复杂度分析多未充分利用信号先验分布信息，且实际中学习到的先验往往与真实分布存在偏差；因此需要刻画先验对样本复杂度的作用，并理解先验失配下方法的可靠性。

Method: 以先验的近似覆盖数刻画分布复杂度，分析后验采样在噪声一比特压缩感知中的恢复性能；用Wasserstein距离度量近似先验与真实分布的接近程度以建立失配鲁棒性；给出任意可靠方法的下界；并用扩散先验构造成即插即用的后验采样算法。

Result: 当测量数与近似覆盖数的对数成正比（最多相差一个一比特分离间隔因子）时，后验采样可高概率准确恢复；若学习先验在Wasserstein距离下足够接近真实分布，则恢复仍可靠。下界表明上界的主要先验相关项近乎最优。FFHQ和ImageNet实验验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 先验的分布复杂度（近似覆盖数）决定了噪声一比特压缩感知的样本复杂度，后验采样可达到近乎最优的样本复杂度并容忍先验失配；扩散先验的即插即用实现使该方法在真实图像数据上有效。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of noisy one-bit compressed sensing for signals drawn from a prior distribution. By characterizing the effective distributional complexity of the prior via its approximate covering number, we prove that posterior sampling achieves accurate recovery with high probability when the number of measurements scales with the logarithm of the approximate covering number, up to a one-bit separation gap factor. This upper bound is robust to learned prior mismatch. Specifically, we show that posterior sampling with an approximate prior remains reliable, provided that the learned prior distribution is sufficiently close to the true signal distribution in Wasserstein distance. In addition, we establish a sample complexity lower bound for any reliable method of noisy one-bit compressed sensing, showing that our upper bound is nearly matched in its main prior dependent term. To approximate the ideal posterior sampling process for real world scenarios, we instantiate posterior sampling through a plug-and-play algorithm with diffusion priors. Experiments on the FFHQ and ImageNet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

</details>


### [405] [DADP: Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning, A Reverse Hebbian-Inspired Structural Pruning Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11853)
*Bhushan Deshpande*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出动态活动依赖剪枝（DADP），一种受生物启发的结构可塑性机制，通过全局阈值动态分配稀疏度，在多种架构上以99%稀疏度保持性能并避免表征坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络过度参数化带来大量计算和内存开销；现有剪枝方法依赖事后幅值阈值或静态初始化启发式，需要手动设定逐层稀疏目标或昂贵的重训练循环。

Method: DADP在训练中通过突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积衡量连接重要性，使用单一全局阈值而非固定层预算，动态跨网络深度分配稀疏度，并自然诱导神经元级和通道级剪枝。

Result: 在MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF和MiniBERT上，DADP达到或超越Magnitude、SNIP和RigL；ResNet-18在99%稀疏度下保留73.67%准确率（稠密基线76.06%）；矩阵香农熵和有效秩测量证实DADP在极端稀疏度下保持潜在特征多样性，无表征坍缩。

Conclusion: DADP作为无需逐层预算、生物启发的动态结构剪枝机制，能在极端稀疏度下维持性能与特征多样性，为高效网络压缩提供有效方案。

Abstract: Modern neural networks are heavily over-parameterized. This redundancy incurs substantial compute and memory overhead during training and inference. Existing pruning methods rely on post-hoc magnitude thresholds or static initialization heuristics. Consequently, they often require manual per-layer sparsity targets or expensive retraining cycles. We propose Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning (DADP), a biologically inspired structural plasticity mechanism. During training, DADP measures connection importance via the accumulated product of pre-synaptic activations and post-synaptic error gradients. Using a single global threshold instead of fixed layer budgets, DADP dynamically allocates sparsity across network depth while naturally inducing neuron- and channel-level pruning. Across MLP, VGG-16, ResNet-18, BiLSTM-CRF, and MiniBERT architectures, DADP matches or outperforms Magnitude, SNIP and RigL, retaining 73.67% accuracy (dense baseline: 76.06%) at 99% sparsity on ResNet-18. Finally, matrix-based Shannon entropy and effective rank measurements confirm that DADP preserves latent feature diversity at extreme sparsities without representation collapse.

</details>


### [406] [GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11854)
*Hexuan Deng,Zihao Yan,Xuebo Liu,Shuo Nie,Yue Wang,Chen Wang,Zhaohua Zhang,Tianwen Jiang,Qiuyong Xiao,Jihong Zhang,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出GRPODropout：在标准GRPO更新前，选择性剔除少量高概率正优势rollout并重新中心化保留优势，以缓解策略熵坍缩。方法仅改变rollout使用方式，计算开销可忽略，理论上给出rollout级分析与阈值选择依据。实验表明其准确率高于原GRPO、actor熵更高，且用于更新的rollout更少，体现"less is more"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等强化学习方法显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但常出现策略熵坍缩：采样多样性下降削弱探索、限制进一步提升。现有工作多从算法层面（奖励修改、熵/KL正则）或token级重加权入手，作者试图从互补视角——改变哪些生成rollout参与策略更新——来缓解熵坍缩。

Method: 提出GRPODropout：在标准更新之前，采用简单策略选择性移除少量高概率、正优势的rollout，并对保留的advantage重新中心化。为支撑设计，作者建立rollout级理论分析，用于指导方法设计与阈值选择；方法仅改变rollout的使用，几乎不增加额外计算。

Result: 实验显示，相比原始GRPO，GRPODropout取得更高准确率，同时actor熵更高，并且用于更新的rollout样本更少，验证"less is more"。

Conclusion: 工作揭示了RL中rollout使用的新洞见：剔除部分rollout可提升性能；代码已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.

</details>


### [407] [Understanding Latent-Dimension Scaling in Dynamical-System Learning through Spectral Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11866)
*Itsushi Sakata,Yuta Miyauchi,Yoshinobu Kawahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究自回归动力学学习中"增大表示尺寸是否提升性能"的问题，提出以Koopman算子的谱残差衡量谱可靠性，并据此训练共享Koopman自编码器，在六个混沌系统上验证其优于潜空间预测损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中的逼近理论支持增大表示尺寸，但这一收益能否延伸到通过自回归预测的动力学学习尚不明确。作者怀疑随维度增加，一步预测误差虽下降，却可能出现虚假特征对，从而损害长时rollout的可靠性。

Method: 利用Koopman算子的特征结构分析学习到的时间演化，用相对残差检测虚假特征对；对有界Koopman算子证明：当学习字典空间在L²中逼近可观测量空间时，其最小残差逐点收敛到全空间对应值。构建共享Koopman自编码器，交替进行重构与潜空间演化训练，分别采用潜空间预测损失（潜坐标下的一步预测误差）或谱残差损失（候选特征对的相对残差）进行对比。

Result: 在六个混沌系统上，两种模型从最小到最大维度均降低了滑动窗口rollout误差的中位数。谱残差模型在全部系统与维度上中位数均低于潜预测模型，且在每个系统中中位数下降倍数更大；在四个系统中其中位数随维度单调下降，潜预测模型仅在一个系统中如此。与四个基线族相比，其平均有效预测时长几乎总是更长。在最大维度的两阶段训练下，谱残差特征值集中于低残差区，而潜预测特征值也出现在高残差区。

Conclusion: Koopman谱可靠性可解释rollout误差随维度增加而稳定下降的现象；以谱残差为训练目标能引导特征值落入低残差区域，获得更可靠、更长时的预测，优于潜空间预测损失。

Abstract: In deep learning, approximation theory motivates increasing representation size. We ask whether this benefit extends to dynamics learning through autoregressive prediction. We analyze the learned time evolution through the eigenstructure of Koopman operators, using relative residuals to detect spurious eigenpairs arising even as one-step error falls. For bounded Koopman operators, we show that minimal residuals over learned dictionary spaces converge pointwise to their full-space counterparts as these spaces approximate the observable space in $L^2$. Our hypothesis is that Koopman spectral reliability helps explain how consistently rollout error decreases with increasing dimension. We compare two models of a shared Koopman autoencoder trained alternately for reconstruction and latent evolution, using latent-prediction loss (one-step prediction errors in latent coordinates) or spectral-residual loss (relative residuals of candidate eigenpairs). Across six chaotic systems, both models reduced median windowed rollout error from smallest to largest dimension. The spectral-residual model achieved lower medians than the latent-prediction model for all systems and dimensions, and its median fell by a larger factor in every system. Its median decreased monotonically with dimension in four systems, against one for latent prediction. Against four baseline families, its mean valid prediction times were nearly always longer. At the largest dimension under two-stage training, we compared eigenvalue positions with each learned dictionary's residual contours. Spectral-residual eigenvalues concentrated in low-residual regions, whereas latent-prediction eigenvalues also appeared in high-residual regions, consistent with the hypothesis.

</details>


### [408] [Automated Assembly Instruction Generation from CAD Models Using Grounded Large Language Models: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11896)
*Aaron Dsouza,Mohammed Azeez Khan,Ashutosh Mishra,Arshaan Khan,Neha K. Nair,Amar Kumar Behera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"CAD-grounded装配指令生成"任务，设计将STEP装配体经ProductGraph中间表示、确定性拓扑排序、图上下文条件下的语言生成、可视化文档附加及规则/模型双重校验的分层框架，人工审核通过后才允许导出PDF；六零件案例验证了端到端可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配文档目前仍主要依赖人工解读CAD模型来编写。结构化产品数据与大语言模型均已可用，但CAD解读、装配序列规划、指令撰写与人机监督等研究长期彼此割裂，缺少将工程信息约束与自然语言生成打通的工作。

Method: 框架将STEP装配体映射为带类型的ProductGraph中间表示；通过确定性拓扑排序推导装配先后顺序；每一步仅基于选定的图上下文条件化生成自然语言；为各步骤附加可视化文档；并结合规则校验与模型辅助校验；在人工审阅者清除全部质量标志前，禁止PDF导出。

Result: 在内置的六零件参考装配体上完成案例研究，证明了端到端可行性：流水线复现了已知的装配顺序，并将数量、材料与扭矩信息带入导出的手册页面。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一种分离工程状态、确定性推理、接地语言实现、验证与人工放行的体系结构；泛化能力与几何有效性验证仍是未决的实证问题。

Abstract: Assembly documentation is a downstream manufacturing artifact that is still usually authored by interpreting CAD models by hand. Structured product data and large language models are both available, yet studies of CAD interpretation, assembly sequence planning, instruction writing, and human oversight have largely proceeded separately. This paper formulates CAD-grounded assembly instruction generation: the production of natural-language assembly procedures constrained by structured engineering information extracted from CAD models. The proposed framework maps a STEP assembly to a typed ProductGraph intermediate representation, derives a precedence order by deterministic topological sorting, realizes each step as language conditioned only on selected graph context, attaches per-step visual documentation, and applies rule-based and model-assisted checks. PDF export remains disabled until a human reviewer resolves every quality flag. The case study establishes endto-end feasibility on a built-in six-part reference assembly: the pipeline preserves a reported assembly order and carries quantity, material, and torque into an exported manual page. Generalization and geometric validation remain open empirical questions. The contribution is an architecture that separates engineering state, deterministic reasoning, grounded language realization, verification, and human release.

</details>


### [409] [Puffin: Probabilistic Learning of Spatial Detail From Coarse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11914)
*Chaitanya Jobanputra,Sebastian Vollmer,Gerrit Großmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Puffin是一个概率统计分解框架，利用高分辨率卫星嵌入作为协变量，将粗分辨率总量提升到精细尺度，并通过聚合感知似然训练、推断时以区域总量为条件进行分配，无需精细标签即可输出与总量一致且具校准不确定性的估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率社会经济变量在城市规划、公共卫生、灾害响应和资源分配中很重要，但现实中这些变量往往只在粗空间分辨率下被观测到。传统上采样或预测精细尺度值需要精细标签，成本高且难以获得，因此需要一种无需精细标签、又能保持与观测总量一致的统计分解方法。

Method: Puffin以高分辨率卫星嵌入作为协变量，不直接预测每个精细子区域的单一值，而是学习一个概率分布，并通过聚合感知（aggregation-aware）似然进行训练；推断时将预测以观测到的区域总量为条件，再把总量在子区域间进行拆分。

Result: 在德国和美国的普查、就业与选举数据上，针对人口、就业及其他计数变量进行评估，得到的精细尺度估计与观测聚合总量一致，并具有校准的不确定性，且训练不需要精细分辨率标签；同时分析了统计分解在不同区域、国家和目标上成功或失败的条件。

Conclusion: Puffin提供了一种无需精细标签的概率统计分解方案，可在保持聚合一致性的同时给出校准不确定性的精细尺度估计，为高分辨率社会经济变量的获取提供了可行途径，并揭示了统计分解适用性的边界条件。

Abstract: High-resolution socioeconomic variables are important for applications such as urban planning, public health, disaster response, and resource allocation. In practice, however, these variables are often observed only at a coarse spatial resolution. We introduce Puffin, a probabilistic framework for statistical disaggregation that raises the resolution of coarse totals using high-resolution satellite embeddings as covariates. Instead of predicting a single value for each fine-resolution subregion, Puffin learns a probability distribution and is trained through an aggregation-aware likelihood. At inference, Puffin conditions these predictions on the observed regional total and splits it among the subregions. The resulting fine-scale estimates are consistent with the observed aggregate and come with calibrated uncertainty, without requiring fine-resolution labels for training. We evaluate Puffin on German and US census, employment, and election data across population, jobs, and other count variables, and study when statistical disaggregation succeeds or fails across regions, countries, and targets.

</details>


### [410] [Interval-valued SHAP in Tree-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11953)
*Chenrui Zhu,Vu-Linh Nguyen,Marie-Hélène Masson,Sébastien Destercke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于不精确狄利克雷模型（IDM）的方法，分析决策树与随机森林中Shapley值的鲁棒性，通过区间值Shapley值量化未标注实例随机引入叶子节点时的波动，并给出高效计算的理论结果及Banzhaf值的推广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley值是流行的特征归因解释方法，针对树模型已有高效计算/估计方案，但其对微小且现实的改动可能高度不鲁棒，缺乏系统的鲁棒性分析工具。

Method: 以不精确狄利克雷模型（IDM）为基础，将少量未标注实例随机引入树的叶子节点，按处理不完整数据的悲观原则与平均原则定义区间值Shapley值；推导多项理论结果以实现高效计算，并将方法推广至Banzhaf值。

Result: 给出区间值Shapley值的高效计算理论，展示其在决策树与随机森林中的行为，并通过案例研究与实验验证其在去除无信息特征偏差方面的应用。

Conclusion: 该方法可有效刻画树模型Shapley值的鲁棒性，且能自然扩展至Banzhaf值，具备实际应用价值。

Abstract: Shapley values are among the most popular feature-attribution explanations. Efficient approaches for computing/estimating Shapley values for tree-based models, which are state-of-the-art for tabular data sets, have been developed. However, it is known that Shapley values can be (highly) unrobust due to small and realistic changes. In this paper, we propose an imprecise Dirichlet model (IDM) based method to analyze the robustness of Shapley values in decision trees and random forests. Technically, it is done by quantifying and analyzing the interval-valued Shapley values when a few unannotated instances are randomly introduced to the leaves of the trees. The interval-valued Shapley values can be defined following common principles in handling incomplete data: the pessimistic and averaging principles. We derive various theoretical results that lead to efficient computation of the interval-valued Shapley values. We also show that the proposed method can be straightforwardly generalized to the case of Banzhaf values. We then present various case studies and experiments to illustrate the behaviour of the proposed interval-valued Shapley values and their applications in debiasing uninformative features.

</details>


### [411] [Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11957)
*Meihui Zhong,Wenxin Tai,Ting Zhong,Fan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出随机分组共形预测（SGCP），通过学习随机分组映射，让样本从校准行为相似的样本中借用校准信息，从而在保持标准覆盖保证的同时，缩小临床应用中不同子群之间的覆盖差距，且预测集大小与基线相当或更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准共形预测只在总体层面提供覆盖保证，在临床重要子群间可能出现覆盖差异。在预定义分组内校准虽可缓解，但需访问敏感子群属性，并存在"最差组瓶颈"：保护最难子群会膨胀所有样本的预测集，增加决策者的认知负担。

Method: 提出随机分组共形预测（SGCP）。该框架学习一个随机分组映射，使每个样本能够从校准行为相似的其他样本中获取校准信息，从而形成局部分数分布，提升各子群体的可靠性。

Result: 理论证明 SGCP 保留了标准覆盖保证；在合成和真实基准实验上，SGCP 一致性地缩小了子群覆盖差距，同时预测集大小相对现有基线更小或相当。

Conclusion: SGCP 为子群可靠的不确定性量化提供了一种不依赖敏感属性的共形框架，在保证覆盖有效性的同时改善了子群公平性与预测效率。

Abstract: Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. It learns a stochastic grouping map that allows each sample to draw calibration information from others with similar calibration behavior, yielding a local score law that boosts reliability across subpopulations. We prove that SGCP retains the standard coverage guarantee. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that it consistently reduces subgroup coverage gaps while achieving smaller or comparable prediction set sizes relative to existing baselines.

</details>


### [412] [Example-driven Parametrisations for Bayesian Shape Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11984)
*Gabriel Diaz-Aylwin,Joseph Neighbor,Abiel Malkani Talwar,Rui-Yang Zhang,Henry B. Moss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出用主成分分析（PCA）学习形状设计的参数化，替代手工构造搜索空间，并在多种工程形状设计任务中验证了其样本效率与探索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化适合目标昂贵且不可微的形状设计，但需要紧凑且具表达力的搜索空间参数化。手工构造参数化依赖领域专业知识，且常带来隐式不可行区域、人为边界以及耦合、无序坐标等问题。

Method: 从已有设计集合中学习参数化：对形状之间的变形（deformations）应用主成分分析（PCA），得到一个线性、可解释的搜索空间，其中主成分的数量显式地在表达力与维度之间进行权衡。

Result: 在翼型（aerofoils）、机翼（wings）和射频腔（radio-frequency cavities）上，跨越2D几何到3D空气动力学与电磁学，实验表明该方法提升了样本效率，并能探索超出手工基线参数化范围的解。

Conclusion: 基于PCA的变形参数化可作为贝叶斯形状优化的通用且有效的搜索空间构建方式，减少对手工参数化的依赖并改善优化性能。

Abstract: Bayesian optimisation is the natural tool for shape design when objectives are expensive and non-differentiable, but it needs a compact yet expressive parameterisation of the search space. Hand-crafting one is a complex endeavour requiring domain expertise, and often yields implicit infeasible regions, artificial bounds, and coupled, unordered coordinates. We instead learn the parameterisation from a collection of existing designs, applying principal component analysis to the deformations between shapes. The result is a linear, interpretable search space in which the number of components explicitly trades expressivity against dimensionality. Across aerofoils, wings, and radio-frequency cavities, spanning 2D geometry to 3D aerodynamics and electromagnetics, we show improved sample efficiency and the ability to explore beyond the confines of hand-crafted baselines.

</details>


### [413] [The Polytopal Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12004)
*A. Emilie J. Wedenborg,Anders V. Nørskov,Teresa Dorszewski,Kristoffer Wickstrøm,Morten Mørup*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Polytopal Neural Networks（PNNs）框架，通过在网络表示上施加多面体结构约束，实现逐层可解释的表示，同时基本不损失性能，并为VQ训练提供新路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的信息处理机制仍不透明。现有可解释性方法存在结构保真度不足、依赖预设语料库、或仅做事后解释等局限，缺乏将可解释结构直接嵌入信息处理过程的方案。

Method: 提出PNNs框架：在网络各层强制多面体（polytope）结构，直接用于后续信息处理，从而提取逐层可区分的"方面"（aspects）。通过可学习的语料表示（learned corpus representations）和摊销式单纯形推断（amortized simplex inference）实现规模扩展。观测由其在各层特定方面上的对齐程度显式描述。该框架亦可直接导出向量量化（VQ）训练路径。

Result: 实验表明，对神经表示施加多面体约束能保持潜在空间中的有意义结构，性能退化极小；在无监督学习中相比VQ表示具有更优的压缩表示；同时为VQ深度学习训练提供了一种性能良好的新方法。

Conclusion: 深度网络能够强制生成可解释的多面体表示，为构建更透明的AI系统提供了一条原则性路径，且性能损失极小。

Abstract: Understanding how deep neural networks process information remains a central challenge. Existing interpretability methods often compromise structural fidelity, rely on prespecified corpora, or explain models post-hoc. We propose Polytopal Neural Networks (PNNs), a framework that extracts distinct layer-wise aspects by enforcing a polytope-based structure that is used directly in subsequent information processing. We scale our approach using learned corpus representations and an amortized simplex inference procedure and highlight how the framework also gives a direct route to vector quantized (VQ) training. In PNNs, observations are explicitly described by their alignment with layer-specific aspects. Empirical results show that imposing polytopal constraints on neural network representations preserves meaningful structures in the latent space with minimal degradation in performance, favorable compressed representations when compared to VQ representations in unsupervised learning, while also providing a performant new approach to VQ deep learning training. Our findings suggest that deep networks can enforce interpretable polytope-based representations, offering a principled path toward more transparent AI systems with minimal performance compromise.

</details>


### [414] [Test-Time Compute for Tabular Foundation Models: Mechanisms, Gains, and Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12005)
*Kanghui Ning,Marin Biloš,James T. Wilson,Yilang Zhang,Kashif Rasul,Dongjin Song,Anderson Schneider,Yuriy Nevmyvaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究测试时计算（TTC）对表格基础模型（TFM）预测的提升，沿适配、聚合、上下文构建三个维度展开，发现适配与选择性聚合带来稳定增益，而上下文构建收益依任务与数据规模而定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表格基础模型（TFM）已具备强预测能力，但如何通过测试时计算进一步提升其表现尚缺乏系统性认识。作者希望厘清不同TTC策略的有效性与计算代价权衡。

Method: 沿三轴评估：1）适配——提出DiagScale，仅更新对角查询-键相似度，训练参数仅占0.003–0.03%；2）聚合——考察预测池构成与选择策略，使用96种配置池并进行贪婪选择与均匀平均对比；3）上下文构建——采用注意力引导检索。评估覆盖TabArena基准及OpenML宽表与大规模表。

Result: DiagScale在三个独立预训练骨干上取得与全量微调相当的增益；聚合方面，更宽预测池配合贪婪选择相对默认预测器降低2.4%误差，而均匀平均反而增加误差；上下文构建中，注意力引导检索在部分大表上改善TabPFN-3预测并支持超出上下文记忆限制的源池，但上下文扩展方法无一致提升。

Conclusion: 适配与选择性聚合可在基准层面带来一致增益，二者结合效果更佳但计算开销显著高于默认推理；上下文构建的收益更依赖任务与数据规模。应依据可用算力预算选择合适策略。

Abstract: Which forms of test-time compute improve the predictions of strong pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs)? We systematically study this along three axes: adaptation, aggregation, and context construction. Our evaluation spans modern TFMs across the TabArena benchmark, supplemented by experiments on wide and large-scale tables from OpenML. For adaptation, we introduce DiagScale, a diagonal query-key similarity update. It trains only 0.003-0.03% of model parameters and achieves gains comparable to full fine-tuning across three independently pretrained backbones. For aggregation, both pool composition and selection strategy matter. TabPFN-3 already averages predictions from different preprocessing variants of the same data, and adding more such predictions yields diminishing returns. With a broader pool of 96 configurations, greedy selection reduces error by 2.4% relative to the default predictor, but uniform averaging increases error. For context construction, attention-guided retrieval improves TabPFN-3's predictions on some large tables and supports source pools beyond the full context memory limit. The context expansion methods we test yield no consistent improvement. Taken together, our results suggest that adaptation and selective aggregation yield consistent benchmark-level gains. The benefits of context construction depend more on the task and data regime. Adaptation and aggregation over the same backbone yield further gains when combined, but require substantially more computation than default inference. These trade-offs motivate choosing strategies according to the available computation budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kanghui-learning/test-time-compute-for-tabular-foundation-models.

</details>


### [415] [CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12016)
*Prince Jha,Nils Lukas,Kun Zhang,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CausalDreamer，冻结 tokenizer 并将隐变量重编码为按"可控性"与"奖励相关性"两轴划分的四组因子化表征，微调预训练动力学模型，在 MMBench2 提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式世界模型（如 Dreamer 4）的 tokenizer 仅以重建目标训练，缺少动作与奖励监督，其隐变量无法显式区分可控/不可控、奖励相关/无关信息，限制了模型预测控制的效果。

Method: 保持 tokenizer 冻结，将其隐变量重编码为四组因子化表征：沿可控性轴，仅两组可控组接收动作输入；沿奖励相关性轴，通过从两组奖励相关组预测奖励来学习。随后微调预训练动力学模型以预测该因子化表征。

Result: 在 20 个 MMBench2 任务上用模型预测规划评估（10 个训练见过的干净任务、10 个未见任务，含 6 个背景/物体/迷宫布局被改变的变体与 4 个新环境），收益归一化后随机策略为 0、专家为 1。CausalDreamer 在干净任务上归一化得分比预训练世界模型高 14%（0.199 vs. 0.175），在操纵变体上高 25%（0.307 vs. 0.246）；两者在新环境中均未显著超过随机策略。

Conclusion: 因子化表征能有效分离奖励无关变化（如背景改变）与奖励相关组，从而提升世界模型在干净任务与分布偏移变体上的控制性能；但对全新环境的泛化仍然有限。

Abstract: World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments.
