We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.

</details>


### [416] [MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12039)
*Mahtab Sarvmaili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多视角图解释器MPGE，统一事实支持、反事实敏感性与样例容忍三种解释视角，用于冻结的分子图分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN的预测准确率无法说明图信息如何支持单个决策；仅保留预测的紧凑依据不足以揭示哪些改动会逆转决策、哪些改动被模型容忍，因此需要多视角解释。

Method: MPGE统一三种视角：事实视角(原型PT)寻找保持标签与所需置信度的紧凑保留边集；反事实(CF)寻找有界且改变预测的删除；样例(EXE)寻找保持标签与置信度的非平凡有界删除。共享约束公式连接预测行为、紧凑性与编辑代价，各视角由独立目标生成。CF-GNNExplainer扩展至图分类，学习对称边排序并验证离散候选；BBBP片段后端返回RDKit净化的分子。

Result: 在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD和BBBP上以语义覆盖率、条件质量、稳定性和运行时间评估主GCN实现。成功事实掩码平均保留8.6%–15.5%输入边；有界反事实覆盖率为4.8%–67.6%，样例保持覆盖率为98.9%–100.0%。探索性对照揭示硬投影与保留节点信息的影响。

Conclusion: 定量比较与分子可视化刻画了模型的支持、敏感性与容忍度，但不应视为已验证的化学机制。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

</details>


### [417] [Exploiting Gradients in Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12076)
*Šimon Soldát,Václav Šmídl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限仿真预算下，将仿真器输出对输入参数的梯度信息融入高斯过程代理模型，以加速基于贝叶斯优化的主动学习式仿真推断；结果表明反向模式微分在小预算场景下能带来净效率提升，而前向模式微分则难以抵消额外计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于微分方程的仿真器广泛用于仿真推断，但当单次仿真昂贵时，推断受限于仿真预算。现有做法多采用高斯过程代理结合贝叶斯优化主动学习来提升样本效率，却很少利用近年来日益可获得的仿真器梯度信息。作者认为，即使目标只是学习输入-输出关系，梯度信号也能额外指导主动学习过程，在昂贵仿真器场景下尤为关键。

Method: 在基于高斯过程代理的贝叶斯优化主动学习框架中，将仿真器输出关于输入参数的梯度信息纳入代理模型（梯度增强代理），并在有限仿真预算下比较其推断表现。分别考虑反向模式微分与前向模式微分两种梯度获取方式，在计入梯度计算额外开销的情况下评估推断效率增益。

Result: 引入梯度信息显著加快了贝叶斯优化式推断的收敛速度。在计入额外计算成本后，反向模式微分仍能保持推断效率增益；而前向模式微分的速度提升无法抵消其计算成本。结果表明梯度增强代理主要在参数维度高于输出维度、反向模式微分高效的问题中具有优势。

Conclusion: 梯度增强的高斯过程代理可有效提升有限预算下仿真推断的样本效率，但其收益取决于微分模式与问题维度结构：当参数数超过输出维度时应优先采用反向模式微分。研究为在昂贵仿真推断中是否及如何利用梯度提供了明确指导。

Abstract: Simulators based on differential equations are ubiquitous in science and engineering. They are often used in simulation-based inference to evaluate the posterior distribution of the input parameters based on real-world observations of the simulator outputs. However, inference becomes challenging when individual simulator evaluations are computationally expensive. In such cases, a Bayesian optimization-based active learning approach with Gaussian process surrogate models has been used to maximize the information obtained from a limited simulation budget. Recently, gradients of simulator outputs with respect to input parameters have become increasingly available, yet they are rarely exploited for inference. Even though we only need to learn the simulator input-output relationship, gradient information can provide an additional valuable signal to guide the active learning procedure. This is of particular interest in the case of expensive simulators, when sample efficiency is crucial.
  In this paper, we demonstrate how incorporating gradient information into the Gaussian process surrogate accelerates Bayesian optimization-based inference under a limited simulation budget. Our results show significant improvement in convergence speed from using gradient information. For reverse-mode differentiation, the inference efficiency gains are maintained when accounting for the additional computational cost. In contrast, for forward-mode differentiation, the inference speed-up does not outweigh the computational costs. These results indicate that gradient-enhanced surrogates are beneficial primarily in problems where the number of parameters exceeds the output dimensionality, where reverse-mode differentiation is efficient.

</details>


### [418] [SCORE: Spectral Correlation Estimation for Multivariate Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12096)
*Christopher Bülte,Emil Partow,Astha Gupta,Pascal Esser,Gitta Kutyniok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SCORE 框架，将高维结构化高斯目标的预测建模分解为边缘分布学习与结构化相关矩阵学习，在谱空间中以线性存储和 O(d log d) 代价实现显式协方差近似，并在多个任务上以更低计算成本取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络预测建模面对高维结构化高斯目标时，需要既高效、数值稳定又具表达力的协方差矩阵近似，而现有方法往往在计算代价、存储或数值稳定性上受限。

Method: SCORE 将 d 维数据的学习任务分解为学习边缘分布与学习结构化相关矩阵两部分：结合 scoring rule 训练与在谱空间中学习的表达性协方差近似，从而支持稠密依赖，同时保持线性存储与 O(d log d) 计算复杂度。训练采用高斯核 score 的闭式解，该形式在退化协方差下仍有定义，并在优化中具有有界梯度。理论上刻画了可逆变换下的核 score，并证明酉变换下的精确不变性；总体层面两级目标可恢复真实边缘并将目标相关投影到可表示类中，有限样本 PAC 界表明两阶段误差可加性叠加。

Result: 在时间序列预测、单目深度估计与空间天气预测等常假设高斯域的多元任务上评估，SCORE 在更低计算成本下取得更优性能。

Conclusion: SCORE 通过谱空间结构化协方差近似与 scoring rule 训练，兼顾表达力、数值稳定性与可扩展性，为高维结构化高斯目标的预测建模提供了有效方案，并具备理论保证。

Abstract: Neural network-based predictive modeling with high-dimensional structured Gaussian targets requires an efficient and numerically stable, yet expressive approximation of the covariance matrix. We propose SCORE: a scalable framework, combining scoring rule training with an expressive covariance approximation learned in spectral space. For $d$-dimensional data, the learning task is decomposed into learning the marginal distributions and learning a structured correlation matrix, which enables dense dependencies with linear storage and $\mathcal{O}(d\log d)$ cost. We utilize the closed form Gaussian kernel score for training, which remains defined even for degenerate covariances and admits bounded gradients during optimization. We characterize kernel scores under invertible transforms and prove exact invariance under unitary transforms. At population level, our two-level objective recovers the true marginals and projects the target correlation onto the representable class; finite-sample PAC bounds show that the errors of the two stages enter additively. We evaluate our model on a variety of tasks with a commonly assumed Gaussian domain: Time-series forecasting, monocular depth estimation, and spatial weather prediction, showing improved performance at lower computational cost.

</details>


### [419] [Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12102)
*Shanchuan Lin,Yansong Peng,Fu-Yun Wang,Haoqi Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"数据空间迭代"(data-space iteration)的少步生成框架，彻底去除流匹配中的时间步离散化，让共享生成器在数据空间中直接迭代精化预测，兼容DMD训练，在ImageNet 256×256上超越标准离散化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配虽可扩展且生成质量高，但采样需大量网络评估；蒸馏可将成本降至一步或少步，但一步生成质量损失大，少步生成才是实用区间。现有少步方法沿概率流做迭代计算，需固定且人工选择的时间步离散化，该离散化常靠启发式选取、调参昂贵，且当不同样本或空间位置的精化难度不同时会受限。

Method: 提出数据空间迭代框架：从噪声出发，由共享生成器直接在数据空间精化其预测，每次迭代都被训练以产出其容量所允许的最佳样本，从而完全移除流离散化。该形式与分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)以极小改动集成，可在匹配的训练设置下对迭代方法进行受控比较。

Result: 在类条件ImageNet 256×256上，数据空间迭代优于标准离散化基线，并匹配或超越通过调度搜索选出的变体，且无需针对调度专门训练。

Conclusion: 数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单有效的替代方案，可取代离散化流空间迭代。

Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

</details>


### [420] [A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12113)
*Panagiotis Roditis,Panagiotis P. Filntisis,Petros Maragos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GeZo-SAC，用辅助几何表示（zonotope 生成元）实现随状态-动作变化的自适应 critic 悲观化与分歧度控制聚合，在 MuJoCo-v5 上取得有竞争力的性能与最低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 off-policy actor-critic 方法（如 SAC/TD3 风格）统一采用两 critic 取最小值来抑制高估偏差，该聚合规则在所有状态-动作上恒定，忽略了两个 critic 之间分歧程度的差异，因此悲观程度无法自适应调节。

Method: GeZo-SAC 让每个 critic 在输出标量价值之外，额外预测一组生成元以定义一个 zonotope；沿采样方向探测该 zonotope 得到几何宽度，将其从各 critic 值中减去作为悲观偏移，并得到两 critic 间的分歧度量，用 log-sum-exp 聚合。聚合方式随分歧增大从宽度加权平均平滑过渡到通常的最小值规则。生成元仅在训练时用于 critic 侧，推理阶段部署的是未修改的 SAC actor。

Result: 在四个 MuJoCo-v5 连续控制基准与六种 off-policy 基线的对比中，GeZo-SAC 在 Ant-v5 和 Hopper-v5 上取得最高平均回报，其余任务保持竞争力；同时平均执行器功与每米动作代价最低，四个环境中测得的高估频率接近零。

Conclusion: 用几何表示替代固定的最小值聚合，可使 critic 悲观性随状态-动作自适应并受分歧度驱动，在不改变推理策略的前提下兼顾性能、能效与高估抑制。

Abstract: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.

</details>


### [421] [Credal Machine Learning for Risk-Averse Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12115)
*Timo Löhr,Paul Hofman,Maximilian Muschalik,Eyke Hüllermeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于可信集（credal sets）的风险规避学习方法，通过将认知不确定性表示为概率分布集合，并配合新的决策规则映射到单一预测分布，从而可靠地最小化CVaR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多机器学习应用中，需要防范可能导致重大损失的最坏情况。原则上可通过训练风险规避的预测模型（如最小化条件风险价值CVaR）而非仅追求平均性能的模型来实现。然而在实际中，学习者对真实损失分布及真实CVaR存在不确定性（认知不确定性），这削弱了风险规避的有效性。

Method: 将认知不确定性用可信集（即概率分布的集合）表示；开发一个高效且可靠的学习器，以可信集形式产生预测；并将其与一种新颖的决策规则相结合，该规则将每个可信集映射为用于CVaR最小化的单一预测分布。

Result: 在分类任务、分布偏移场景以及强化学习中，该方法都能可靠地避免灾难性决策，同时在期望性能上损失很小。

Conclusion: 通过将认知不确定性表示为可信集并配合相应的决策规则，可以实现可靠的风险规避，在多种任务中有效避免灾难性决策且几乎不牺牲平均性能。

Abstract: In many machine learning applications, it is necessary to guard against worst-case scenarios and predictions that could result in substantial losses. In principle, this can be achieved by training risk-averse predictive models that minimize loss functions such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), rather than relying on models that perform well on average. In practice, however, the effectiveness of this approach to risk aversion is undermined by the learner's uncertainty regarding the true loss distribution and, consequently, the true CVaR. To achieve reliable risk-aversion, we propose a method in which this (epistemic) uncertainty is represented in terms of credal sets, i.e., sets of probability distributions. More specifically, we develop an efficient yet reliable learner that produces predictions in the form of credal sets and combine it with a novel decision rule that maps each credal set to a single predictive distribution for CVaR minimization. Across classification, under distribution shift, and in reinforcement learning, our approach reliably avoids catastrophic decisions, while sacrificing little in expected performance.

</details>


### [422] [Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12119)
*Alessio Pellegrino,Jacopo Mauro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合图转换与Weisfeiler-Lehman图核的自动化特征提取方法，用于约束编程的算法选择，核心贡献为基于割的表示（WLc），在2023–2025 MiniZinc挑战实例上优于fzn2feat（SVM场景）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统算法选择依赖人工设计的实例级统计特征，难以刻画问题底层结构，因此需要自动化、结构感知的特征提取方法。

Method: 将问题实例转换为图，利用Weisfeiler-Lehman图核（1-WL）生成结构表示，并据此构建基于割的表示WLc以建模结构划分；WL特征无需训练GNN。

Result: 在2023–2025 MiniZinc挑战实例上，针对最大化Borda计数与最大化预测准确率两项任务，结合SVM、随机森林与多层感知机评估：WLc在使用SVM时优于fzn2feat，RF与MLP结果较为接近。

Conclusion: 图核与割基特征为算法选择提供了有效的自动化结构表示；其优势在SVM上最明显，其他模型上差异不大。

Abstract: Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure.
  In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.

</details>


### [423] [Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12148)
*Jack Waller,Xing Liang,Dimitrios Makris,Rajagopal Nilavalan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究对金融时间序列预测中的量子神经网络（QNN）配置进行了大规模系统性对比评估，以GBP/USD即期汇率为案例，通过网格搜索生成1,368种模型配置，最优配置R²达0.985并超越经典BiLSTM基线，同时评估了真实量子硬件噪声的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QNN配置的系统性比较主要集中于分类任务，而对回归问题尤其是金融时间序列预测的关注相对不足，缺乏针对该场景的架构设计指导与噪声敏感性刻画。

Method: 以GBP/USD即期汇率为案例，对编码方法、ansatz设计、量子比特数、层深度与代价函数进行网格搜索，构建1,368种不同模型配置；对每种配置在预测精度、计算成本与收敛行为三方面进行评估；并通过在IQM Emerald设备上执行以考察真实量子硬件噪声的影响。

Result: 结果揭示了方法选择对性能的影响机制：门选择与排布对模型成功的重要性高于原始参数数量；纠缠是全电路的系统级属性而非仅存在于ansatz层面。最优QNN配置取得R²=0.985，优于经典BiLSTM基线。真实硬件执行表明门错误与退相干是实际部署的重大障碍，门选择与电路深度是硬件噪声鲁棒性的关键决定因素。

Conclusion: 该研究为QNN设计提供了实用的架构指导，并建立了近期量子设备上QNN噪声敏感性的基线刻画。

Abstract: Quantum machine learning, and quantum neural networks (QNNs) in particular, are advancing fields with growing potential. Although systematic comparisons of QNN configurations have been explored primarily for classification tasks, comparatively little attention has been given to regression problems, particularly financial time series forecasting. This study presents a large-scale systematic comparative evaluation of QNN component configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search across encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct model configurations, each evaluated in terms of prediction accuracy, computational cost, and convergence behaviour. The results reveal unique insights into how the choice of methods influences performance, such as that gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit rather than solely at the ansatz level. The best-performing QNN configuration achieves an $R^2$ score of 0.985, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Additionally, the impact of real quantum hardware noise is assessed through execution on the IQM Emerald device, revealing that gate errors and decoherence represent a significant barrier to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience. Overall, the findings provide practical architectural guidance for QNN design and establish a baseline characterisation of QNN noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices.

</details>


### [424] [Bayesian Optimisation under State-Preservation Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12150)
*Gabriel Diaz-Aylwin,Vignesh Gopakumar,Omkar Myatra,David Moulton,Lorenzo Zanisi,David S. Leslie,Henry B. Moss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对状态保持约束下的工程设计优化问题，提出通过线性化约束响应在设计空间中构造椭球并批量采样候选点，结合在线精化线性响应映射的贝叶斯优化方法，并在托卡马克偏滤器优化中实现端到端验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多工程设计问题中，目标与约束依赖于由设计参数决定的PDE状态。优化设计时需将选定的状态可观测量保持在可信值附近，即状态保持约束。现有约束贝叶斯优化依赖学习得到的可行性模型，但难以处理高度各向异性的可行域。

Method: 核心思想是预先计算在线性化约束响应下仍处于容差范围内的控制集合，从而将状态空间约束“拉回”到设计空间。该线性化定义了一个椭球，可从中高效抽取大量分布良好的候选点；底层线性响应映射在线精化，并据此重建椭球。

Result: 在关键应用——等离子体边界保持下的托卡马克偏滤器优化中实现了端到端验证。

Conclusion: 通过将状态保持约束拉回设计空间并利用椭球采样，方法能够有效应对高度各向异性的可行域，并与在线精化的线性响应映射结合，在托卡马克偏滤器优化任务中验证了可行性。

Abstract: In many engineering design problems, the objective and constraints depend on the state: the solution of a PDE determined by the design parameters. We consider improving a design while holding selected state observables near trusted values, which we call state preservation constraints. Constrained Bayesian optimisation handles these with a learnt feasibility model, but struggles with this problem's highly anisotropic feasible set. Our central idea is to pre-compute the set of controls whose linearised constraint response stays within tolerance, thereby pulling back the state-space constraint into design space. This linearisation defines an ellipsoid from which we can efficiently draw a large number of well-spread candidates. The underlying linear response map is refined online, and the ellipsoid is rebuilt accordingly. We demonstrate the method end-to-end on our key application - Tokamak divertor optimisation under plasma-boundary preservation.

</details>


### [425] [Toward Optimal Regret in Adversarial MDPs with Stochastic Hard Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12153)
*Qian Zuo,Francesco Emanuele Stradi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究具有对抗性损失和随机硬约束的回合制约束马尔可夫决策过程，提出MA-OPS算法，通过乐观搜索Slater边际与悲观评估策略，实现接近最优的遗憾界$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\rho+1/(d\rho))$，并给出匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作（Stradi et al., 2025）在该设定下遗憾为$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$，但下界为$\Omega(\sqrt{T}/\rho)$，其中$\rho$（离线问题的Slater边际）可能远大于$d$。这一差距表明现有算法对边际的依赖并非最优，作者希望获得对$d$和$\rho$的最优遗憾依赖。

Method: 提出MA-OPS算法：结合对Slater边际的乐观搜索（optimistic search）与对所选策略的悲观评估（pessimistic evaluation），以安全地学习一个具有较大可行性边际的策略，再利用该策略在满足每回合约束的同时最小化遗憾。该方法是Stradi et al. (2025)混合规则方法的扩展。

Result: MA-OPS达到遗憾$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\rho+1/(d\rho))$；作者进一步给出匹配下界，证明对$T$、$d$、$\rho$的依赖在对数因子内是最优的。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了episodic约束MDP对抗损失设定中遗憾对边际依赖的空白，达到最优遗憾界，同时保证每回合满足期望成本约束。

Abstract: We study episodic constrained Markov decision processes with adversarial losses under stochastic hard constraints. Specifically, starting from a known strictly feasible policy with margin $d$, we seek to obtain optimal regret while satisfying the expected cost constraints in every episode. In this setting, Stradi et al. (2025) show that a carefully designed mixing rule attains regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$. Interestingly, they also provide a lower bound of order $Ω(\sqrt{T}/ρ)$ for the same setting, where $ρ$ is the Slater margin of the offline problem and can be much larger than $d$. In this work, we build on their approach to obtain optimal regret dependence on these margins. Specifically, we propose MA-OPS, an algorithm that combines an optimistic search for the Slater margin with a pessimistic evaluation of the selected policies to safely learn a policy with a large feasibility margin. This policy is then used to minimize regret while satisfying the constraints at every episode. In particular, we show that MA-OPS attains regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/ρ+ 1/(dρ))$. Finally, we provide a matching lower bound, showing that the dependence on $T$, $d$, $ρ$ in the regret bound is optimal up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [426] [Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12163)
*Ahmet Tüzen,Helge Langseth,Kjetil Nørvåg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Schema，一种可扩展的属性图生成模型，通过递归软社区分解与三阶段独立训练，在单一参考图上学习并生成大规模属性图，同时提出覆盖结构保真、记忆、下游效用与可扩展性的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成大规模属性图需同时复现拓扑、联合生成属性并保持可扩展性；而真实图常以单一大图形式存在，模型必须从唯一被拟合的图泛化，无法依赖独立样本，现有方法难以兼顾结构保真、避免记忆与下游效用。

Method: Schema 递归地将参考图分解为软社区层级，为每个节点分配隶属分布。生成分为三个独立训练的阶段：(1) 以软隶属为条件合成节点属性；(2) 基于局部结构上下文生成社区内边；(3) 在隶属质量分布于多个社区的桥接节点上建模社区间连接。各阶段均不构建完整邻接矩阵，且仅作用于受社区规模约束的子图。

Result: 在四个真实属性图上，Schema 比任何其他可生成属性的模型更接近地恢复局部与长程结构的平衡，同时仅复现少量参考图边；其下游精度保持与参考图相当而不被人为抬高。结构保真度相当的基线会记忆参考图，而下游精度更高的基线要么超过参考精度，要么在更大图上无法完成。另在六个最多含一千万节点的图上评估了可扩展性。

Conclusion: Schema 通过软社区分解与分阶段子图生成，实现了在单一大图上训练的可扩展属性图生成，避免全邻接矩阵与对参考图的记忆，在结构保真、下游效用与规模之间取得更优平衡。

Abstract: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

</details>


### [427] [Is Real-World Training Data Necessary for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12167)
*Yujing Liu,Yixin Liu,Yue Tan,Xiaofeng Cao,Alan Wee-Chung Liew,Heng Tao Shen,Shirui Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对通用图异常检测（GAD）的数据稀缺问题，提出异常图自动合成框架AG-FORGE，并配套设计拓扑-语义协同的通用检测模型TS-GGAD及课程学习策略，在14个真实数据集上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用图异常检测旨在无需重训或微调即可检测任意未见图上的异常，但构建基础模型需要充足训练数据，而真实异常图稀缺且采集标注代价高昂，导致严重数据短缺，因此探索合成数据驱动的训练路径具有必要性。

Method: 提出AG-FORGE（异常图生成锻造器），实现异常图的自动合成；进一步提出TS-GGAD，一种拓扑-语义协同的通用GAD模型，捕获互补的拓扑与语义异常证据，并设计面向大规模合成训练的课程学习策略以释放模型容量。

Result: 实验发现合成数据可达到与真实数据相当的性能，但因现有方法容量受限而难以进一步突破；在14个真实数据集上，基于AG-FORGE生成数据训练的TS-GGAD显著优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 合成数据驱动训练对通用图异常检测可行且有效，配合高容量协同模型与课程学习策略，可突破真实数据稀缺的瓶颈并显著提升检测性能。

Abstract: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to build a foundation model that detects anomalies on arbitrary unseen graphs without retraining or fine-tuning. Sufficient data are essential for foundation model training, yet generalist GAD still faces a data shortage, as real-world anomalous graphs are scarce and costly to collect and annotate. To fill this gap, we propose AG-FORGE, an Anomalous Graph generation Forge for automatic synthesis of anomalous graphs, exploring the feasibility of synthetic data-driven training for generalist GAD. Empirically, we find that synthetic data can achieve performance comparable to real-world training, but fail to push the performance boundary further due to the limited capacity of existing methods. To further unlock model capacity as training data scale up, we develop TS-GGAD, a Topology-Semantic coordinated Generalist GAD that captures complementary topological and semantic anomaly evidence, together with a curriculum learning strategy tailored to large-scale synthetic training. Extensive experiments on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate that TS-GGAD, trained on data generated by AG-FORGE, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [428] [A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12183)
*Ming Chen,Rong-Xi Tan,Ke Xue,Yu-Jie Zhou,Taiye Lu,Zhi-Xuan Gao,Peng Xie,Zijun Shen,Chen Lu,Haopu Shang,Chao Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出跨领域智能体黑盒优化基准 AgenticBBO-Bench，统一评估协议下覆盖五个领域，系统分析工具、任务信息与LLM角色三个影响因素，并给出前沿挑战与模型性价比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒优化中目标评估昂贵且次数受限，LLM智能体结合任务语义、计算与优化工具具备潜力，但既有研究任务域与系统配置各异，结果难以比较，单项设计选择的作用无法被隔离。

Method: 构建统一有限预算评估协议下的跨领域基准 AgenticBBO-Bench，涵盖合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计与分子设计五个领域；围绕优化工具、任务信息与先验知识、LLM在搜索中的角色三个因素开展消融式实验；另设五任务前沿挑战，在Codex智能体框架下评测七个LLM。

Result: 智能体BBO在五个领域的族平均得分均高于直接基于LLM的方法，并在四个领域优于最佳数值优化器。额外数值工具并未稳定提升性能；任务语义普遍有益而更具体的先验可靠性较低；数值优化器可有效吸收智能体搜索轨迹带来的收益。在Codex框架下，GPT-6 Astra与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash位于性能—成本Pareto前沿。

Conclusion: AgenticBBO-Bench为智能体黑盒优化提供了跨域、可比较的统一评测平台，揭示了工具与先验的收益边界，并表明智能体搜索与数值优化器的互补结合具有前景。

Abstract: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

</details>


### [429] [Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12189)
*Jannik Wiese,Johannes Schusterbauer,Tommaso Martorella,Björn Ommer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出JWS，一种单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行概率降水临近预报，结合掩码异步扩散和评分规则目标，实现少步生成，在SEVIR和MeteoNet上达到SOTA且训练/推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式扩散模型用于概率降水临近预报时，通常依赖分别训练的压缩或确定性预报组件，且因迭代去噪导致推理成本高。

Method: 提出JWS：单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间预报并支持少步生成。方法包含Masked Asynchronous Diffusion（一种在保留干净上下文的同时适配高维时空数据的扩散时间步采样方案），以及一个简单的评分规则目标，使训练与概率预报对齐并实现少步生成。

Result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上，JWS在降低训练和推理成本的同时达到最先进的概率预报性能；其最小模型以显著更少参数量仍具竞争力，推理速度提升超过17倍。

Conclusion: JWS通过直接在雷达空间建模、消除有损压缩不确定性并采用少步扩散生成，简化了训练与推理流程，在概率降水临近预报中实现了性能与效率的双重提升。

Abstract: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

</details>


### [430] [DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12190)
*Yudi Zhang,Mingyu Cao,Lu Yin,Mykola Pechenizkiy,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 DataSense-Bench 基准，考察前沿 AI 模型是否具备"数据感"——即为训练可靠选择正确数据的能力。任务要求智能体在不能训练模型、不能访问评测任务的前提下，从候选中挑选并排序可微调小模型的训练子集，并以微调后性能和排序准确度两个维度评估。结果显示选择增益有限、排序能力不稳定，模型尚不具备可靠的数据感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着递归自我改进（RSI）与通用人工智能（AGI）相关主张不断增多，一个基础性问题被忽视：前沿 AI 模型是否具备"数据感"，即能否可靠地为训练选择正确的数据。数据选择与性能预测是机器学习中的基础问题，但缺乏标准化评测，因此需要构建专门基准来量化该能力。

Method: 提出 DataSense-Bench：让 AI 智能体从候选训练子集中选择并排序可用于微调小 LLM 的样本组。智能体可检查数据、编写并执行分析代码、运行模型前向传播，但不能训练模型或访问真实评测任务。随后在标准化协议下用每个被选子集微调基座模型并评估训练后性能。基准在终端问题求解与工具使用两个场景实例化：分别从 OpenThoughts-Agent 和 EnvScaler 选取轨迹，并在 TBLite 与 BFCL 上评估。评估采用两个互补维度：排名第一子集的训练后性能（识别高价值训练数据的能力）与排序准确度（预测各子集相对性能的能力）。

Result: 实验中，相对于随机选择，选择增益有限；智能体无法可靠地对所选数据组进行排序，且排序能力在不同任务间不一致：Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均识别出最佳组，但在三次终端运行中仅有一次做到。对两个任务执行轨迹的分析表明，智能体常使用相似的数据信号，却对其训练价值的解读各不相同。

Conclusion: 前沿 AI 模型尚不具备可靠的"数据感"，在选择高价值训练数据与预测数据相对价值方面能力有限且不稳定，这削弱了关于递归自我改进与 AGI 的部分主张。DataSense-Bench 为后续研究提供了可复现的评测框架，并提示模型在数据价值理解上仍存在明显缺陷。

Abstract: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.

</details>


### [431] [Verification with Transfer: Exact Information Frontiers and Their Price in Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12211)
*Hazar Yueksel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"验证器只接受/拒绝整个答案"时,通过调用相关源任务来降低验证代价的信息论极限,给出列表率失真函数下界、源调用数的紧界、顺序(交错 vs 源优先)的影响,以及线性银行情形的闭式解与可计算性,并用 Lean 4 机器验证与小型 transformer 实验作为"标尺"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整体接受/拒绝的验证器信息量极低:在 k-bit 答案的平坦先验下,零误差需要 2^k-1 次验证。常见补救是求解相关源任务(全部先做即课程式,或与验证交错)。作者要把这一补救在"信息"和"调用次数"两个维度上定价,明确其最小因果信息需求与期望调用代价,并区分交错与源优先协议在精确/带噪验证器下的优劣。

Method: 以率失真/列表率失真框架刻画最小因果信息;证明一次"验证前观测"即可达到该列表率失真函数,从而下界期望二元源调用数;构造设计源并分析其与下界的差距(唯一答案情形 1+log_2 5,一般情形 log 项,且无加性常数可达);比较交错与源优先协议在精确验证器下对硬上限/期望调用的影响,以及带噪验证器下的信息与错误损失;对 F_2 上线性银行给出最优精度闭式,并做多项式时间归约,给出 2^{O(h^2)}poly(J,k+h) 的预算剖面算法。

Result: 1) 最小因果信息等于列表率失真函数,由"验证前一次观测"达到;2) 设计源在唯一答案时距下界不超过 1+log_2 5 次调用,一般情形在 log 项内,且无加性常数;3) 精确验证器固定源时,把所有调用移到首次验证前可保持所有硬上限,而交错最多可省任意多期望调用;带噪验证器下源优先可损失无界的信息与错误因子;4) 线性银行最优精度有闭式解,预算剖面可在 2^{O(h^2)}poly(J,k+h) 时间算出;5) 零误差硬上限下,超出取整信息价的调用恰为花在 nuisance 上的部分;6) 除两条关于 planner 的陈述外,编号结果均在 Lean 4 中机器验证;7) 标尺实验显示小型 transformer 在潜维 5 使用全部投递比特、在 11 处不用,且低 XOR 度不足以导致比特被使用。

Conclusion: 论文给出"源任务辅助验证"的完整信息—调用代价理论:验证前的单次观测即达最优因果信息,交错并非普遍优于源优先,其收益取决于验证器是否精确;线性银行情形可精确刻画并可计算。形式化验证增强了结果的可靠性,而实验标尺表明模型对投递比特的利用存在明显的潜维阈值,XOR 度并非充分条件。

Abstract: A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.

</details>


### [432] [Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12232)
*Mohamed Readh Fentazi,Mazene Ameur,Adlen Ksentini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文构建了无标签泄漏的时序预测TTA评测框架，将标签延迟 d≥H 强制植入四种近期TTA方法（TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA）中，并与无超参RLS中值校正器等基线比较。结果显示：标签泄漏会虚增简单适配器增益达110%，而训练配方对冻结在线误差的影响（最高25倍）超过任何适配效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测的测试时自适应（TTA）方法利用到达的真实标签更新模型或小型适配器，但 H 步预测的标签实际要到 H 步之后才存在，真实数据管线还会引入额外延迟。若在标签实际可用前就更新，会产生标签泄漏，导致增益被高估、方法间比较失真。作者希望建立符合因果约束的评测标准，厘清已发表TTA方法的真实效果。

Method: 构建无泄漏评测框架：规定预测起点 s 的标签仅在步 s+d（d≥H）时释放用于更新，并将该规则植入四种近期TTA方法（TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA）的公开代码中，在其各自骨干与检查点上运行，覆盖五个基准（ETTm1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）。附加两个闭式校正器作为参照：按坐标取中值组合的递归最小二乘（RLS）滤波器组（无超参，7通道流上56微秒/步）与ELF式线性校正器。

Result: 在因果延迟标签下结果呈不对称性。ETTm1上四种方法均真正实现自适应，但RLS滤波器组以极小代价击败其中三种；仅DynaTTA在最小因果延迟下胜过该滤波器组，代价却约为每次更新的2,500倍；ELF式校正器击败全部四种方法。其余四个数据集上，已发表方法相对自身冻结检查点最大统计显著提升仅0.5%，且在最小因果延迟下每个数据集都至少有一种已发表方法显著劣于冻结模型；在漂移严重的ETTh2上，更长的标签延迟使所有与冻结模型分离的适配器（含本文方法）显著有害。泄漏的下一步更新使简单适配器的表观增益虚高最多110%，而骨干训练配方使冻结在线误差变化达25倍，超过所测任何适配效应。

Conclusion: 在符合因果约束的延迟标签设定下，近期TTA方法在时序预测中的真实收益有限，部分情形甚至有害，其效果常被标签泄漏与训练配方差异所掩盖。简单闭式校正器兼具低成本与稳健性，可作为更强基线。作者开源了评测框架、集成补丁与全部缓存运行结果，以推动更严格的TTA评测。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five benchmarks (ETTm1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity and Traffic). As references we add two closed-form correctors: a bank of recursive least squares (RLS) filters combined by a per-coordinate median, with no tunable hyperparameters and 56 microseconds per step on the 7-channel streams, and an ELF-style linear corrector. Under causal delayed labels the picture is asymmetric. On ETTm1 every audited method genuinely adapts, yet the RLS bank still beats three of the four at a fraction of their cost; only DynaTTA beats the bank, only at the minimum causal delay, and at roughly 2,500 times the per-update cost; the ELF-style corrector beats all four. On the other four datasets, the largest statistically significant improvement any published method achieves over its own frozen checkpoint is half a percent, on all four at least one published method is significantly worse than the frozen model at the minimum causal delay, and on drift-heavy ETTh2 longer label delays make every adapter that separates from the frozen model, ours included, significantly harmful. Leaky next-step updates inflate the apparent gains of simple adapters by up to 110%, and the backbone training recipe moves frozen online error by up to a factor of 25, more than any adaptation effect we measure. We release the harness, integration patches and all cached runs.

</details>


### [433] [AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12240)
*Darahaas Nallagatla,Darryl Cherian Jacob,Pan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AdaCast，一个条件参数生成框架，为冻结的时序基础模型按输入生成特定的低秩参数更新，实现输入自适应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全合一（all-in-one）适配方法仅学习一套数据集级参数更新，对所有输入应用同一适配模型，无法针对每条时序的时序模式、季节性与动态进行调整，难以对异质输入生成定制化预测。

Method: AdaCast 采用生成器为冻结的预训练时序基础模型（TSFM）生成输入特定的低秩参数更新，这些更新在训练和推理阶段均对每个输入进行模型适配，属于条件参数生成（conditional parameter generation）思路。

Result: 在六个公开基准上，AdaCast 在域内预测上持续优于静态适配基线，并提升了对跨域留出数据集的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 条件参数生成是提升时序预测自适应性的有效途径。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.

</details>


### [434] [RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12244)
*Mark Daniel Szalai,Gabor Horvath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RIFT，一种基于最小生成树几何视角的确定性异常检测方法，在一维数据上与Isolation Forest无穷森林极限完全一致，高维下为无参数泛化，并提供集成变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Isolation Forest（IF）是无监督异常检测的常用基线，近期研究给出了一维数据下无穷森林极限的闭式表达式。受该公式几何解释的启发，作者希望构造一种确定性、无参数且能克服IF缺陷的异常检测方法。

Method: 基于上述公式的几何解释提出RIFT（Relative Isolation From Trees）：生成最小生成树（MST），以从每个点观察到的树边"表观大小"之和作为该点的异常得分。针对大数据集进一步提出集成变体。

Result: 在一维数据上，RIFT得分精确还原IF的闭式极限；在高维下提供无参数泛化，确定性强，对密度变化与簇状异常更鲁棒，并避免IF的轴平行伪影。合成数据与ADBench基准实验表明精度与IF相当，集成变体在不同随机种子下方差显著更低。

Conclusion: RIFT通过最小生成树的几何视角统一了IF的理论极限与高维推广，兼具确定性、无参数与鲁棒性；集成变体进一步提升稳定性，精度与IF可比且方差更低。

Abstract: Isolation Forest (IF) is a widely used baseline for unsupervised anomaly detection. Recent studies provide a closed-form expression for the infinite-forest limit for one-dimensional data. Inspired by the geometric interpretation of this formula, we introduce RIFT (Relative Isolation From Trees), a deterministic anomaly detection method that generates the minimum spanning tree and scores each point by the sum of the apparent sizes of tree edges as viewed from that point. For one-dimensional data, the RIFT score recovers the closed-form IF limit exactly. In higher dimensions, it provides a parameter-free generalization that is deterministic, robust to varying density and clustered anomalies and avoids the axis-parallel artifacts of IF. We further propose an ensemble variant for large datasets. Experiments on synthetic data and the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that the accuracy is comparable to IF, while the ensemble variant exhibits significantly lower variance across random seeds.

</details>


### [435] [Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12247)
*David Leko,Luka Benić,Guillermo Bernárdez,Nina Miolane,Olga Fink,Lev Telyatnikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Cluster-TNN：通过局部提升与簇采样的拓扑小批量框架，避免全域构造的显存瓶颈，使高阶拓扑神经网络首次可在Reddit等大规模图上训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑深度学习将图学习扩展到超图、胞腔复形、单纯复形等高阶域，但这些域通常需从输入图中通过"图提升"全量构造并存储完整提升表示。在Reddit（233k节点、57.3M边）等大规模稠密数据集上，这种全局物化成为严重计算瓶颈，常导致训练不可行。

Method: 提出Cluster-TNN，一种域无关框架：预处理阶段对输入图进行划分；运行时动态采样若干节点簇，重建其诱导子图构成小批量，并在每个小批量内施加所选提升操作。保留采样节点间全部边以维持跨簇构造高阶结构所需的连通性，生成拓扑小批量，可直接供现有拓扑神经网络处理。

Result: 在21组与全图执行的配对比较中，Cluster-TNN在所有配置下均降低峰值GPU显存，平均降低83.2%，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。该显存降低使多种不同高阶拓扑神经网络首次能够在Reddit和OGBN Products等大规模数据集上训练。

Conclusion: Cluster-TNN是一种通用策略，可将拓扑深度学习扩展到超越全局域构造限制的规模，为大规模高阶拓扑学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

</details>


### [436] [AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12265)
*Xinhua Miao,Bowei Yang,Zhengong Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaptLSTM自适应在线框架，通过验证校准阈值检测漂移并执行选择性更新，在云服务负载预测中实现低成本高精度的性能恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云服务弹性伸缩依赖准确的工作负载预测，但病毒式内容、产品发布和用户行为变化导致分布漂移，使离线训练模型迅速失效。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，但每步计算开销过高，难以实用。

Method: AdaptLSTM采用验证集校准阈值进行漂移检测，并执行选择性的、有针对性的模型更新，从而在保持预测精度的同时降低在线学习成本。该框架与模型无关，可适配多种骨干网络。

Result: 在Alibaba Machine Trace上，以20%成本恢复朴素在线学习54%的改进（效率提升2.7倍，p=0.002，10个随机种子）；在波动更大的Container Trace上达到96%的改进（效率提升4.8倍，MAE较静态基线降低75%）。相比ADWIN、DDM、Page-Hinkley等经典漂移检测器无法在回归误差流上触发，AdaptLSTM在301步中触发42次，优于同等预算基线。墙钟分析显示吞吐量提升1.33倍，更新耗时减少45%；LSTM、GRU、Transformer骨干均呈现相同Pareto模式。

Conclusion: AdaptLSTM通过选择性更新有效平衡了在线学习的精度与计算成本，验证了其在多变云负载场景下的高效性与模型无关的通用性。

Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.

</details>


### [437] [Composite Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion with Optimal Oracle Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12328)
*Mingyi Li,Taira Tsuchiya,Kenji Yamanishi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机非光滑非凸复合优化，目标是寻找满足Goldstein型平稳性条件的点。作者扩展在线到非凸转换框架，引入含正则项本身的新损失，得到 $O(\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 梯度查询与 $O(d\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 函数值查询复杂度，达到非复合问题的最优率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该问题涵盖约束优化、神经网络正则化训练等，但在一阶访问下此前没有已知的 oracle 复杂度界，零阶访问下的已有复杂度也是次优的。因此需要建立更优的复杂度界。

Method: 采用 online-to-nonconvex conversion 框架，通过在线学习器选择更新方向；针对复合场景引入新的学习器损失，该损失包含正则项本身而非其线性化，并使用在线镜像下降的变体实现低 regret。

Result: 所得算法以 $O(\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 次随机梯度查询或 $O(d\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ 次函数值查询找到满足条件的点，其中 $\delta$ 为 Goldstein 半径，$\varepsilon$ 为平稳性容差，$d$ 为维度。这些率与非复合非光滑非凸优化的最优率相匹配。此外还给出了光滑情形下的率并进行了数值实验。

Conclusion: 额外凸正则项不会恶化 oracle 复杂度，复合问题可达到与非复合问题相同的最优复杂度；框架可扩展至复合场景及光滑情形。

Abstract: We consider stochastic nonsmooth nonconvex composite optimization, which includes several important problems such as constrained optimization and the regularized training of neural networks. The objective is the sum of a possibly nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz function and a convex regularizer, and the function is accessed through stochastic gradients or function values. The goal is to find a point that satisfies a Goldstein-type stationarity condition designed for composite objectives. To our knowledge, no oracle complexity bound for this setting is known under first-order access, and existing complexities under zeroth-order access are suboptimal. To handle this issue, we employ the framework of online-to-nonconvex conversion, which chooses update directions by an online learner and is known to achieve optimal rates for noncomposite problems. We extend the framework to our composite scenario by introducing new losses for the learner, which contain the regularizer itself rather than its linearization and for which a variant of online mirror descent achieves low regret. We show that the resulting algorithm finds such a point with $O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ stochastic gradient queries or $O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ function-value queries, where $δ$ is the Goldstein radius, $\varepsilon$ is the stationarity tolerance, and $d$ is the dimension. These rates match the optimal ones for noncomposite nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, demonstrating that the additional convex regularizer does not worsen the oracle complexity. We also give rates for the smooth case and present numerical experiments.

</details>


### [438] [Ambient Discrete Diffusion: Using the Wrong Data at the Right Time for Data Efficient Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12340)
*Julian Kleutgens,Mauricio Tec,Claudio Battiloro,Francesca Dominici,Giannis Daras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RefineMix是一个在严重数据稀缺下训练离散扩散模型的框架，通过在选定扩散时间步利用分布外数据提升泛化且不使采样分布产生偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学应用中常面临严重数据稀缺。连续扩散中已有利用分布外数据提升泛化的策略，但离散扩散因掩码噪声保留幸存Token的域信息，在高噪声水平下限制了相关数据的使用，需针对该差异提出新方法。

Method: RefineMix在选定的扩散时间步引入分布外数据。核心观察是：低噪声水平下不同域的有效支撑集近乎不相交，成为优势，使模型可同时从域内与分布外数据中学习而不偏置采样器。作者形式化这些直觉并给出理论分析。

Result: 在五个域偏移设定中，RefineMix匹配或超越域内微调与数据混合。在蛋白质序列生成上，仅用197个域内样本微调，生成的同时具备新颖性、可折叠性且同家族的蛋白质比例相比标准微调近乎翻倍。

Conclusion: RefineMix为数据稀缺下的离散扩散训练提供了有效方案，理论分析与多设定实验验证了其在不偏置采样分布的前提下利用分布外数据提升泛化的能力。

Abstract: We introduce RefineMix, a framework for training discrete diffusion models under severe data scarcity, a common constraint in scientific applications. RefineMix uses out-of-distribution data at selected diffusion times to improve generalization without biasing the sampling distribution. Although this strategy has been explored in continuous diffusion, discrete diffusion presents a distinct challenge: unlike Gaussian noise, masking preserves domain information in surviving tokens, limiting the use of related data at high noise levels. At low noise levels, however, the domains effectively disjoint supports become an advantage, allowing the model to learn from both in-domain and out-of-distribution data without biasing the sampler. We formalize these intuitions and provide a theoretical analysis for the proposed method. Experimentally, across five domain-shift settings, RefineMix matches or outperforms in-domain finetuning and data mixing. For protein sequence generation, finetuning with just 197 in-domain examples nearly doubles the fraction of generated proteins that are simultaneously novel, foldable, and in-family compared to standard finetuning.

</details>


### [439] [SplitJEPA: Learning Invariant and Variant Latent Worlds without Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12349)
*Ruijin Hua,Zichuan Liu,Zhuokai Zhao,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SplitJEPA，一种无需重建的 JEPA 方法，直接在表示空间联合恢复潜在状态及其不变/变化组织，并给出可识别性理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解动态世界需要将潜在状态划分为跨相关观测共享的不变因子与变化因子。现有方法多依赖重建来获得这种分解，但重建要求潜变量先解释整个观测世界，代价高且不可靠；JEPA 直接建模潜在状态且从不重建，但尚无结果能恢复其学到的不变与变化部分。因此"如何在不付出重建代价的情况下学习潜在世界的不变-变化结构"仍未解决。

Method: 提出 SplitJEPA：一种 JEPA，在不使用任何重建的情况下，直接在表示空间中联合恢复潜在状态及其不变与变化组织。理论分析设定为平稳高斯预测动力学加上满秩变化条件，用以证明可识别性。

Result: 在平稳高斯预测动力学与满秩变化条件下，证明 SplitJEPA 能将不变子空间与变化子空间识别到独立的块对角等距变换意义下，且不引入观测解码器。由于保证不依赖解码器，该结果将无重建的潜变量恢复扩展到不变-变化块的识别。合成非线性系统与机器人操作任务的实验支持理论结果，并显示其在鲁棒性与效率上的实用价值。

Conclusion: SplitJEPA 填补了 JEPA 无法恢复不变-变化结构的空白，首次实现无重建的潜在不变-变化块识别，并在理论与实验中验证其对鲁棒性和效率的价值。

Abstract: Understanding a dynamical world calls for more than a latent state that summarizes its observations: the state should also be organized into the factors that stay shared across related observations and the factors that vary between them. For example, a robot pushing a cube to a goal should take the same action when the camera shifts or the lights dim, since nothing in the scene has moved. Existing approaches to this decomposition commonly obtain it through reconstruction, so the latent variables must first explain the entire observational world before their organization can be trusted. Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) model the latent state directly and never reconstruct, yet no existing result recovers the invariant and variant parts of the state they learn. How to learn the invariant-variant structure of the latent world without paying for its reconstruction therefore remains open. To close this gap, we introduce SplitJEPA, a JEPA that jointly recovers the latent state and its invariant and variant organization directly in representation space, without any reconstruction. We prove that, under stationary Gaussian predictive dynamics and a full-rank variation condition, SplitJEPA identifies the invariant and variant subspaces up to independent block-wise isometries, without introducing an observation decoder. Since the guarantee needs no decoder, the result extends reconstruction-free latent recovery to invariant-variant block identification. Experiments on synthetic nonlinear systems and robotic manipulation tasks support the theoretical results and show their practical value for both robustness and efficiency.

</details>


### [440] [Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12362)
*Mingyi Li,Taira Tsuchiya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过正则化Q函数联合控制所有状态-动作对上的局部更新稳定性，弥合了在线情景式表格MDP中策略优化算法与占用度量类算法之间的遗憾界差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略优化在每个状态局部更新策略，避免在占用度量多面体上优化，但其现有遗憾界比占用度量类算法大H倍，作者希望消除这一差距。

Method: 采用正则化Q函数（regularized Q-functions），在所有状态-动作对上联合控制局部更新的稳定性，而非在每个状态上分别控制；并将算法扩展到对抗性线性混合MDP。

Result: 已知转移时达到高概率遗憾界Õ(√(HS(H+A)T))，未知转移时为Õ(HS√(AT))；两者均改善了现有策略优化界对H的依赖性，后者匹配已知最优界。

Conclusion: 该工作通过正则化Q函数消除了策略优化与占用度量类算法在H依赖性上的差距，并成功推广到对抗性线性混合MDP场景。

Abstract: We consider policy optimization for online episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) with adversarial losses and bandit feedback. Policy optimization updates the policy locally at each state and avoids optimization over the occupancy-measure polytope, but its existing regret bounds are larger by a factor of the horizon $H$ than those of occupancy-measure-based algorithms. We close this gap by using regularized $Q$-functions, which allow us to control the stability of the local updates jointly over all state-action pairs rather than separately at each state. The resulting algorithm attains high-probability regret bounds of $\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$ for known transitions and $\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$ for unknown transitions, where $S$ is the number of states, $A$ the number of actions, and $T$ the number of episodes. Both bounds improve the horizon dependence of existing policy optimization bounds, and the latter matches the best-known bound. We further extend the algorithm to adversarial linear-mixture MDPs and obtain the same improvement in the horizon dependence.

</details>


### [441] [Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12370)
*Joel-Pascal Ntwali N'konzi,Feliks Nüske,Stefan Klus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EDMD-kDL，一种基于核的字典学习方法，可直接从数据中学习有限维Koopman嵌入，结合配点法与双层优化，性能媲美或优于基于ANN的方法且可扩展至大数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman算子理论为非线性动力系统提供线性分析框架，但EDMD等有限维近似需先验指定字典；现有机器学习方法多用ANN自编码器学习字典，而核方法虽更具可解释性和理论可分析性，却少被关注。

Method: 提出EDMD-kDL，将配点方法与双层优化相结合，同时学习核字典及对应的Koopman近似，从而直接从数据中学习有限维Koopman嵌入。

Result: 在全球海表温度预测和直接从视频数据学习等数值实验中，EDMD-kDL在所有测试场景下性能与ANN方法相当或更优；且所需核矩阵规模取决于配点数而非训练集大小，因此天然可扩展至大数据集。

Conclusion: EDMD-kDL为核方法在Koopman字典学习中提供了可行方案，兼具可解释性、理论可分析性与可扩展性，是ANN方法的有力替代。

Abstract: Koopman operator theory provides a linear framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems and has become a major tool for data-driven modeling. A central challenge, however, is that finite-dimensional approximations computed by methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) require the dictionary to be specified a priori. Recent machine-learning approaches address this limitation by learning the dictionary from data, predominantly using artificial neural network (ANN) autoencoder architectures. Although kernel methods offer an alternative with greater interpretability and tractability for theoretical analysis, they have received little attention in this setting. We introduce extended dynamic mode decomposition with kernel-based dictionary learning (EDMD-kDL), a kernel-based method for learning finite-dimensional Koopman embeddings directly from data. The method combines ideas from collocation methods and bilevel optimization to simultaneously learn a kernel dictionary and the corresponding Koopman approximation. We evaluate EDMD-kDL against state-of-the-art ANN-based approaches on a range of numerical experiments, including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and learning directly from video data. Across all tested settings, EDMD-kDL achieves performance comparable to or better than the ANN-based methods. Moreover, in contrast to standard kernel methods, the proposed approach is scalable to large datasets by design since the size of the required kernel matrices depends on the number of collocation points rather than the size of the training dataset.

</details>


### [442] [Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12379)
*Prabhav Singh,Xiheng Tom Wang,Haojun Shi,Jason Eisner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Marformer，一种直接预测条件边际分布的 Transformer，用于不完整信息下的决策，可高效计算贝叶斯风险与信息价值（VOI），在合成与真实数据上匹配或超越传统缺失数据方法且速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实决策常在不完整信息下进行，仅能观测部分随机变量时需预测其余变量。缺失变量的条件边际分布是计算贝叶斯风险与信息价值（VOI，即决策前多获取一次观测的期望收益）的关键要素。现有生成式方法需要建模完整联合分布、依赖数据生成过程的领域知识，且预测开销大。

Method: 提出 Marformer：类似 BERT 预测缺失词，该 Transformer 直接预测任意观测值集合下的条件边际。它为每个分布 p(X_i) 构造隐向量表示，并通过注意力机制对其他分布 p(X_j) 迭代细化。方法不建模完整联合分布，无需数据生成过程的领域知识，且所有预测在单次前向传播中完成。

Result: 在三个缺失数据合成域（贝叶斯网络、离散化多元高斯、结构化标注数据）上评估。Marformer 可匹配或超越经典缺失数据方法，即使这些方法被赋予生成合成数据的真实模型族与先验。在真实标注数据集上，Marformer 在最大训练规模下超越所评估的基线。两种情况下，Marformer 均显著快于所评估的生成式基线。

Conclusion: Marformer 是一种高效、无需领域知识、单次前向即可预测条件边际的 Transformer，适用于不完整信息下的贝叶斯风险与 VOI 计算，在合成与真实任务上兼具性能与速度优势。

Abstract: Real decisions are made under incomplete information. If we observe only some of the random variables we need, we can predict the others. The \textbf{conditional marginals} over the missing variables are the key ingredient for computing Bayes risk and Value of Information (VOI), the expected gain from acquiring one more observation before deciding. We present the Marformer, a Transformer trained to directly predict conditional marginals given any set of observed values. Like BERT, which is trained to predict missing words from context, the Marformer constructs a hidden-vector representation for each distribution $p(X_i)$ and iteratively refines it through attention to other distributions $p(X_j)$. Unlike generative approaches, the Marformer does not model the full joint distribution, requires no domain knowledge of the data-generating process, and makes all predictions in a single forward pass. We evaluate across three synthetic domains with missing data---Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, and structured annotation data. The Marformer can match or outperform classical missing-data methods, even when those methods are given the true model family and prior that generated the synthetic data. We also evaluate on a real annotation dataset, where the Marformer outperforms the evaluated baselines at the largest training size. In both cases, the Marformer is substantially faster than the evaluated generative baselines.

</details>


### [443] [Prospective Prediction of OOD Degradation from Source-Side Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12397)
*Sasha,Monin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个概念验证：仅利用源域训练动态，可在直接观测之前预测持续性的分布外（OOD）性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究是否能在OOD退化真正显现之前，仅凭源侧训练动态对其进行提前预警，从而为可靠性监测提供手段。

Method: 在受控的捷径学习（shortcut learning）设定下，使用简单的逻辑回归预测器；对源侧量采用时间汇总（temporal summaries）而非当前值；并将预测器从CNN无额外训练迁移到MLP。

Result: 逻辑回归预测器呈现明确的前瞻性信号，而仅用训练时长则无此信号；时间汇总信息远多于当前值；迁移到MLP时，置信度与熵动态保留了大量预测信息。

Conclusion: 源侧训练动态确实可能包含未来OOD失败的早期预警信号，构成该方向的概念验证。

Abstract: We study whether persistent out-of-distribution (OOD) degradation can be predicted before it is directly observed using only source-side training dynamics. In a controlled shortcut-learning setting, a simple logistic regression predictor develops a clear prospective signal, while training time alone does not. Temporal summaries of the source-side quantities are substantially more informative than their current values. When transferred without additional training from a CNN to an MLP, confidence and entropy dynamics retain substantial predictive information. These results provide a proof of principle that source-side training dynamics can contain an early warning signal for future OOD failure.

</details>


### [444] [Learning Kilometer-Scale Weather Prediction with Global-Regional Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12401)
*Guowen Li,Yang Liu,Yujie Wang,Qiuyan Sun,Haoyuan Liang,Juepeng Zheng,Hong Cheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ScaleCast区域天气预报框架，通过Global-Regional Alignment模块将预训练全球模型的大尺度预报对齐并融合到高分辨率区域预测中，在0.25°ERA5与5.5km CERRA上提升地表及高空变量预报，单一模型支持多种全球驱动，并适配3km HRRR域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公里级区域天气预报对局地预警和天气敏感决策至关重要。现有数据驱动方法要么依赖数值预报提供大尺度引导，要么需额外训练全球预报组件。预训练全球天气模型可作为高效的大尺度预报来源，但复用其引导高分辨率区域预测时，需解决全球与区域表征在不同网格间的对齐问题，并将全球引导与局地交互融合以推进区域状态演化。

Method: ScaleCast是一个区域预报框架，核心为Global-Regional Alignment机制。其Global-Regional Conversion模块将联合的全球与区域表征对齐到区域位置；Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics模块将对齐后的全球引导与区域邻域相互作用相结合。全球侧使用ERA5 0.25°分析，区域侧使用5.5km CERRA区域再分析进行实验；并通过在3km HRRR上微调验证跨域与跨分辨率适应性。

Result: 在ERA5 0.25°与CERRA 5.5km配置下，地表及高空变量的区域预报均有提升；单一训练模型无需针对特定驱动重训即可支持Pangu-Weather、GraphCast与HRES多种全球预报驱动。在3km HRRR上微调后，框架展现出对不同区域域和空间分辨率的适应能力。风暴个例研究显示气旋定位与核心气压估计改善；与HadISD站点观测对比显示局地温湿变化更一致。

Conclusion: ScaleCast通过Global-Regional Alignment有效复用预训练全球模型的引导能力，实现了无需重训即可兼容多全球驱动的公里级区域预报，并具备跨域、跨分辨率的可迁移性，在气旋定位、核心气压及站点温湿变化刻画上表现更优，为区域高分辨率数据驱动预报提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Kilometer-scale regional weather forecasting is essential for local weather warnings and weather-sensitive decisions. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on numerical forecasts for large-scale guidance or require additional training of global forecasting components. Pretrained global weather models offer an efficient source of large-scale forecasts, motivating their reuse to guide high-resolution regional prediction. However, this coupling requires aligning global and regional representations across different grids and integrating global guidance with local interactions to advance regional states. We propose ScaleCast, a regional forecasting framework that addresses these challenges through Global-Regional Alignment. Its Global-Regional Conversion module aligns joint global and regional representations with regional locations, while the Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block combines aligned guidance with regional neighborhood interactions. Experiments using ERA5 global analyses on a 0.25-degree grid and CERRA regional reanalysis at 5.5 km spacing demonstrate improved regional forecasts across surface and upper-air variables, with a single trained model supporting multiple global forecast drivers (i.e., Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES) without specific retraining. Fine-tuning on HRRR at 3 km spacing further demonstrates the framework's adaptability to a different regional domain and spatial resolution. Windstorm case studies show improved cyclone positioning and core-pressure estimates, while comparisons with HadISD station observations show closer agreement with local temperature and humidity changes.

</details>


### [445] [A Unified Bellman Operator for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12420)
*Nishanth Arun Rao,Royina Karegoudra Jayanth,Benjamin Eysenbach,Jaime Fernández Fisac*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种联合贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标统一到一个联合价值函数中，并在双时间尺度随机逼近框架下证明其时序差分学习收敛，收敛后的最优策略在始终保持安全的同时最大化任务回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键领域要求强化学习在最大化任务性能的同时严格满足安全约束。现有安全强化学习范式存在两难：要么依赖先验知识提供严格安全保证（如安全过滤器），要么支持联合学习但仅能满足平均意义上的安全约束。

Method: 提出一种新的贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标统一为联合价值函数；采用双时间尺度随机逼近框架进行时序差分学习，快时间尺度估计学习联合策略的安全价值，慢时间尺度估计联合价值；通过将极限动力学表述为占用平均微分包含（occupation-averaged differential inclusion）来保证收敛。

Result: 证明该极限动力学渐近收敛到一组极限最优安全约束任务价值函数；在连续控制任务上使用神经逼近的实证评估显示收敛稳定，测试时安全违规接近零。

Conclusion: 该联合贝尔曼算子方法在理论上保证收敛后的最优策略既能最大化任务回报又能始终维持安全，实验表明其实现了稳定收敛与近乎零的安全违规，为安全强化学习提供了一种兼顾严格安全与联合学习的范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning in safety-critical domains requires maximizing task performance while strictly adhering to safety constraints. Existing safe reinforcement learning paradigms typically force a trade-off: they either require a priori knowledge to provide strict safety guarantees (e.g., safety filters), or they enable joint learning but only satisfy safety constraints on average. In this work, we propose a novel Bellman operator that unifies performance and safety objectives into a joint value function. We show that temporal difference learning with the joint Bellman operator converges under a two-timescale stochastic approximation framework. On the fast timescale, the safety value of the learning joint policy is estimated, while the joint value is estimated on the slow timescale. Convergence is ensured by formulating the limiting dynamics as an occupation-averaged differential inclusion, and showing that it asymptotically converges to a set of limiting optimal safety-constrained task value functions. Theoretically, once converged, the resulting optimal policy maximizes task return while maintaining safety at all times. Empirical evaluations on continuous control tasks with neural approximations demonstrate stable convergence with near-zero safety violations at test time.

</details>


### [446] [Rounding in Preconditioner Space: Redesigning 4-bit AdamW Optimizer-State Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12444)
*Hanyang Li,Shao Tang,Daniel Thomas Braithwaite,Gregory Dexter,Leonardo Neves,Aman Gupta,Hiroto Udagawa,Abhishek Shivanna,Daniel Silva,Rohan Ramanath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从"舍入空间"视角重新设计AdamW的4-bit优化器状态量化，提出ZIP-SR（零包含+预条件子空间随机舍入）与ZE-EDEN（零排除+重标定）两种方案，在130M–2.7B模型上将4-bit AdamW与32-bit的验证损失差距最多缩小70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化AdamW优化器状态可降低持久化存储，但量化误差会通过一阶/二阶矩的递推传播，扰动后续自适应更新。作者指出：在状态空间上"均值误差小"并不意味着下一步的预条件子误差小，因此需要重新审视量化器选择重建电平的坐标（即舍入空间），以抑制误差在递归中的放大。

Method: 1) 对二阶矩中邻近零点的量化单元做局部分析，说明小的状态均值误差不保证小的预条件子误差；2) 构造一维二次型例子，展示状态空间舍入与预条件子空间舍入会导致定性不同的优化动态；3) 据此提出ZIP-SR：二阶矩码本保留零，并在预条件子空间计算随机舍入概率；4) 作为互补路线提出ZE-EDEN：二阶矩码本排除零，并对量化后的二阶矩块进行重标定以缓解正量化下限带来的预条件子畸变；5) 两者一阶矩均用NF4，并在训练最后10%对LM-head一阶矩施加定向随机舍入。

Result: 在130M至2.7B参数的GPT与Llama风格预训练实验中，两种方法在每个评测规模上都缩小了TorchAO 4-bit AdamW相对32-bit AdamW的平均验证损失差距，最大差距缩减达70%。在全参数监督微调中，两种方案验证损失均低于TorchAO，且在下游任务上接近32-bit AdamW。

Conclusion: 舍入空间的选择（状态空间 vs 预条件子空间）以及二阶矩码本是否包含零，是决定4-bit AdamW量化误差传播行为的关键设计维度；ZIP-SR与ZE-EDEN通过相应设计有效提升4-bit优化器状态的训练质量，同时保持较低的存储开销。

Abstract: Quantizing AdamW's optimizer states reduces persistent storage, but quantization errors propagate through the moment recurrences and perturb subsequent adaptive updates. We redesign 4-bit optimizer-state quantization for AdamW from the perspective of \emph{rounding space}: the coordinate in which a quantizer chooses between adjacent reconstruction levels. For the second moment, a local analysis of the quantization cell adjacent to zero shows that small mean state error need not imply small mean preconditioner error at the next step. A one-dimensional quadratic construction further shows qualitatively different optimization dynamics under state-space and preconditioner-space rounding. These results motivate Zero-Inclusive Preconditioner-space Stochastic Rounding (\textbf{ZIP-SR}), which retains zero in the second-moment codebook and computes stochastic-rounding probabilities in preconditioner space. As a complementary route, Zero-Excluding EDEN calibration (\textbf{ZE-EDEN}) uses a zero-excluding second-moment codebook and rescales the quantized second-moment block to mitigate the preconditioner distortion caused by the positive quantization floor. Both configurations use 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) for the first moment, with targeted stochastic rounding of the LM-head first moment during the final 10\% of training. Across GPT- and Llama-style pretraining experiments ranging from \textbf{130M} to \textbf{2.7B} parameters, both methods reduce TorchAO 4-bit AdamW's mean validation-loss gap to 32-bit AdamW at every evaluated model size, with the largest reported gap reduction reaching \textbf{70\%}. In full-parameter supervised fine-tuning, both recipes achieve lower validation loss than TorchAO while remaining close to 32-bit AdamW on downstream tasks.

</details>


### [447] [Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12445)
*Oskar J. Hollinsworth,Alex F. Spies,Tigist Diriba,Adam Gleave,Chris Cundy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出可扩展的LLM智能体白盒欺骗检测方法：构建迄今最大欺骗数据集FIBS，设计可跨多层多token聚合信息的探针架构，在SHADE-Arena达98.8% AUC，并首次探索"内省式欺骗"检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期事件凸显了对LLM智能体进行监控的困难以及模型欺骗人类的风险，而现有黑盒文本监控基线在前沿监控场景下效果不足，需要更有效的探测手段。

Method: 1）收集迄今最大的欺骗检测训练数据集（FIBS）；2）提出新型探针架构，可在多个层与多个token间聚合信息；3）将白盒探针方法扩展到前沿监控规模；4）设置"内省式欺骗"评测，即欺骗无法仅从上下文判断、真值只能通过引导式提问或对模型训练数据的深入知识获得。

Result: 在SHADE-Arena上探针达到98.8% AUC，超过文本监控基线；随着底层模型规模扩大，探针效果提升。在内省式欺骗评测中，探针区分包含模型真实隐藏目标的对话记录与其他目标的AUC最高达99.7%。探针还能有效检测主流开放权重模型在政治敏感话题上撒谎以及在被施压时谎报自身信念的行为。

Conclusion: 白盒探针可被扩展用于前沿监控并有效检测多种欺骗行为，作者公开发布FIBS数据集，以推动有效探针的前沿部署，并鼓励社区补充更多欺骗与破坏行为样本。

Abstract: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

</details>


### [448] [Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12449)
*Anna Zimmel,Fleur Hendriks,Markus Holzleitner,Florian Sestak,Martin Weichselbaumer,Vlado Menkovski,Johannes Brandstetter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Bi-FORK，一个通过潜空间流匹配与排斥引导采样学习高维物理系统中对称破缺分岔一对多解映射的生成框架，在多种分岔系统上恢复多模态解结构并显著扩展规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分岔现象在物理系统中普遍存在，但在深度学习中探索甚少。在对称破缺分岔处，单一输入对应多个同样有效的解，违背了大多数学习型物理代理模型所依赖的一对一假设。

Method: Bi-FORK采用潜空间流匹配生成完整轨迹以保持空间与时间连贯性，并使用排斥引导采样在一次摊销推理中恢复不同的解分支。

Result: 在屈曲梁、力学超材料和Allen-Cahn相分离上评估，涵盖连续、离散和场值分岔，离散点数最高达260,000，成功恢复多模态解结构，规模超出先前方法数个数量级。

Conclusion: Bi-FORK将生成式建模拓展至高维分岔物理系统，为学习一对多解映射提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.

</details>


### [449] [Compactness and Consistency: A Conjoint Framework for Deep Graph Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11506)
*Wei Ju,Siyu Yi,Kangjie Zheng,Yifan Wang,Ziyue Qiao,Li Shen,Yongdao Zhou,Xiaochun Cao,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CoCo联合框架，通过局部-全局图卷积滤波与低秩紧凑嵌入编码，结合一致性学习，实现兼具紧凑性与一致性的深度图聚类表示，实验优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN用于图聚类虽有效，但局部消息传递难以捕捉节点全局关系；图数据中冗余与噪声导致节点表示缺乏紧凑性与鲁棒性。

Method: CoCo利用图卷积滤波从局部与全局两个视角学习鲁棒节点表示，并将其编码为低秩紧凑嵌入以去除冗余噪声、揭示内在结构；再基于紧凑嵌入设计一致性学习策略，促进两视角间的知识迁移以丰富节点语义。

Result: 在多个数据集上，CoCo优于当前最先进（state-of-the-art）的对比方法。

Conclusion: 在深度图聚类中同时建模表示的紧凑性与一致性可有效缓解局部信息局限及数据冗余噪声问题，提升聚类性能。

Abstract: Graph clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, aiming at grouping nodes with similar characteristics in the graph into clusters. This problem has been widely explored using graph neural networks (GNNs) due to their ability to leverage node attributes and graph topology for effective cluster assignments. However, representations learned through GNNs typically struggle to capture global relationships between nodes via local message-passing mechanisms. Moreover, the redundancy and noise inherently present in graph data may easily result in node representations lacking compactness and robustness. To address these issues, we propose a conjoint framework CoCo, which captures compactness and consistency in the learned node representations for deep graph clustering. Technically, our CoCo leverages graph convolutional filters to learn robust node representations from both local and global views, and then encodes them into low-rank compact embeddings, thus effectively removing the redundancy and noise as well as uncovering the intrinsic underlying structure. To further enrich the node semantics, we develop a consistency learning strategy based on compact embeddings to facilitate knowledge transfer from the two perspectives. Our experimental results indicate that our CoCo outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts on various datasets.

</details>


### [450] [Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11692)
*Yi Ma,Tianpei Yang,Yaodong Yang,Weixun Wang,Hongyao Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将冻结的决策模型Jev作为强化学习训练过程的组件，验证其在参考策略、探索评判与回放评分三个位置上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型能缓解强化学习在样本效率和迁移上的弱点，但其逐token生成导致查询串行且昂贵；Jev作为决策模型单次前向即可返回校准答案，但现有研究未考察其在RL环境中的自主决策能力及其作为训练组件的价值。

Method: 先分析RL系统各对象对答案的需求，判定Jev除值函数的基数用途外均可满足，剩余对象形成多个可承担多种角色的位置；随后在三个位置上使用Jev构建算法：参考策略、探索评判者和回放评分者。

Result: 在九个MiniGrid任务和三个Atari游戏上，使用Jev训练优于标准RL学习器，包括学习器单独无法取得进展的场景，且模型本身保持未训练状态。

Conclusion: 这是首次在RL学习过程中使用Jev，确立了冻结决策模型可作为RL训练的可用组件，并邀请进一步探索Jev及其他先进决策模型改进RL的潜力。

Abstract: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance.
