# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [579] [Propagation-Invariant Transmission Eigenmodes in Weakly Scattering Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10732)
*J. C Osorio-Tascon,P. A. Quinto-Su*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 研究散射不变模式（SIMs）能否同时具备散射不变性与传播不变性，通过测量环形基下的透射矩阵，发现弱散射下存在局域化SIMs并呈类贝塞尔传播，强散射下局域化消失但SIMs仍保持更强传播鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传播不变光束依赖环形角谱维持横向强度结构，而散射不变模式依赖透射矩阵本征模式抵抗散射，二者是否可兼得此前尚不明确，本文旨在探究SIMs能否同时表现出散射与传播不变性。

Method: 在正交环形基下，对弱、中、强散射介质分别测量自由空间与样品的透射矩阵（TMs），据此识别角谱主要局限于一个或少数相邻环的局域化SIMs（LSIMs），并对比LSIMs与高斯型、贝塞尔光束的传播行为。

Result: 弱散射下128个SIMs中有75个满足环形局域化判据，LSIMs呈类贝塞尔传播；中等散射下经滤除低强度谱分量后恢复25个LSIMs，强散射下则无。随模式串扰增强，环形局域化与无衍射行为逐渐受抑，但SIMs在中、强散射区仍比高斯型与贝塞尔光束具有更高的横向强度相关性。

Conclusion: 环形局域化使SIMs在弱散射时获得传播不变性；即使局域化丧失，SIMs增强的传播鲁棒性仍可保持，表明散射不变性与传播不变性可在弱散射条件下共存。

Abstract: Propagation-invariant beams (PIBs) with annular angular spectra preserve their transverse intensity structure over extended propagation distances. Here, we investigate whether scattering invariant modes (SIMs) can simultaneously exhibit scattering and propagation invariance. We measure free-space and sample transmission matrices (TMs) in an orthonormal annular basis for weak, moderate, and strong scattering media and identify localized SIMs (LSIMs) whose angular spectra remain predominantly confined to one or a few neighboring rings. Under weak scattering, 75 of the 128 SIMs considered for annular localization satisfy this criterion, with LSIMs exhibiting Bessel-like propagation. Under moderate scattering, 25 LSIMs are recovered after filtering low-intensity spectral components, whereas none are found under strong scattering. Although increasing modal crosstalk progressively suppresses annular localization and nondiffracting behavior, SIMs retain higher transverse-intensity correlation over propagation than the Gaussian-like and Bessel beams in the moderate and strong regimes. These results show that annular localization enables SIMs to acquire propagation invariance when scattering is weak, whereas the enhanced propagation robustness of SIMs can persist even after this localization is lost.

</details>


### [580] [Inverse Design of Integrated Photonic Components for Visible-Light Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11453)
*Christoph Stockinger,Marko Šimić,John O. Adeniran,Natale G. Pruiti,Marc Sorel,Peter Banzer*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对可见光波段光子集成电路的伴随法、工艺感知逆向设计流程，通过扩展开源GPU加速FDTD求解器FDTDX构建高效设计平台，并在Si3N4平台上实验验证了超紧凑宽带的光路由、复用与偏振控制器件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可见光波段PIC对量子技术、光学传感和非线性光学至关重要，但受限于低折射率对比度与基于直觉的设计参数空间有限，导致集成密度与工作带宽不足。

Method: 采用伴随法（adjoint-based）结合工艺感知（fabrication-aware）的逆向设计工作流；扩展开源GPU加速FDTD求解器FDTDX，构建内存与运行时间高效的通用逆向设计平台；以氮化硅（Si3N4）平台为对象设计器件。

Result: 在Si3N4平台上设计、制造并实验验证了用于光路由、复用和偏振控制的超紧凑、宽带器件。

Conclusion: 该工作为高密度、高性能可见光PIC提供了可扩展的设计框架。

Abstract: Photonic integrated circuits (PICs) operating in the visible spectral range are crucial for quantum technologies, optical sensing, and nonlinear optics applications. However, their development is hampered by limited integration density and operational bandwidth, linked to low refractive index contrast and restricted parameter space in intuition-based PIC design. We address these bottlenecks with an adjoint-based, fabrication-aware inverse design workflow tailored for visible-spectrum photonics. By expanding the capabilities of FDTDX, an open-source, GPU-accelerated FDTD solver, we provide a versatile memory and runtime efficient inverse design platform. Demonstrating this approach on a silicon nitride (Si3N4) platform, we design, fabricate, and experimentally validate ultra-compact, broadband components for light routing, multiplexing, and polarization control. This work provides a scalable framework for high-density, high-performance visible-light PICs.

</details>


### [581] [Undetected Photon Spectroscopy in the Long-wave and Far Infrared](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11582)
*Jinghan Dong,Jingrui Zhang,Haichen Zhou,Weijie Nie,John G. Rarity,Alex S. Clark*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文将未探测光子光谱技术拓展至20 μm，基于BGGSe非线性干涉仪，仅用硅探测器探测近红外信号光，实现了7.8–20 μm宽带吸收光谱及SF6气体检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未探测光子光谱可在不直接探测探测样品的长波光的情况下获得样品长波光谱响应，但此前在分子指纹区的演示仅达到约10.5 μm，更长波长基本未被探索，亟需拓展其可及光谱范围。

Method: 采用基于BaGa2GeSe6（BGGSe）晶体的非线性干涉仪，通过旋转晶体实现宽波段波长调谐，仅使用硅探测器探测近红外（NIR）信号光；对信号干涉图进行傅里叶变换分析，获得对应的闲频光光谱与样品透射率。

Result: 使用Kapton在7.8–20 μm波段实现了宽带吸收光谱，测量吸收与独立红外测量结果一致；同一系统在约10.55 μm处实现了六氟化硫（SF6）气体检测。

Conclusion: 该工作显著拓展了未探测光子光谱的可及光谱范围，同时保留了基于硅的近红外探测方案，为长波红外光谱检测提供了新途径。

Abstract: Spectroscopy with undetected photons allows the spectral response of a sample at long wavelengths to be measured through interference of a shorter-wavelength signal field, without directly detecting the light that probes the sample. Previous demonstrations of undetected-photon spectroscopy in the molecular fingerprint region have reached approximately 10.5 microns, leaving longer wavelengths largely unexplored. Here, we extend this approach to 20 microns wavelength, demonstrating infrared undetected-photon spectroscopy using a BaGa2GeSe6 (BGGSe)-based nonlinear interferometer while only the near-infrared (NIR) signal is detected using a silicon detector. Rotation of the BGGSe crystal provides broad wavelength tuning, and Fourier-transform analysis of the signal interferograms yields the corresponding idler spectra and sample transmittance. Broadband absorption spectroscopy is demonstrated using Kapton across a 7.8-20 microns wavelength range, with the measured absorption agreeing with independent infrared measurements. The same system is further employed to detect sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) gas via spectroscopy near 10.55 microns. These results substantially extend the accessible spectral range of spectroscopy with undetected photons while retaining silicon-based NIR detection.

</details>


### [582] [Harnessing Machine Learning for Ultrafast Science in Facility Settings: Opportunities and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12146)
*Mousumi Upadhyay Kahaly,Ishraq Md Anjum,Davorin Peceli,Zsolt Divek,Subhendu Kahaly*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文指出超快科学正从专用激光实验演变为设施级、数据密集型研究，并以ELI生态为例，提出机器学习的设施级数字架构（采集—接入—存储—分析—机器学习—自适应反馈—用户界面），主张机器学习不应仅作离线分析工具，而应在物理约束与稳健数据基础设施支撑下服务于实时诊断、代理建模、异常检测、实验优化及自主发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高重复频率飞秒/阿秒光源、同步多维诊断与强非线性激光-物质相互作用产生异构数据流，其体量、速度与复杂度超出传统人工工作流处理能力；因此需要将机器学习作为下一代超快设施的赋能层，解决数据密集型实验的管理与实时决策问题。

Method: 采用综述/架构性论述：分析人工智能辅助实验的科学驱动力；提出涵盖采集、接入、存储、分析、机器学习、自适应反馈与用户界面的设施级数字架构；并结合ELI ALPS、ELI Beamlines、ELI-NP的代表性案例进行评述。

Result: 归纳出机器学习在物理洞察约束下可支撑实时诊断、代理建模、异常检测、实验优化以及逐步自主的发现工作流，并给出面向ELI生态的设施级数字架构框架与跨设施应用示例。

Conclusion: 机器学习应被定位为超快设施的核心使能层而非单纯离线分析工具；当受物理知识约束并嵌入稳健数据基础设施时，它可推动超快科学走向更高程度的自动化与自主发现。

Abstract: Ultrafast science is rapidly evolving from a collection of specialized laser experiments into a facility-scale, data-intensive research endeavour. High-repetition-rate femtosecond and attosecond sources, synchronized multidimensional diagnostics, and increasingly nonlinear laser-matter interactions now generate heterogeneous data streams whose volume, speed, and complexity often exceed the capacity of conventional manual workflows. This chapter examines how machine learning can become an enabling layer for next-generation ultrafast facilities, with emphasis on the Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI) ecosystem. We discuss the scientific drivers for artificial-intelligence-assisted experimentation, propose a facility-scale digital architecture spanning acquisition, ingestion, storage, analytics, machine learning, adaptive feedback, and user interfaces, and review representative examples from ELI ALPS, ELI Beamlines, and ELI-NP. The central thesis is that machine learning should not be treated merely as an offline data-analysis tool; rather, when constrained by physical insight and embedded in robust data infrastructure, it can support real-time diagnostics, surrogate modeling, anomaly detection, experimental optimization, and progressively autonomous discovery workflows.

</details>


### [583] [Photoluminescence study of Vanadium in 4H- and 6H- Silicon Carbide](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10781)
*Ibrahim Boulares,Anne R. Evans,Jeremy L. Smith,Brenda VanMil*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文通过低温偏振分辨光致发光测量，系统表征了4H-和6H-SiC中V4+色心的零声子线偏振选择定则，明确了各α、γ及β格位的σ/π偏振特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: V4+色心兼具可寻址自旋与电信O波段发光，是量子网络的理想候选，但其偏振选择定则尚未被实验完整测定，限制了自旋-光子界面的利用。

Method: 在低温下对4H-和6H-SiC中钒零声子线进行偏振相关光致发光测量，采用edge和face-on两种散射几何（发射波矢分别垂直于和平行于晶体c轴）。

Result: 四个α格位中α2和α3以及6H-SiC的γ格位发射偏振平行于c轴（σ偏振）；α1和α4发射偏振垂直于c轴（π偏振）；并给出β格位的初步低信号测量结果。

Conclusion: 实验绘制了钒色心零声子线的偏振选择定则，揭示了不同格位间σ/π偏振的差异，为基于V4+的量子网络自旋-光子界面设计提供了依据。

Abstract: Point defects with optically addressable spin states are a key building block for quantum networks, but few solid-state emitters combine a spin-photon interface with emission in the low-loss telecommunications band. Vanadium (V4+) defects in silicon carbide (SiC) meet this requirement, emitting zero-phonon lines (ZPLs) throughout the telecom O-band in both the 4H- and 6H-SiC polytypes while retaining an addressable electron and nuclear spin system [1,2]. Although the orbital and spin structure of these defects has been characterized in detail, the polarization selection rules have not been fully mapped experimentally. Here we present polarization-dependent photoluminescence (PL) measurements of vanadium ZPLs in 4H- and 6H-SiC at cryogenic temperature, of two scattering geometries: edge and face-on (emission wavevector perpendicular and parallel to the crystal c-axis, respectively). Emission from two of the four α sites, (α2 and α3) and the 6H-SiC γ sites, are polarized parallel to the c-axis (σ-polarized), whereas emission from α1 and α4 are polarized perpendicular to the c-axis (π-polarized). Additionally, we report preliminary, lower signal measurements of the \b{eta} sites.

</details>


### [584] [Optimal Diffractive Focusing of Vortex Beams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10842)
*Roohollah Ghobadi,Carrie Rodriguez,Lukas Scarfe,Maxim A. Efremov,Ebrahim Karimi*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文将有轨道角动量（OAM）的近轴光束通过有限圆孔的衍射环聚焦问题，构建为变分优化问题。对固定拓扑荷，在输入场归一化约束下，求解使指定环半径与传播距离处强度最大的实值径向光瞳，得到精确解析解：最优光瞳由菲涅耳相位与依赖OAM的贝塞尔径向调制组合而成，相应本征值给出环上强度的严格上界。理论还分析了透镜辅助构型、给出了衍射与折射涡旋聚焦的比较界限，并为二元菲涅耳-贝塞尔波带片及振幅加权光瞳等实用掩模提供定量评价框架，并通过光学实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 涡旋光束的衍射聚焦在结构光操控中具有重要意义，但缺乏对"在给定环半径与传播距离处可达最大强度"这一基本极限的严格刻画。本文旨在建立一种变分框架，为携带OAM的紧致光束在有限孔径下的衍射环聚焦确定根本性能上限，并统一评价实际掩模设计。

Method: 将衍射环聚焦表述为变分优化问题：固定拓扑荷，在输入场归一化约束下，寻找最大化指定环半径与传播距离处强度的实值径向光瞳。求解该优化问题获得精确解析解，并分析透镜辅助构型以推导衍射与折射涡旋聚焦的比较界限；同时用该理论定量评估二元菲涅耳-贝塞尔波带片与振幅加权光瞳等实用设计。实验上在光学域实现对应的涡旋光束光瞳，比较其传播与聚焦性能。

Result: 最优光瞳具有解析形式：菲涅耳相位结构与OAM相关贝塞尔径向调制的结合；对应的本征值给出环上强度的严格上界。透镜辅助构型可导出简洁界限，实现衍射与折射涡旋聚焦的直接比较。理论框架可定量评价实用掩模性能，实验结果与最优解的预测一致（用于验证理论与对比实际光瞳的传播与聚焦表现）。

Conclusion: 本文建立了振幅型最优聚焦的涡旋光束类比，明确了支配结构波衍射聚焦的基本极限，为OAM光束衍射环聚焦提供了严格的变分理论基础与实用设计评价工具。

Abstract: We formulate diffractive ring focusing of paraxial beams carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) through a finite circular aperture as a variational optimization problem. For a fixed topological charge, we determine the real-valued radial pupil that maximizes the intensity at a prescribed ring radius and propagation distance under a normalization constraint on the input field. The resulting problem admits an exact analytical solution: the optimal pupil combines the familiar Fresnel phase structure with an OAM-dependent Bessel radial modulation, and the associated eigenvalue yields a rigorous upper bound on the achievable ring intensity. We further analyze the lens-assisted configuration and derive a simple bound that allows direct comparison between diffractive and refractive vortex focusing. The theory also provides a quantitative framework for evaluating the performance of practical mask designs, including binary Fresnel-Bessel zone plates and amplitude-weighted pupils. We have experimentally tested our predictions in the optical domain by implementing the corresponding vortex beam pupils and comparing their propagation and focusing performance with the optimal solution. Our results establish the vortex-beam analogue of optimal amplitude-only focusing and identify the fundamental limits governing diffractive concentration of structured waves

</details>


### [585] [Topological Spatiotemporal Mode-Locked Lasers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11009)
*Xiaokang Lian,Yuchen Zhang,Mutian Xu,Bing Han,Chengkun Cai,Jun Liu,Jian Wang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出并实现一种基于模分复用的拓扑时空锁模光纤激光器，通过引入模式间时延构造拓扑时空晶格，实现稳定的周期时空孤子并观察到类玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的嵌套型时空孤子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在光学和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体系中实现稳健的高维孤子长期面临挑战，主要源于不可预测的高阶微扰。因此需要一种能精确调控并稳定高维时空孤子的新方案。

Method: 采用模分复用技术构建多模腔内的拓扑时空锁模光纤激光器；在各横模光路之间引入时间延迟，形成拓扑时空晶格，激发周期性时空孤子；借助非互易耗散耦合作用诱导的周期势提供稳定性，并在热力学极限下考察孤子行为。

Result: 成功激发周期性时空孤子，且对微扰保持稳定；在热力学极限下孤子凝聚为嵌套型时空孤子，表现出类似物质波玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的现象。

Conclusion: 拓扑时空锁模激光器不仅是可控且稳健的时空光弹来源，还为研究非线性高维孤子动力学和非厄米拓扑物理提供了有价值的平台。

Abstract: Achieving robust high-dimensional solitons both in optics and Bose-Einstein condensates remains a great challenge, due to unpredictable high-order perturbations. Here we propose and demonstrate a novel topological spatiotemporal mode-locked fiber laser empowered by mode-division multiplexing, for precisely controlling of the spatiotemporal solitons. By introducing time delays between the individual transverse mode paths, a topological spatiotemporal lattice is formed in the multimode cavity, which in turn excites periodic spatiotemporal solitons. These solitons are stable against the perturbations, attributed to periodic potentials induced by the nonreciprocal dissipative coupling interactions. Moreover, under the thermodynamic limit, the solitons condense into nested-type spatiotemporal solitons, a phenomenon analogous to the Bose-Einstein condensate of matter waves. Our results indicate that topological spatiotemporal mode-locked lasers not only constitute a controllable source of robust spatiotemporal light bullets, but also provide a valuable platform for exploring nonlinear high-dimensional soliton dynamics and non-Hermitian topological physics.

</details>


### [586] [Optical Signals Synthesized from an Optical Lattice Clock with Uncertainty of 1.3E-17](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11178)
*Yuan Yao,Jinpeng Zou,Haosen Shi,Hongfu Yu,Longsheng Ma,Yanyi Jiang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文报道了一种基于光学频率梳的精密光学频率合成器，可将171Yb光晶格钟的输出频率分频，在宽光谱范围内产生高稳定度、高准确度的单频激光，输出信号继承了Yb光钟的频率准确度，其频率不确定度为6.8 mHz（相对不确定度1.3E-17）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要一种能够在宽光学波段内提供高频率稳定度与准确度的激光源；通过将输出频率溯源至光晶格钟，可将原子钟的准确度传递到任意所需光学频率上。

Method: 利用基于光学频率梳的精密光学频率分频器，将171Yb光晶格钟的频率进行分频，从而合成所需频率的单频激光信号。并对171Yb光晶格钟的频率不确定度进行了评估。

Result: 合成器输出为单频激光，频率稳定度和准确度高，覆盖宽光学区域，并继承Yb光钟的频率准确度。171Yb光晶格钟的频率不确定度评估为6.8 mHz，对应相对频率不确定度1.3E-17，主要受黑体辐射频移和晶格诱导光频移限制。

Conclusion: 基于光频梳分频的光学频率合成器可有效将171Yb光晶格钟的准确度传递至宽波段光学频率，实现高准确度单频激光输出；当前精度主要受黑体辐射频移和晶格光频移限制。

Abstract: We report an accurate optical frequency synthesizer, which can generate single-frequency laser light with high frequency stability and accuracy at desired frequencies over a wide optical region. The frequency of the output signal is divided from an 171Yb optical lattice clock via an accurate optical frequency divider based on an optical frequency comb. Therefore, the output of the optical frequency synthesizer inherits the frequency accuracy from the Yb optical clock. The frequency uncertainty of the 171Yb optical lattice clock is evaluated to be 6.8 mHz, corresponding to a fractional frequency uncertainty of 1.3E-17, mainly limited by the blackbody radiation shift and the lattice-induced light shift.

</details>


### [587] [Full-Vector Diffractive Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11274)
*Shengmei Zhao,Gongyuan Wang,Zhiwan Wang,Jianan Shao,Haolin Liu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出V-D2NN，将完整矢量角谱法嵌入端到端训练，实现级联衍射层中偏振耦合与矢量衍射的物理严格建模，在偏振复用任务与纵向场工程上超越标量/半矢量模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）将偏振视为独立通道，依赖标量或半矢量传播模型，忽略了交叉偏振耦合与矢量衍射，因而无法准确描述矢量光与物质的相互作用，也限制了偏振相关功能的优化能力。

Method: 将完整的矢量角谱法（vector angular spectrum method）嵌入端到端训练流程，构建矢量D2NN（V-D2NN）框架。该框架在级联衍射层间对矢量光-物质相互作用进行物理严格描述，从而可直接优化偏振转换、自旋-轨道耦合与矢量干涉，且无需外部偏振光学元件；同时提供开源训练框架。

Result: 在偏振复用任务（矢量光束生成、偏振相关成像与分类、多通道光学加密）中，V-D2NN一致优于标量与半矢量对照模型；在纵向场工程中，可主动整形指定纵向场，归一化相关度达0.839，该能力为标量传播模型所不具备。

Conclusion: V-D2NN通过物理严格的矢量传播建模拓展了衍射神经网络的能力边界，尤其在偏振复用与纵向场调控方面具有标量模型无法实现的功能，其开源框架可支撑矢量衍射光学在计算、传感与通信领域的进一步发展。

Abstract: Conventional diffractive deep neural networks (D2NNs) treat polarization as independent channels and rely on scalar or semi-vectorial propagation models, which neglect cross polarization coupling and vector diffraction. Here we propose a vector D2NN (V-D2NN) that embeds the full vector angular spectrum method into the end-to-end training pipeline. This physically rigorous framework describes vectorial light-matter interactions across cascaded diffractive layers, enabling direct optimization of polarization conversion, spin-orbit coupling, and vectorial interference without external polarization optics. We demonstrate the V-D2NN on polarization-multiplexed tasks--ector beam generation, polarization dependent imaging and classification, and multiple channel optical encryption--where it consistently outperforms scalar and semi-vectorial counterparts. In longitudinal-field engineering, the V-D2NN actively shapes a prescribed longitudinal field with a normalized correlation of 0.839, a capability inaccessible to scalar-propagation models. An open-source training framework is also provided to support further development of vectorial diffractive optics for computing, sensing, and communications.

</details>


### [588] [Impact of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering on Modulation Instability in Fiber Fabry-Perot Resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11413)
*Alice Houard,Thomas Bunel,Matteo Conforti,Saliya Coulibaly,Arnaud Mussot*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文实验与数值证明了在光纤Fabry–Perot谐振腔中，受激布里渊散射可稳定由Kerr效应驱动的调制不稳定性。布里渊散射将调制不稳定谱整形为稳定的多自由光谱范围级联，该级联在无布里渊效应时是不稳定的；其稳定机制源于布里渊响应的实部，形成由布里渊频移与腔共振相对位置决定的不对称Kerr–布里渊相互作用。该结果将受激布里渊散射确立为调控Kerr谐振腔非线性动力学的额外自由度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kerr驱动的调制不稳定性在谐振腔中通常表现出不稳定、复杂的非线性动力学，如何有效控制其谱演化是一个关键问题。作者希望探究受激布里渊散射是否可作为新的调控机制，以稳定并整形调制不稳定谱。

Method: 采用实验与数值相结合的方法，研究对象为光纤Fabry–Perot谐振腔中的Kerr驱动调制不稳定性，并分析受激布里渊散射对调制不稳定谱的作用，特别关注布里渊响应实部以及布里渊频移相对于腔共振位置的影响。

Result: 受激布里渊散射可将调制不稳定谱整形为稳定的多自由光谱范围级联，而没有布里渊效应时该谱是不稳定的；稳定效应来源于布里渊响应的实部，并导致由布里渊频移与腔共振相对位置控制的不对称Kerr–布里渊相互作用。

Conclusion: 受激布里渊散射可作为控制Kerr谐振腔非线性动力学的附加自由度，为调制不稳定性谱的稳定与调控提供了新机制。

Abstract: We report the experimental and numerical demonstration of stimulated Brillouin scattering-induced stabilization of Kerr-driven modulation instability in fiber Fabry--Perot resonators. We show that Brillouin scattering shapes the modulation instability spectrum into a stable multi--free-spectral-range cascade that is otherwise unstable in the absence of Brillouin effects. We further identify that this stabilization originates from the real part of the Brillouin response, leading to an asymmetric Kerr-Brillouin interaction governed by the relative position of the Brillouin frequency shift with respect to the cavity resonances. These results establish stimulated Brillouin scattering as an additional degree of freedom for controlling nonlinear dynamics in Kerr resonators.

</details>


### [589] [Engineering Photon Avalanche Thresholds in Single Nanocrystals with Plasmonic Nanostructures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11420)
*Marcin Szalkowski,Maciej Fryckowski,Małgorzata Misiak,Artur Bednarkiewicz,Dawid Piątkowski,Sebastian Maćkowski*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文利用银岛膜等离激元场增强作用，将光子雪崩稀土纳米晶的激发功率密度降低十倍以上，为低功率亚衍射成像与传感探针提供新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子雪崩（PA）成像策略凭借简单光学装置、近红外激发与发射、低细胞毒性和高光稳定性等优势而受到关注，但其实际应用受限于较高的激发功率密度（10–100 s kW/cm²），这一瓶颈制约了其推广。

Method: 采用金属纳米结构提供的电磁场增强来缓解该限制，对耦合到银岛膜上的单个光子雪崩纳米晶进行显微研究，并结合数值建模分析等离激元介导的电磁场增强对光子雪崩动力学的影响。

Result: 实验表明，触发雪崩发射所需的激发功率密度降低十倍以上，数值模拟结果与实验相符，并阐明了等离激元介导的电磁场增强在改变光子雪崩动力学中的作用。

Conclusion: 该等离激元增强策略可显著降低光子雪崩的激发功率需求，为新一代低激发功率的亚衍射成像与传感探针开辟了道路。

Abstract: Optical sub-diffraction imaging has become an essential tool in modern research. Recently, a new imaging strategy has been demonstrated that exploits the strongly nonlinear excitation-emission response of rare-earth-doped nanocrystals operating in the photon avalanche (PA) regime. This approach benefits from simple optical instrumentation, near-infrared excitation and emission, low cytotoxicity, and high photostability. However, its practical implementation is hindered by relatively high (10-100s of kW/cm2) excitation power densities required to initiate the PA process. We aim to mitigate this limitation through electromagnetic field enhancement provided by metallic nanostructures. The results of microscopic studies of individual photon-avalanching nanocrystals coupled to a silver island film demonstrate a greater than tenfold reduction in the excitation power density required to trigger the avalanche emission. These experimental results, corroborated by numerical modelling, which elucidates the role of plasmon-mediated electromagnetic field enhancement in modifying the photon avalanche dynamics, paves the way towards new generation of low excitation power probes for sub-diffraction imaging and sensing.

</details>


### [590] [Simulations of Fluorescence and Energy Transfer in Periodic Systems: Pitfalls and Considerations for Bound States in the Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11457)
*Ilia Lykov,Sergejs Boroviks,Olivier J. F. Martin*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文研究支持对称保护BIC的等离激元-光子混合谐振波导光栅，指出强局域场并不等同于有用的荧光增强，因为BIC在抑制辐射泄漏的同时会将大量能量导向欧姆损耗；受主吸收与FRET可被显著增强，但供体有用荧光增强仍有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BIC兼具高品质因子与强电磁场局域，常被认为可增强光-物质相互作用；但大场幅并不直接转化为有用的荧光增强或供体-受主间的能量转移增强，这一矛盾需要澄清，同时BIC荧光数值模拟（尤其周期边界条件的使用）存在陷阱。

Method: 针对支持对称保护BIC的混合等离激元-光子谐振波导光栅开展研究；通过大量数值模拟并比较不同品质因数（figures of merit），分析荧光、吸收与能量转移；区分近场FRET与由离域BIC模式介导的长程能量转移及重吸收机制；并将有限光栅结果与无限周期模拟进行对比。

Result: 强BIC相关场可增强受主吸收，但有用荧光增强仅为中等水平；BIC在抑制辐射泄漏的同时会将很大一部分能量重定向至欧姆损耗；在FRET实验中受主吸收可被强烈增强，而供体的有用荧光增强仍属中等。

Conclusion: 必须将近场FRET与长程能量转移和重吸收机制分开考虑（二者均由离域BIC模式介导）；有限光栅与无限周期模拟之间的概念不一致性得到解释；该工作为解读基于BIC的周期纳米光子系统中的荧光、吸收与能量转移提供了一致性框架。

Abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) combine high quality factors with strong electromagnetic-field localization and are therefore widely explored for enhancing light--matter interactions. However, large field amplitudes do not directly translate into useful fluorescence enhancement or energy transfer enhancement between two donor--acceptor fluorophores. Here, we investigate this question for a hybrid plasmonic--photonic resonant waveguide grating supporting a symmetry-protected BIC. We emphasize some of the pitfalls associated with the numerical simulations, especially the utilization of periodic boundary conditions for fluorescence. Strong BIC-related fields can enhance acceptor absorption while useful fluorescence enhancement remains moderate. Extensive simulations and the comparison of different figures of merit, indicate that, while a BIC can suppress radiative leakage, it can also redirect a large fraction of the energy into Ohmic losses. As a result, the useful fluorescence enhancement of donors remains moderate, whereas absorption by acceptors can be strongly enhanced in Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) experiments. It is essential to separate near-field FRET from long-range energy transfer and reabsorption mechanisms, both of which are mediated by the delocalized BIC mode. Finally, results obtained for finite gratings are compared with infinite periodic simulations and conceptual inconsistencies explained. This work provides a consistent framework for interpreting fluorescence, absorption, and energy transfer in BIC-based periodic nanophotonic systems.

</details>


### [591] [Learning qBIC Resonances across Metasurface Families in Dielectric Fourier Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11500)
*Shuangteng Lei,Li Yu,Tianxin Li,Wei Lu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作将7类介电超表面共2015个样本映射到统一倒格子网格，用冻结低阶傅里叶通道描述共振位移，并以K空间骨干+局部复K空间专家（可微Fano层）建模宽谱与超窄qBIC，显著降低共振位置与深度误差，并支持谱到结构重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BIC/qBIC超表面通常用几何特异参数描述，导致跨几何结构难以比较；同时超窄qBIC特征在全光谱学习中容易被稀释而难以准确刻画。

Method: 将来自7个介电超表面家族的2015个样本映射到共享倒格子网格；用两个冻结的低阶傅里叶通道捕捉共振位移，并做场级分析验证Maxwell-Fourier微扰图像；构建五通道K空间骨干模型宽谱，并用局部复K空间专家结合可微Fano层参数化qBIC共振。

Result: 低阶傅里叶通道对共振位移的分支内平均R²为0.871–0.999；两个代表性分支的场级分析支持Maxwell-Fourier微扰解释；在几何阻断测试集上，专家将共振位置MAE从3.2 nm降至0.95 nm，共振深度误差降低14倍；同一坐标还支持谱到结构重构。

Conclusion: 统一的K空间/倒格子坐标可实现跨几何的BIC/qBIC超表面共振描述与建模，既能提升超窄共振参数预测精度，又能统一支持谱到结构反演。

Abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BIC) metasurfaces are typically described by geometry-specific parameters, hindering cross-geometry comparison, while ultranarrow qBIC features are easily diluted in full-spectrum learning. Here, 2015 samples from seven dielectric metasurface families are mapped to a shared reciprocal-lattice grid, where two frozen low-order Fourier channels capture resonance shifts with mean within-branch $R^2$ values of 0.871-0.999. Field-level analysis of two representative branches further confirms that these shifts are consistent with the Maxwell-Fourier perturbation picture. A five-channel K-space backbone models the broadband spectrum, while a local complex K-space expert parameterizes the qBIC resonance through a differentiable Fano layer. The expert reduces resonance-position mean absolute error (MAE) from 3.2 to 0.95 nm and the resonance-depth error by 14-fold on a geometry-blocked test set. The same coordinate supports spectrum-to-structure reconstruction.

</details>


### [592] [RF-Resolved RIN Engineering of High-Power CW Yb Fiber Laser Architectures Using Seed Topology, Seed Power, Pumping Geometry and Cavity FSR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11856)
*Anitta Augustine,V. Meher,Shantanu Dambare,V. Balaswamy*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 首次在统一72 W输出、10 kHz–1 GHz频段上，对四种设计参数如何共同塑造高功率CW掺Yb光纤激光器RIN进行了受控对比实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高功率连续波掺Yb光纤激光器的相对强度噪声（RIN）会限制非线性与频率变换光子学应用，但缺乏在同等条件下对多种腔结构设计参数的系统性、like-for-like实验映射。

Method: 对比独立双向FBG振荡器、FBG种子MOPA，以及FSR约11.5 MHz和5 MHz的单向环形种子MOPA，均在1064 nm附近、共同72 W输出下，测量10 kHz–1 GHz的RF分辨RIN；并分别比较种子光与放大输出以考察噪声传递。

Result: 低频RIN受技术噪声限制且几乎与架构无关；160 kHz以上由种子腔拓扑及其放大传递决定。高种子功率抑制中高频RIN，但两种拓扑传递方向相反：FBG种子在15 W时2 MHz–1 GHz RMS RIN经放大由3.66%升至4.14%，环形种子则由1.47%降至1.35%。前向泵浦功率缩放与噪声折中最佳；环形FSR由约11.5 MHz降至5 MHz仍保持高频RIN优势。匹配条件下环形种子使160 kHz–2 MHz积分RMS RIN降低2–3倍，2 MHz–1 GHz降低约3倍（约9–10 dB，近-127.4 dBc/Hz）。

Conclusion: 给出了按频段划分的设计规则，将各频段与主导调控杠杆对应；单向环形种子MOPA为宽带泵浦RIN抑制提供了简单可扩展路径。

Abstract: We report, to the best of our knowledge, the first controlled, like-for-like experimental mapping of how four practical design parameters--seed-cavity topology, seed power, amplifier pumping geometry, and seed-cavity free spectral range (FSR)--jointly shape the radio-frequency (RF)-resolved relative intensity noise (RIN) of high-power continuous-wave (CW) Yb-doped fiber lasers. We compare a standalone bidirectional fiber Bragg grating (FBG) oscillator, an FBG-seeded master-oscillator power amplifier (MOPA), and unidirectional ring-seeded MOPAs with FSRs of approximately 11.5 and 5 MHz, all near 1064 nm at a common 72 W output, with RIN measured from 10 kHz to 1 GHz. Across all settings, the low-frequency RIN is technical-noise limited and nearly architecture-independent, whereas RIN above 160 kHz is governed by the seed-cavity topology and its transfer through the amplifier. Higher seed power suppresses the mid- and high-frequency RIN, but the seed-alone and amplified-output comparison reveals opposite transfer for the two topologies: for FBG seeding the 2 MHz-1 GHz RMS RIN increases through amplification (3.66 percent to 4.14 percent at 15 W seed), whereas for ring seeding it decreases (1.47 percent to 1.35 percent). Forward pumping gives the best power-scaling/noise trade-off, while reducing the ring FSR from approximately 11.5 to 5 MHz preserves the high-frequency RIN advantage, confirming it is not a mode-spacing effect. At matched conditions, ring seeding lowers the integrated RMS RIN by 2-3 times (160 kHz-2 MHz) and approximately 3 times (2 MHz-1 GHz, approximately 9-10 dB to near -127.4 dBc/Hz). These results yield band-resolved design rules linking each band to its dominant lever. The unidirectional ring-seeded MOPA thus offers a simple, scalable route to broadband pump-RIN suppression for nonlinear and frequency-conversion photonics.

</details>


### [593] [Temporal chirality in Floquet photonic media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11940)
*Rui-Chuan Zhang,Yixin Sha,Yi Yang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文揭示时间调制光子介质中的"时间手性"：反转复介电常数闭合回路取向可在保持Floquet谱不变的同时显著改变定向散射响应，其根源是演化算符的赝厄米性与赝酉性，并通过单谐时间PT对称系统验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在空间光子学中，手性与对称性对波传播方向的控制已被广泛研究，而在时间调制（时变）光子介质中，是否存在类似"时间手性"的概念、以及调制回路的绕行方向能否作为调控自由度，尚不清楚。作者希望明确时间调制系统中取向依赖的物理机制，并寻找新的波动力学调控手段。

Method: 引入复Bogoliubov参数化描述散射振幅，从演化算符出发分析赝厄米性与赝酉性两类对称约束，证明时间手性的一般性。以单谐时间PT对称系统为具体模型，比较两种调制回路取向下的Floquet谱与定向散射行为，并用全波仿真验证。

Result: 两种调制回路取向在相变点处支持相同的真空型Floquet光子能带（Floquet谱不变），但定向散射响应截然不同：一种取向抑制反向光子产生，另一种则引起强烈增长；全波仿真证实了该现象。

Conclusion: 时间手性构成时变光子学中一个独立的新概念，调制回路取向成为调控Floquet波动力学的有效控制参量。

Abstract: We reveal temporal chirality in time-modulated photonic media: reversing the orientation of a closed loop traced by the complex permittivity can leave the Floquet spectrum unchanged while strongly modifying the directional scattering response under the same excitation. This behavior is linked to two symmetry constraints on the evolution operator, namely pseudo-Hermiticity and pseudo-unitarity. We prove the general occurrence of temporal chirality based on a complex Bogoliubov parametrization of the scattering amplitudes. We illustrate these findings in a single-harmonic temporal-$\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric system: both modulation-loop orientations support the same vacuum-like Floquet photonic bands at the phase transition, but one suppresses backward photon generation whereas the other induces strong growth, as confirmed by full-wave simulations. Our results establish temporal chirality as a distinct notion in time-varying photonics and identify modulation-loop orientation as a control knob for Floquet wave dynamics.

</details>


### [594] [Observation of robust corner states in photonic crystals without global symmetries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12062)
*Zitao Ji,Jianfeng Chen,Yidong Zheng,Zhaogang Dong,Zhi-Yuan Li*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出并在光子晶体中实验实现了一类无需全局对称性与非平庸拓扑的稳健角态：通过局部调控平庸结构的角几何，将连接体带中一对狄拉克点的平带边缘态移入平庸带隙，形成对位置与半径无序均稳定的强局域角态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稳健角态多依赖二阶拓扑绝缘体（如收缩-膨胀晶格、呼吸Kagome晶格），其形成本质依赖全局对称性，导致对结构无序高度敏感。作者希望突破对称性与拓扑保护的依赖，寻找更普适的稳健局域机制。

Method: 在原本拓扑平庸的光子晶体中局域裁剪角几何；利用体带结构中一对狄拉克点所连接的平带边缘态，通过几何调谐将其移入原本平庸的带隙，从而诱导强局域角态；并在实验中验证其对位置与半径无序的稳定性。

Result: 成功实现强局域角态，且该角态在位置无序与半径无序下均保持稳定；证实其非偶然产生，而源于体带中狄拉克点对的平带边缘态被几何调谐移入平庸带隙。

Conclusion: 揭示了一类此前被忽视的、与对称性无关且抗无序的角态，将稳健局域拓展至传统拓扑保护之外，并为全介质光子系统中的光局域提供新途径。

Abstract: Robust corner states have attracted considerable attention in recent years, particularly in photonic systems. They are typically realized in second-order topological insulators, including shrunken-expanded lattices and breathing Kagome lattices, where global symmetries are essential in their formation. This reliance on symmetry, however, can make these states highly sensitive to structural disorder. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a class of robust corner states in photonic crystals that require neither global symmetry nor nontrivial topology. By locally tailoring the corner geometry of an otherwise topologically trivial structure, we create strongly localized modes that remain stable under both position and radius disorder. These states are not accidental; rather they originate from a pair of Dirac points in the bulk band structure. Geometric tuning shifts the flatband edge states connecting the Dirac points into an otherwise trivial bandgap, thereby inducing strongly localized corner states. Our findings uncover a previously overlooked class of symmetry-independent, disorder-resilient corner states, extend robust localization beyond conventional topological protection, and provide a route toward light localization in all-dielectric photonic systems.

</details>


### [595] [Minimizing round-trip loss for near-unity quantum efficiency in organic light-emitting diodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12065)
*Junho Kim,Seonjeong Lee,Seunghyup Yoo,Malte C. Gather*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文将OLED光提取重新定义为多次往返过程，指出吸收损耗是外量子效率停滞在55-60%的根本原因，并通过引入低损耗辅助反射镜将高折射率微透镜基底OLED的EQE从51%提升至77%，并提出四条设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代OLED内量子效率接近100%，但平面器件仅20-30%光子能逃逸。尽管外耦合结构可回收部分被困光，但不同光学设计下EQE始终停滞在55-60%，这一上限的来源尚不完全清楚，因此需要揭示其物理机制以突破效率瓶颈。

Method: 作者将OLED光提取视为多程（multi-pass）过程：未被外耦合结构提取的光返回OLED并被反射回来，可经过多次往返逃逸，其效率由每次往返的吸收损耗决定。通过在OLED上附加低损耗辅助反射镜（auxiliary reflector）来降低往返损耗，在不改变OLED叠层和外耦合结构的条件下测试EQE变化，并据此推导设计规则。

Result: 在传统平面OLED中吸收损耗较小，但附加外耦合结构后吸收损耗变得占主导，解释了观察到的效率上限。加入低损耗辅助反射镜后，高折射率微透镜基底OLED的EQE从51%提升至77%，这是无宏观提取透镜的单结OLED报道的最高值；常规玻璃基底OLED估计有92%的光被提取到基底。所推导的四条设计规则可将往返损耗保持在百分之几，并预测在现有材料条件下EQE可达约90%。

Conclusion: 光提取的多程图像与吸收损耗主导机制解释了OLED外量子效率的上限。通过降低往返吸收损耗，可显著提升EQE，并预测约90%的EQE在现有材料体系下可行。在该设计规则下，微腔调谐和发光体取向很大程度上不再重要，且高效率可在广泛的微透镜设计和散射层中保持。

Abstract: Modern organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) reach internal quantum efficiencies close to 100%, yet in a planar device only 20-30% of photons escape. External outcoupling structures on high-index substrates recover some of the trapped light, but external quantum efficiencies (EQEs) have stalled at 55-60% across different optical designs, and the origin of this ceiling is not fully understood. Here we identify light extraction in such OLEDs as a multi-pass process: light that the outcoupling structure fails to extract returns to the OLED, is reflected back and may escape over multiple passes, with the efficiency governed by the absorption per round trip. Absorption loss is minor in conventional planar OLEDs, but it becomes dominant and accounts for the observed efficiency ceiling when an outcoupling structure is attached. Consistent with this picture, adding a low-loss auxiliary reflector raised the EQE of an OLED on a high-index microlens substrate from 51% to 77% without any change to the OLED stack or the outcoupling structure, the highest value reported for a single-junction OLED without a macroscopic extraction lens; for an OLED on a conventional glass substrate an estimated 92% of the light delivered to the substrate was extracted. We derive four design rules that keep round-trip losses to a few percent and predict that EQEs around 90% are feasible with established materials. Under these rules, microcavity tuning and emitter orientation largely cease to matter, and high efficiency is retained across a wide range of microlens designs and scattering layers.

</details>


### [596] [Spatiotemporal computing for temporal nonlinear tasks using few-mode fiber and SOA nonlinearity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12173)
*Adhila Nazarudeen,Silvia Ortín,Apostolos Argyris*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在阶跃折射率少模光纤（FMF）输出端引入半导体光放大器（SOA）非线性支路，与直接支路并行处理，实现非线性分类任务，并在28.5 Gb/s下验证了延迟XOR及高阶奇偶校验任务性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前基于FMF的模间色散已实现线性分类（如超快多比特报头识别），但缺乏非线性处理能力，无法应对非线性任务，因此需要扩展该架构的计算能力。

Method: 在色散介质（FMF）输出端引入光学非线性，将FMF输出分为直接支路与非线性支路并行处理，非线性支路由SOA实现；在28.5 Gb/s下对延迟XOR与高阶奇偶校验任务进行实验评估，并利用每比特周期内多个时间采样作为独立分类器特征提升光子表示维度。

Result: 融合直接与SOA变换表示可降低分类误差，并拓宽支持低误差分类的工作条件范围；利用比特周期内多时间采样增加特征维度后，计算性能进一步提升。

Conclusion: 在FMF色散平台上引入SOA非线性并采用多时间采样特征，可有效将线性光子处理架构扩展至非线性任务，提升分类精度与工作条件鲁棒性。

Abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. In previous studies, we have demonstrated linear classification tasks with such FMFs, such as ultrafast multibit header recognition. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We experimentally evaluate the architecture at 28.5 Gb/s on two delayed XOR and higher-order parity tasks. We show that combining the direct and SOA-transformed representations reduces classification errors and broadens the range of operating conditions supporting low-error classification. In addition, by exploiting multiple temporal samples within each bit period as independent classifier features, we increase the dimensionality of the photonic representation and improve the computational performance.

</details>

### [597] [Time-Domain Analysis of Surface Acoustic Wave Magnetoelectric Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11421)
*Mohsen Samadi,Henrik Wolframm,Felix Weisheit,Dirk Meyners,Eckhard Quandt,Michael Höft,Martina Gerken*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 采用时域与频域互补的数值与实验方法，表征多层Love波延迟线磁电SAW传感器的瞬态传播特性，提取延迟时间及相/群速度，并验证时频域分析的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAW传感器的瞬态响应对理解其动态行为、传播延迟及对时变信号的响应至关重要，但相关传播特性的定量表征尚不充分，尤其是多层结构中Love波色散导致的相速度与群速度差异。

Method: 针对基于多层Love波延迟线的磁电SAW传感器，结合数值仿真与实验：用时域分析确定延迟时间并提取相速度和群速度，用频域分析独立表征波色散，并通过波场追踪与色散关系计算群速度进行交叉验证。

Result: 在146 MHz工作频率下，波场追踪所得仿真群速度与频域色散关系结果偏差仅0.4%；仿真延迟时间和群速度与实验吻合良好，偏差分别为2.7%和0.9%。数值与实验均显示相速度与群速度不同，反映多层结构中的Love波色散。

Conclusion: 时域与频域分析结果具有一致性，实现了SAW传感器瞬态传播行为的定量表征，为理解其动态特性和时变信号响应提供了可靠依据。

Abstract: The transient response of surface acoustic wave sensors is important for understanding their dynamic behavior, propagation delay, and response to time-varying signals. In this work, the time-domain propagation characteristics of a magnetoelectric SAW sensor based on a multilayer Love-wave delay line are investigated using complementary numerical and experimental approaches. Time-domain analysis is employed to determine the delay time and to extract the phase and group velocities, while frequency-domain analysis provides an independent characterization of the wave dispersion. Both numerically and experimentally, the phase and group velocities are found to differ, reflecting the dispersion of the Love wave in the multilayer structure. At the operating frequency of 146 MHz, the simulated group velocity obtained from wave-field tracking agrees within 0.4% with the value determined from the frequency-domain dispersion relation. The simulated delay time and group velocity also show good agreement with experiment, with deviations of 2.7% in delay time and 0.9% in group velocity. These results demonstrate the consistency of the time- and frequency-domain analyses and provide a quantitative characterization of the transient propagation behavior of SAW sensors.

</details>
